publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The system provides a speed recognition system installed at the smart home. Any person could utilize the system to orally operate the TVs and lighting fittings. The system is composed of speed recognition TV dialing system, speed recognition living room-based lighting fitting system. The design achieves the intelligent control of home with the core STC89C52 single-chip computer, the LD3320 speech recognition module and infrared T-R module. The system functions with the hardware and by the software. When the LD3320 speech recognition module receives the user speech command, it would quickly collect and process this command, and then send the command to the single-chip computer of master control which would follow the set programme to analyze and process the command. The command which had been processed with the infrared T-R module would be sent to the single-chip computer which would process and reduce the speech command. The object to be controlled would be demanded by the command to alter real time the relevant display status. The tests prove that the design has an functional accuracy of 93%.

articleTitle: OpenCV - based 3D printing physical surface defect detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: with the development of the society, The demand for daily necessities continues to increase, At the same time, the production efficiency and quality requirements of the products are getting higher and higher. Aiming at this problem A feasible method for 3D printing physical surface defect detection based on OpenCV. Get the products you need quickly through reverse technology, Guaranteed efficient production. At the same time, using OpenCV-based surface defect inspection to ensure product quality. First, obtain a physical surface image through a color industrial CCD camera. Secondly, the histogram equalization method can enhance the contrast of the image and Image preprocessing. Finally, image morphological segmentation of dual-core defect recognition technology is used to detect the position of physical surface defects. This method can accurately detect 3D printing physical surface defects. Achieved the intended purpose.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis and Contrastive Experiments of Long News Texts
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the current patterns and characteristics of information dissemination, this paper makes a sentiment analysis of network news. It aims to effectively control the spread of negative and false information, maintain social stability, and provide support for relevant departments to master the right of disseminate discourse. The "Belt and Road" related corpus obtained through web crawler is used as the experimental corpus. We use the dictionary method, machine learning method and deep learning method to analyze the preprocessed corpus respectively. Among them, machine learning algorithms include Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes and Support Vector Machine(SVM). The method of deep learning is Long Short-term Memory(LSTM) network. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the dictionary-based method is lower than the other two methods. The accuracy of the machine learning-based method depends on the selection of the feature vector dimension. In contrast, deep learning-based method have higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Cylindrical conformal broadband array antenna based on defective ground structure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The existing cylindrical conformal ultra-wideband antennas are mostly unit antennas, although the working bandwidth is wider, the gain is low. When the array antenna is conformal on the surface of the cylinder, the working bandwidth is narrowed because of the deformation of the array antenna. To solve this problem, a cylindrical conformal array antenna based on rectangular defective ground structure(DGS) is proposed in this paper. The antenna is designed as a cylindrical conformal wideband array antenna with a center frequency of 10 GHz, which broadens the bandwidth by loading rectangular defective ground structures on the backplane. The simulation results show that the bandwidth of the cylindrical conformal array antenna increases from 0.2GHz to 1.6GHz after loading the rectangular defective ground structure, and the gain of the antenna increases from 12.3dB to 14.1dB. The operating frequency bandwidth of the conformal array antenna is effectively increased without adding the thickness of the dielectric layer, which is more advantageous for miniaturization and integration of the array antenna.

articleTitle: Atoll-based Propagation Model Correction and Actual Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the mobile communication system, the radio wave propagation model describes the propagation characteristics of radio wave from the transmitter to the receiver. It is closely related to the specific propagation environment and is the first consideration in the field of network planning and network optimization. Although the classical propagation model is universal, the prediction of specific propagation environment is not accurate enough. Therefore, it is necessary to correct the propagation model by combining the geomorphic characteristics of specific areas. First, we simulated Okumura-Hata model, Cost231-Hata model, SUI model and Standard propagation model (SPM) with Atoll. Secondly, the signal field intensity of 2.6GHz band in a certain university was tested. Then, combining Atoll, the average error, standard deviation and root mean square error of the predicted value and measured value of the above four propagation models were calculated, thus verifying the predicted value of Cost231-Hata model was closer to the measured value. Finally, the correction of the Cost231-Hata model is completed by Atoll, and the corrected standard deviation is 5.75dB. The research in this paper is expected to be used in network planning and network optimization and it provides a reference for the 5G network being constructed in this kind of propagation environment.

Author Keywords: the measurement of signal field strength

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Closed Loop Control System for Large Precision Machining
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of science and technology has greatly improved the level of equipment manufacturing industry. Advanced manufacturing equipment based on CNC machine tools has increasingly shown a unique and important role. The wide application of CNC machine tools has important practical value for reference to the industrial development level of different countries in the world. This paper conducts and models and simulates the closed-loop control system of large precision machining machines. The software used for the simulation is Matlab and Simulink. The simulation controller uses a PID controller. The simulation results show that the PID control algorithm can control the position accuracy of the system well, and also discusses the influence of PID parameters on the system control results. The feed servo system of CNC machine tools has some remarkable features. It can accurately control the actuators by receiving the position and speed control signals output from the CNC system, moving them according to the set parameters, and putting several actuators. The laws of motion are dynamically integrated to complete the predetermined motion trajectory. In actual machining, for any feed axis of a CNC machine tool, a corresponding feed system for driving action is required. Improving the dynamic and static performance of the feed servo system is of great significance for ensuring the processing quality of mechanical products.

articleTitle: State Assessment of Measuring Error and Analysis of Risk Early Warning Technology for Operating CVT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The state evaluation of measurement performance of CVT is an important part of the state evaluation of electric energy metering devices. Based on the measurement data of several running CVTs in power grid and using the processing thought of big data for reference, this paper seeks the potential correlation between measurement data and errors of running CVT, evaluates the measurement performance of running CVT, warns CVT with high risk of error overshoot, and establishes the evaluation system of CVT metering performance condition-based maintenance and formulates corresponding operation and maintenance strategies. This paper designs an on-line monitoring and risk early warning system for measuring error status of CVT, which collects, transmits, processes, monitors and warns the output data of running CVT in real time.

articleTitle: An Improved Ant Colony Algorithm for Traveling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the disadvantages of the basic ant colony algorithm in solving non-deterministic polynomial problems, such as slow convergence rate and local optimal solution. In this paper, the updating rules of pheromone and the updating strategy of target city in ant colony algorithm are improved, and an improved ant colony algorithm (IACA) is proposed. In addition, it is applied to the shortest traversal path search of travel salesman problem. Taking 33 provincial capitals and berlin52 problems as test objects, this paper compares the search efficiency of the proposed algorithm with that of the basic ant colony algorithm. It can be seen from the simulation results that IACA has a faster convergence rate than the basic ant colony algorithm. IACA is obviously superior to the basic ant colony algorithm in terms of convergence and the quality of the optimal solution. It provides a new choice for solving similar optimization problems.

articleTitle: Improvement of YOLOv3 network based on ROI
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The paper adopts the YOLOv3 network, by removing the calculation of non-interest areas to improve the operation speed of YOLOv3. It increases the operating speed in proportion to the size of the non-interest area. The author studies the characteristics of the convolutional layer and the YOLO layer, and proposes a new processing method from the experimental results. In this paper, the ROI image processing technology in the video detection sequence is used to filter the ROI region, eliminate the calculation outside the ROI, and improve the detection speed and accuracy of the YOLOv3 network.

articleTitle: Research on Attack Mechanism of Network Intrusion in Industrial Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, safety incidents of industrial control systems (ICS) have occurred frequently. On the one hand, the gradual adaptation of standards, general communication protocols and software and hardware systems to ICS reduces the attack difficulty of ICS. On the other hand, more and more vulnerability researchers focus on ICS which is becoming the focus of network attackers. This paper analyses the vulnerability and security risks of the current ICS architecture, network environment, communication protocols and supporting software. With the help of the concept of Cyber Kill Chain, the two stages of network attack in ICS are elaborated in detail. Combining with Havex and Stuxnet virus, the mechanism of network intrusion attack in ICS is analyzed comprehensively and thoroughly, which provides effective technical support for the research of ICS network attack defense.

articleTitle: A Complete Solution to the Stability of Discrete-time Scalar Systems with A Single Delay
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The stability of discrete-time scalar systems with a single delay is studied. A complete characterization of the stability set of delays is presented. Results show that discrete-time systems distinguish from continuous-time systems in the following aspect: the stability of the system at some value of delay d can not ensure the stability at delay of less than d. In addition, a necessary and sufficient condition for the systems admitting a delay margin is obtained and this delay margin is given analytically.

articleTitle: Modified Model Predictive Control of Voltage Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the shortcomings in the direct current model predictive control of the traditional voltage source inverters, output voltage's quality is poor and waveform distortion rate is high. When the load changes, the tracking accuracy of the control system to the output current is not high, and there is a delay problem. In response to the above problems, the output accuracy is improved by adding voltage loop and feed-forward compensation of load current to compensate the load disturbance; solve the system delay problem by vector angle compensation method, solve the overshoot caused by current's step change by load change, and improve current's tracking accuracy. The optimal vector selection method is added to the cost function to reduce the switching frequency, reduce the output waveform distortion and improve power quality. Theoretical validity is verified by the simulation and theoretical comparison with the help of MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Research on Image Caption Method Based on Mixed Image Features
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of deep learning in the field of image caption, the effect of it has improved. However, the traditional method for feature extraction is based on the whole picture, ignoring the local features and the relationships of global and local features. Another problem is that the text description is broad and not targeted. Considering the above problems, we propose a new method based on mixed image features. The method uses an improved ResNet to extract global features. Local features are extracted using a deep RetinaNet. The global and the local features of the image are merged by an attention mechanism, which are mapped into embedding vectors. To obtain the mapping relationship between images and descriptions, a long short-term memory (LSTM) based on an attention mechanism is used as a language generation model. Image features and semantic features are combined to generate content description of images.

articleTitle: Box Detection and Positioning based on Mask R-CNN [1] for Container Unloading
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Container unloading is a very dangerous job, so how to automate it is very necessary.There are currently machines that can be fully automated and unloaded for specific situations, but the generalization is not good. In order to automatically unload the goods under different situation, it is necessary to find a way to replace the human eye, how to establish a complete identification and positioning Vision system is very important.Traditional methods based on Vision are difficult to achieve end-to-end unloading automation.We use deep learning-based target detection here. The algorithm Mask-RCNN is used to detect specific objects. The second generation Kinect developed by Microsoft can completely re- place the human eye. In the simulation environment, we get the recognition speed of each frame for 0.2 seconds, which can get the three-dimensional coordinates of each box precise. By feeding back the data to the machine, the machine can know their target clearly.This is a good promotion of the development of automatic unloading

articleTitle: Development and Application of Parts Assembly Guidance System Based on Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the traditional assembly process, it is difficult for operators to quickly understand assembly process information from the instruction manual, which results in inefficient assembly process. Therefore, an assembly guidance system based on augmented reality is about to be proposed in this paper. Also, in view of the problem that geometric models cannot fully express part assembly relationships, this paper proposes to analyze and construct the assembly semantic information model of parts based on the part object model. On the basis of the above semantic information model, the assembly relationship between parts is visually modeled, and these information models are accurately superposed on the real assembly guidance environment by using AR and virtual space modeling technology. Finally, we recursively decompose the parts assembly situation in this paper, and establish the part assembly guidance prototype system to verify the order and accuracy of the part assembly guidance process.

articleTitle: Possible Fault Types and Impact Analysis of Phased Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The difference in the fault mode of the phased array antenna has different effects on the characteristic parameters of the phased array antenna. Studying the influence of fault mode on radar radiation characteristics is the premise and basis for test diagnosis. Therefore, the fault mode and influence of phased array antenna must be analyzed. This paper takes the case of phase shifter composed of common binary principle as an example to discuss the type of fault that a phased array antenna can have and its effect on antenna performance. Finally, in order to verify the degree of influence of array element fault on the performance of the antenna in the adopted array form, a half-wave array rectangular planar phased array antenna model is established. The simulation verifies that when it contains one, two, and the effect on the radiation characteristics of the antenna in the case of four faulty elements.

articleTitle: Improved grey wolf optimization based on the Quantum-behaved mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Grey Wolf optimization algorithm is a new swarm intelligence optimization algorithm proposed in recent years. It has strong local search ability but weak global search ability. An improved grey wolf optimization is proposed, which combining quantum behavior strategy with grey wolf optimization algorithm, to prevent the algorithm from falling into local optimum. 5 benchmark functions are used to compare with other improved grey wolf optimization algorithms, which proves that the proposed algorithm has better optimization performance.

articleTitle: A feature extraction technique in stereo matching network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Feature extraction is the basic and vital part of stereo matching. Accurate and effective feature extraction is the precondition of correct disparity estimation. Large-scale pooling is widely used to extract high-level features in the stereo matching network, but a lot of semantics is discarded. Meanwhile, frank bilinear interpolation with rare high-level information causes error propagation in the matching cost calculating. We apply Feature Pyramid Net to extract the multi-scale features with more context information and restore resolution layer by layer. The approach is validated on KITTI and Scene Flow.

articleTitle: MCA-GAN: Text-to-Image Generation Adversarial Network Based on Multi-Channel Attention
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: It is an extremely challenging task to text-to-image generation based on generative adversarial network(GAN). Although some researchers have made remarkable progress in the field of image generation in recent years, it is still a problem to be solved in the aspect of texture detail in image generation. An attention generation algorithm based on multi-channel is presented in this paper. The network gradually refine by three branches to produce high-resolution images that conform to the text description. By the iterative training of GAN, the multi-channel feature attention mechanism is used to guide the pixel value deviation and loss in the process of image generation. Through a lot of experiments and people’s visual perception of the generated images, the algorithm based on multi-channel attention mechanism proposed in this paper has been significantly improved in the processing of details.

articleTitle: Data Visualization of University Laboratory Digital Asset Management System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: At present, data visualization has become a supporting technology for analyzing data in various fields. This paper mainly visualizes the digital assets retained in the laboratory, mainly on the papers, awards, and team profiles. Etc. In this paper, ECharts is used as the main tool for mapping data to charts. Python scripts crawl the paper keywords to generate word clouds, and finally display the laboratory results with H5. A deeper understanding of the lab is achieved by visualizing the digital asset system.

articleTitle: Applications of LoRa Technology in Smart Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a set of wireless communication module based on LoRa technology is developed, and a complete local area network wireless communication solutions satisfying long distance and low power consumption is proposed, which has wide wireless coverage, strong penetration and star architecture. By using LoRa communication, the data of the distribution terminal can be transmitted to the data collection unit seamlessly. The data is more safe and reliable. Through practical field application, the communication system is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Fault Diagnosis System of Coal Mine Drilling Rigs based on Drilling Parameters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the underground fully hydraulic drilling rigs mainly relies on manual experience to diagnose faults, which requires high professional skills of the operators and can not accurately and reasonably judge the fault types, this paper puts forward a method to identify faults by using the sensitive drilling parameters in the drilling rigs construction. Firstly, principal component analysis(PCA) algorithm is used to extract features from drilling sensitive data sets, which eliminates the correlation between drilling data sets. Then, the self-organizing maps(SOM) neural network clustering algorithm is performed on the trained samples, and the cluster centers are obtained. By calculating the Euclidean distance between each sample in the test sample set and the cluster center in the high-dimensional feature space, the Bayesian discriminant method is used to judge the test samples, and the final fault diagnosis result is obtained. The diagnostic accuracy rate is up to 90%. This method provides a new and reliable fault warning method for the fully hydraulic drilling rigs in coal mine.

articleTitle: Fujian Anti-Disaster Baseline Power Grid Planning Method Based on Network-Source-Load Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to reduce the disastrous blackouts caused by the damage of natural disasters to power facilities, this paper proposes the method of differential planning to construct a anti-disaster baseline power grid, starting from the view of protecting key power users and balancing the relationship between input and benefit of anti-disaster. The methods and principles of systematically constructing the power grid based on network-source-load cooperation, such as the selection of guaranteed scope of key users, the planning of anti-disaster guaranteed power supply and the planning of baseline power grid, are projected from. Taking the power grid of a city in Fujian province as an example, this paper constructs a anti-disaster baseline power grid scheme, and puts forward some suggestions for the differential construction of anti-disaster baseline power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Storage of Big Data Based on HBase Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of remote sensing, satellites and drone technologies, the remote sensing image datasets are exploding. The traditional storage modes can't meet the storage requirements of massive remote sensing image data. Therefore, this paper proposes a large data storage scheme for remote sensing image based on HBase. The method utilizes distributed storage and column-oriented open source database HBase as the storage model of remote sensing image big data, and uses tile pyramid technology and MapReduce parallel computing framework to construct the tile pyramid of remote sensing image. Finally, the remote sensing image data blocks are stored in the distributed database HBase. This method can effectively improve the storage problem of remote sensing image big data, and has good reliability, scalability and processing efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Fuel Cell Vehicle Power System Selection and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Because of its free from contamination and zero emission, fuel cell vehicles which become a research hot in the field of electric vehicle overcome the defect of short trip range of mileage of the pure electric vehicle. At the same time, fuel cell vehicle is friendly to the environment and has high energy conversion efficiency, which the internal combustion engine car is not incomparable. At the same time, fuel cell vehicle is friendly to the environment and has high energy conversion efficiency， which the internal combustion engine car is not incomparable. Besides the fuel cell car still keep the performance of accelerating, high speed and long distance. It is necessary to research the powertrain of fuel cell cars. This thesis focuses on the model selection and parameters design of the power system of fuel cell cars. The power system components are modeled by MATLAB/SIMULINK, and the power performance of fuel cell vehicles and the operation of power system components are simulated and analyzed by ADVISOR under actual working conditions.

articleTitle: A Tracking Method Based on Target Classification and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To solve the precise tracking problem of unknown targets in the air, the method based on target classification and recognition is to select different motion models for different type of targets. In this paper, there are three unknown air targets: fighters, civil aircraft and helicopters. Firstly, different accurate motion models are designed for these three targets. Bayesian inference is used to classify and identify the target with the target state and signal. With the classification result, the suited motion model is selected for tracking. The result shows that compared with the standard Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) algorithm, this method can reduce the error of target tracking by about 10%. It shows that making accurate models for the target motion can effectively improve the tracking accuracy of the unknown target with the accurate classification result.

articleTitle: Study on the Sensor Configuration Technology of the Cabin Detecting System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The selection of sensor types on the cabin detecting system is described, and the configuration principles of different types of sensors are given. Taking the shipborne weapon cabin as the model, an example application is carried out. We build the cabin detecting system in the cabin model, test the response time of the system. According to the test, the response time of the warning alarm of typical fire in typical sites is within 10s, the response time of the fire alarm is within 20s.

articleTitle: Research on the Characteristics of Community Network Information Transmission in Blockchain Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on information dissemination and block chain theory, combined with the characteristics of blockchain social network, this paper studies the information dissemination characteristics of the whole and subgroup networks based on the tags. The steemit data is obtained by the way of crawling and the social network analysis method is adopted. The Gephi which is visualization tool is used to process and visualize the data. The blockchain subgroups characteristics were compared and analyzed according to degree centrality, betweenness centrality and eccentricity. This paper concludes that the blockchain community information dissemination network is a scale-free network. Subgroup aggregation is not affected by subgroup size. Subgroup size affects the closeness between subgroups and the number of influence nodes.

articleTitle: PS-InSAR Analysis of Collapsed Dam and Extraction of Flood Inundation Areas in Laos Using Sentinel-1 SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) technique can potentially measure millimetre-scale changes in deformation by two or more SAR images. In this paper, thirty Sentinel-1 SAR images were processed with Persistent Scatterer InSAR (PS-InSAR) method over the collapsed dam in Laos to measure its deformation in the last year before the collapse. Then the deformation map of the dam is achieved. The map show that unusual subsidence occurred in the final two months prior to the collapse. Several feature points distributed near the collapse of the dam were analyzed. The maximum accumulated subsidence exceeded -20 mm in the last year. Our results indicate that PS-InSAR technology for deformation monitoring of dams can be used as an early warning method to prevent other similar accidents. Furthermore, we extracted the flood inundation map from two Sentinel-1 images. It can play a role in post-disaster relief work.

articleTitle: Design of Neural Network Identification System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the principle of BP neural network algorithm, this paper uses a FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) to implement a three-layer BP (back propagation) neural network system that recognizes the handwritten digits of the MNIST library. The system selects 100 test samples from the MNIST database and performs simulation tests on the recognition accuracy of the circuit in the FPGA development platform Quartus II 13.0 and Modelsim. The digital recognition accuracy of the simulation is 89%, which can be used in a simple pattern recognition system.

articleTitle: Job Information Crawling, Visualization and Clustering of Job Search Websites
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With so much information available on job-hunting websites, the partial information provided by job-hunting websites is of little reference value to fresh graduates or cross-industry job seekers. This paper is a machine learning algorithm based on Python language. It makes a comprehensive analysis of job information and realizes the visualization and text clustering of job information. It has good applicability and is convenient to be extended to other fields.

articleTitle: An Improvement Method of Feeder Protection in DC Traction Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The DC traction power supply system is an important part of urban rail transit, its reliable operation is the basis for the safe and stable operation of urban rail transit system. According to the existing urban rail DC feeder short-circuit criterion cannot correctly distinguish the starting current of heavy locomotive and the end short circuit current when has car, caused by the failure of protective devices, proposed in the current rise rate and current increment protection, meanwhile increased the ratio of peak current and stable current value as the auxiliary criterion of traditional protection, finally building the simulation model of urban rail transit system in MATLAB/Simulink, the simulation results show that the proposed method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: IRT Based Micro-Motion Target Frequency Estimation and Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the existing micro-motion (MM) frequency estimation methods cannot adapt to multi-MM targets and the operation speed is slow, a new algorithm for MM target frequency estimation and MM target detection is proposed. In this method, the radar echo of the MM target is modeled as (Sinusoidal frequency modulation) SFM signal, and the inverse Radon transform (IRT) is used to realize the MM target frequency estimation and detection. Not only can the algorithm accurately estimate the MM frequency of multiple targets at the same time, but also operate quickly. The simulation results show that the algorithm in this paper is correct and faster than Hough transform algorithm.

articleTitle: Luminescent Polymer Thims in Microelectronic Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: many electronic sensors need different colors when used in detections, indications and other different applications. These colors can come from europium ions taken polymer matrixes as basis materials. Colored sensors can be used in different integrated circuits. Though many integrated circuits are composed of semiconductors, they are easily cracked. Weak film-formation property hinders their markets and profits. In order to improve film formation, polymer matrixes are mixed in semiconductors and integrated circuits. Good film-formation property enhances furious competition and development of colored widescreen. In this paper, colored thin films were prepared, which could be used in ions sensors and widescreen.

articleTitle: Research on Micro-hole Electrolytic Machining Process with Sidewall Insulated Electrode
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Ultrasonic vibration technology had been used in the micro holes electrochemical machining (ECM) to exclude processed products within the gap, but the impact of ultrasonic cavitation influenced the insulating layers on the electrode surface and accelerated its destruction. In order to improve the life of the sidewall insulated electrode, the double insulating layer consisting of ceramic insulating film and electrophoretic paint film was formed on the surface of the fine titanium electrode by using the micro-arc oxidation and cathodic electrophoresis. The effects of ultrasonic vibration power, electrolyte concentration and machining voltage on the micro hole machining accuracy with the sidewall-insulated electrode was analyzed. The experimental results showed that the double insulation layers displayed a strong durability in ultrasonic vibration assisted micro holes electrochemical machining. When the ultrasonic vibration power exceeded a certain value, the processing was able to stabilize. Afterwards, the machining accuracy changed little with the increase the power. It is necessary to reduce the electrolyte concentration and the machining voltage, thereby reducing the stray corrosion, for ensuring the shape accuracy of the hole in stable machining.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Control and Test of Arc-suppression Coils on Parallel Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of parallel operation of arc-suppression coils, such as different manufacturers can not be connected in parallel, the same manufacturer have more tuning times and sometimes have tuning disorder, a fuzzy control method for parallel operation of arc -suppression coils based on membership function is proposed. Firstly, the problems of automatic parallel operation are analyzed. Based on the widely used multi-tap arc-suppression coil, a fuzzy control method of parallel operation based on membership function is proposed, and the hardware and software of the arc-suppression coil are designed. The parallel operation of several arc-suppression coils has been tested many times in the high voltage simulated power grid built in the laboratory. The experimental results show that the fuzzy control can minimize the tuning times of parallel operation, not only improve the service life of the tuning mechanism and the arc-suppression coil, but also avoid the tuning disorder. The method can be further extended.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Filter Cake Moisture in Ceramic Production by Least Squares Support Vector Machine based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the production process of ceramics, the moisture content of filter cake obtained by press filter has an important influence on the production of ceramics. In this paper, the least squares support vector machine prediction model is established, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the least squares vector machine parameters through the fitness function. Comparison with neural network and traditional SVM through simulation, simulation results show that the least squares support vector machine model based on particle swarm optimization has better prediction accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Absorption Analysis of Wind Power Projects Based on Regional Power Balance and N-1 Static Security Constraints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the rapid development of wind power in the region, the "back-load characteristics" of wind power itself and the slow development of low-valley load bring about the increasingly serious problem that the development of power grid lags behind the development of energy, especially the development of wind power. In this paper, a method of wind power project absorption analysis based on regional power balance and N-1 static security constraints is proposed. The local wind power absorption is evaluated by regional power balance, and the impact of N-1 static security constraints on wind power access to power grid is evaluated by the verification of each outlet section. The analysis of the feasibility and timing of the wind power construction is of great significance for the orderly development of wind power projects.

articleTitle: Coexistence Analysis between UWB Device and IMT System in 6~7GHz band
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper discusses the compatibility coexistence problem between UWB equipment and IMT system in 6~7GHz frequency band. By analyzing the parameters of IMT system and UWB technical parameters, combined with the link budget calculation method, the allowable interference in eMBB scene, intelligent manufacturing scene and auto-driving car networking scenario. The strength calculation and the summation analysis method calculate the total interference of multiple UWB devices to the IMT system in the eMBB scenario, and finally obtain the same-frequency interference of the single UWB device to the IMT system, the adjacent-frequency interference of the single UWB device to the IMT system, and multiple The calculation results of the same-frequency interference of the UWB equipment to the IMT system under different propagation models.

articleTitle: An incremental Bayesian network structure learning algorithm based on local updating strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Bayesian network is wildly applied in AI field, but current structure learning algorithms consume a significant amount of time when faced with big data. We propose an incremental algorithm based on local updating strategy. First, we adopted a balanced decomposition for the structure, found the sub-network needed to be updated, and updated it to obtain the new network. Then we did simulation experiments to verify the validity of our method. Finally, we compared the efficiency and accuracy of our method with that of other mainstream algorithms. The result shows that our method runs in a low constant time, and its average accuracy of structure learning reaches 98%.

articleTitle: Analysis of taxi track data based on spark platform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: How to analyze a large amount of traffic data, improve the level of urban traffic management, and discover the travel rules of urban residents from complex data, and rationally dispatch vehicles. Combined with the trajectory data of the yellow and green taxis in New York City, the traffic data is processed based on the Spark distributed data processing platform, and the K-means clustering algorithm is used to analyze the passengers' access points. The visualization of taxi passenger travel characteristics based on the platform is given, including the impact of rental car passengers, the distribution of urban residents' travel time and the distribution of taxi area speed. The gradient lifting algorithm is used to predict the importance of each feature of the training set, so as to rationally dispatch the vehicle.

articleTitle: A Non-Photorealistic Approach to Night Image Enhancement Using Human JND
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Night image enhancement is a challenging image enhancement problem due to its extremely low lighting condition and high dynamic range. Traditional methods such as gamma correction mostly try to keep the overall image lighting regime while increasing the exposure level. In this paper we propose a new non-photorealistic approach for this problem. The goal is to enhance each possible image detail regardless of the overall lighting condition, so as to see every possible image detail. In this approach, we first convert the image RGB color space to HSV color space and enhance only the V channel; Then we compute the background level for each pixel and locate all the edge points via human just-noticeable-difference (JND). Then we enhance all these edge points so that their background levels are adjusted to the range which is visually comfortable to humans. In the following step, we propagate these scaling factors to the rest of the non-edge points through least-squares optimization. We finally use the enhanced V channel and convert back to the RGB color space. Experimental results show that the propose approach, though not strictly photo-realistic, can achieve significant enhancement results entailing the most image details when compared with other typical methods.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of a Camera Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The current level of camera manufacturing is developing rapidly, in order to further improve the quality of camera imaging, this paper analyzed and simulated the actual signal processing circuit of a camera. Based on the theory of Signal Integrity, taking advantage of a software named Cadence, Analyzed a high speed with low noise signal processing circuit. Give design advice to the camera circuit, to improve the level of high-resolution camera design.

articleTitle: A Noval Mirror Training Strategy Based On Kinematics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of limb motor dysfunction in stroke patients after operation, a noval mirror training strategy based on kinematics is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the pose of the end effector based on the common coordinate system is obtained by establishing forward kinematic modeling of dual-arm upper limb rehabilitation robot; Secondly, the pose of the end effector of patient's impaired limb in the common coordinate system is calculated by the mirror relationship of the bilateral limbs, and the joint angles is obtained according to the inverse kinematics, which realizing the function of the mirror training. Finally, the experiment is designed and the tester's training data is collected and a series of evaluation indicators are obtained to reflect the training effect in different traininig stages. The results show that this strategy has a certain effect on improving the motor function of the impaired limb. In the future, the factors affecting the strategy will be further optimized to improve the rehabilitation effect.

articleTitle: Simulated website login to improve network data crawling efficiency
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for content from news websites, Web crawler technology has been widely used in the automatic crawling of news website data. However, data crawling behavior is often found and blocked by websites, resulting in inefficient crawling. This paper analyzes the structure of news websites, designs and implements a highly efficient simulated login model for crawling, which avoid the human authorized step during the log-in process. The code testing shows that this simulated login method effectively improves the efficiency and data integrity of the crawler.

articleTitle: Research on a Multi-pulse Diode Rectification in Space Nuclear Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: considering high voltage and high frequency of space nuclear power, the 12- pulse diode rectifier is proposed. In the topology, the three-phase three-winding isolation transformer can generate balanced sets of three-phase voltages with 30° phase shift, which produces 12 pulses in the rectification. The three-tap interphase reactor can improve the power quality of the grid side. Matlab simulink is used to simulate the proposed topology, and the simulation results are analyzed. The simulation results demonstrated that the the design of the proposed rectifier is able to complete high quality rectification.

articleTitle: Research on Damping of Low Frequency Oscillation with Distributed Power Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: During the operation of AC/DC interconnected power grids, small signal instability of low frequency oscillation between regions is prone to occur. In this paper, distributed power flow controller is applied to improve the small signal stability of the power system. In order to ensure the distributed power flow controller to control the flow of the target line in the small signal stability range, a method for determining target parameters of distributed power flow controller is presented. This method combines power flow calculation model with active power optimal dispatch and small signal calculation. And an integrated scheduling equation with small signal stability constraints will be formed. Solve this equation to get the control target parameters of distributed power flow controller. Meanwhile, the PSASP is used to simulate and verify CEPRI7V7 system with the distributed power flow controller. The results show that the proposed method can improve the stability of small signal in the system.

articleTitle: Research on Standard Influence Model Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Standard impact is a qualitative measure of the relationship between standards adopted by standardization agencies. This paper uses GB standardized database metrics, by referring to the five elements of Chen Yunpeng's article, the radial basis neural network is established to study the impact index of each standardization institution on GB. The results show that IEC, NF, DIN and BS have a greater value of influence index on GB than other organizations. The equivalent adoption of IEC and its domain coverage quantity are far greater than other standardization agencies. The conversion time and average effective adoption time of NF are much higher than other standardization organizations, it indicates that different international standardization organizations have great differences in the influence on GB, GB needs to learn from other institutions in different dimensions to improve itself.

articleTitle: Dynamic acquisition system of RFID tags’ performance based on photoelectric sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a dynamic image acquisition system is designed to test the performance of RFID system. The RFID dynamic image acquisition system consists of inbound and outbound delivery system, application environment reading range detection system, RFID far-field data acquisition and reading performance test system, and gantry bracket.

articleTitle: Improved Wavelet Threshold Denoising and Multi-scale Principal Component Analysis Method with Application to TE Process Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: There is a lot of noise in the actual industrial process data, which will lead to the decline of data quality, and then affect the effect of fault diagnosis. In practical applications, the wavelet threshold method is generally used to remove noise. To overcome the shortcomings of traditional soft and hard threshold methods, an adaptive threshold denoising method based on normal distribution is proposed. In this method, normal distribution test is introduced to adaptively select soft threshold and hard threshold to reduce the noise of wavelet coefficients in each layer. Then the improved wavelet threshold denoising method and multi-scale principal component analysis method are combined to propose a fault diagnosis strategy based on improved multi-scale principal component analysis (IMSPCA). Firstly, the normalized distribution test is used to improve the wavelet threshold denoising. Then the improved wavelet threshold denoising method and multi-scale principal component analysis are combined to establish a comprehensive PCA model for fault diagnosis and improve the reliability of fault diagnosis. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the IMSPCA method are verified by the simulation of TE process.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability of Active Distribution Network with Distributed Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, as distributed photovoltaics gradually enter the distribution network, the distribution network has changed from a passive system to an active system, and the topology and tidal current operation of the traditional distribution network have undergone tremendous changes. The access of distributed photovoltaics has a huge impact on the reliability, power supply capability and operation of the distribution system. This paper summarizes the active distribution network facility outage model and distributed photovoltaics output model with distributed photovoltaics. By analyzing the electricity consumption characteristics of three common types of loads in cities, a distributed photovoltaic matching degree evaluation model is established for distributed photovoltaic systems. The reliability of the active distribution network is analyzed. The results show that the distributed photovoltaic access distribution network can improve the reliability level of the original system. At the same time, with the increase of distributed photovoltaic capacity under low permeability, the average power outage time of the system, the average number of power outages of the system and the average power shortage of the system gradually decrease, the system reliability is gradually improved.

articleTitle: The Application of IsatData Pro Service in Data Communication of Oceanic Buoys
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The IsatData Pro service provide bidirectional messaging services between the terminal and the IsatData Pro Gateway via Inmarsat satellite services. The working frequency of it is in L band, which provides a good ability to resist rain and snow attenuation. Even in bad weather, it can ensure reliable communication. Compared with the traditional M2M communication service, The IsatData Pro provides a larger capacity and faster data communication capability and it provides two modes of communication: terminal-to-network communication and terminal-to-terminal communication. The IDP terminals are satellite terminals that use the IsatData Pro service. There are several terminals available for selection, among which IDP690 is suitable for buoy system because of its small size, light weight and low power consumption. A marine buoy is designed by using IDP690 as communication unit. The test data show that the data transmission of the buoy is stable and the delay is small, which can meet the data transmission requirements of the buoy.

articleTitle: Revisiting the Reed-Muller Locally Correctable Codes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Local codes are a special kind of error-correcting codes. Locally correctable codes (LCCs) are one type of local codes. LCCs can efficiently recover any coordinate of its corrupted encoding by probing only a few but not all fraction of the corrupted word. A q-ary LCC which encodes length k messages to length N codewords with relative distance Δ has three parameters: r, δ and ϵ. r is called query complexity recording the number of queries. δ is called tolerance fraction measuring the relative distance between encoding codewords and its corrupted codes which can be locally decoded. ϵ is called error probability showing the coordinate of its corrupted encoding fail to be recovered with probability at most ϵ. One fundamental problem in LCCs is to determine the trade-off among rate, distance and query complexity. But for a specific LCC, focus is on query complexity, tolerance fraction and error probability. Reed-Muller codes (RM codes) are the most presentative LCCs. In order to understand the "local" more clearly, we revisit local correctors for RM codes and analyze them in detail: 1)The decoding procedures; 2)The role of Reed-Solomon codes (RS codes) in decoding RM LCCs; 3)Other local correctors for RM codes. How parameters including r, δ and ϵ change in RM LCCs have been analyzed in different correctors. We believe this paper can help us understand local codes better and grasp the main soul of this research direction.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-port Converter for DC Residential Micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of residential micro-grid, according to the characteristics of DC micro-grid, a multi-port DC/ DC converter and its control strategy are proposed for DC residential micro-grid. This converter is realized by multiplexing the switches of bidirectional Buck/Boost circuit and two bridge arm switches of the phase-shifted full-bridge converter. The secondary side is connected with synchronous Buck converter to form two output ports of high and low voltage. Compared with other multi-port converters, the multi-port DC/ DC converter takes advantages of small size, simple structure, and high power density. Moreover, it can be applied in the DC residential micro-grid environment to realize the functions of "plug and play" of ports, bidirectional flow of energy between ports, electrical isolation and multi-voltage level output. Finally, the circuit model is built by Matlab/Simunlink simulation software to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Design and Application Development of the Camps Navigation System Based on ArcGIS Runtime SDK for Android : ——Taking the Yunnan Normal University as an example
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of Internet communication technology and the widespread popularity of smart-phone, the market for mobile navigation systems has been matured. It is categorized and analyzed by the mobile navigation system appearing in the current mobile navigation market, we found that there are inaccuracies and missing navigation data in the campus area. For this issue, the article uses ArcGIS Runtime and Android as the development platform. to develop campus navigation application software. The campus navigation map is produced by high-resolution remote sensing images, and it has high data space resolution, which effectively improves the data quality. This data uses ArcGIS Online for data cloud storage and management, achieved the interactive updates between data and users and solve the problem of complicated navigation data upgrade. Based on high-precision map data, the software design to achieve campus positioning, walking navigation, driving navigation, and point of interest searching. The mobile navigation system can realize high-precision navigation services in the campus area, so as to achieve better mapping resources for users, and facilitate the travel and life of visitors and college teachers and students on campus.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetic Coupling Mechanism of Wireless Power Supply System with Flat Pickup
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low transmission efficiency and high cost of wireless power supply system with the flat pickup, this paper simulates and analyses the setting methods of the ferrites. An improved flat pickup is proposed to increase system output power by 10% to 20% with little added cost. The effect of the height of the pickup on the coupling coefficient is simulated and analyzed. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle vision-aid landing with Dynamic vision sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Compared with the conventional frame-based image sensor, Dynamic Visual Sensor (DVS) only sensitive to the intensity changes in the scene, and then serially send out these changes in the form of Activity Event (AE). Taking advantage of real-time, low redundancy and small data volume of DVS, we exploit a novel method for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) vision-aid landing. In our method, discrete AEs within a varying period are accumulated to form an event map at first. Then the template matching technology is employed to locate the landing mark. Based on the recognized landing mark, local optical flow estimation and real speed projection are conducted to provide more aux information for accurate landing. In the experiments, a simulation platform is setup verify the effectiveness of our methods under various external environments. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can accurately measure the location and relative speed of landing marks.

articleTitle: A batch data based PSO identification method for Hammerstein systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For a single input-output Hammerstein model with a polynomial nonlinear part, the standard particle swarm optimization (PSO) method loses some accuracy, due to computing fitness only based on a set of input-output data in each iteration. Therefore, to promote the identification accuracy, this paper investigates a batch data based particle swarm optimization (BD-PSO) method to identify parameters of the system. The simulation results prove that the BDPSO method has a fast convergence speed and has a good estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Taxi Management System Based on Nios II
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to manage taxi operation more efficiently, a taxi management system based on NIOS II is proposed.The system includes a vehicle terminal with Nios II processor embedded in the FPGA, a background data management system of taxi management system and a mobile phone operator. The vehicle terminal receives navigation messages with low-power UM220-III Beidou/GPS dual-mode positioning module, completes the information processing of navigation messages by using the designated interrupt processing function of NIOS II, sends AT instructions to SIM900A module through serial port, and transmits vehicle location information and some necessary information to the network server using UDP protocol. The network server aggregates the taxi information of the whole city to form the available information. Managers operate background data management system to send dispatching information of taxis. The mobile operator receives dispatching information, and the taxi driver carries out the operation according to the dispatching information.

articleTitle: Research on Photography Measurement System used in Thermal Vacuum Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the fast development of photographic measurement and image processing technology, photography measurement system has become widely used in industry measurement area. But its measurement accuracy can be greatly affected by ambient temperature, pressure, vibration and other conditions. Traditional photography measurement system is not suitable for thermal vacuum environment. In this paper, a special photography measurement system is designed for small parts dual dimensions size measurement in thermal vacuum environment. The hardware of this system is composed of highresolution CCD camera, telecentric lens, LED lights, temperature controller, isolation platform and computer. Measurement software is developed combined image processing algorithm including image enhancing, image segmentation, edge detection, exposure compensation and so on. Measurement test is done in vacuum tank and measurement results show that this system can be applied in thermal vacuum environment with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Grid-connected Control Device for Distributed Photovoltaic Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Distributed photovoltaic grid connection has impaired the power quality of the distribution network. Aiming at this salient problem, a regulation method for the voltage at the point of interconnection in the distribution network is proposed. Besides, the basic principles of voltage regulation device are introduced, and the computing method for the capacity energy storage battery configuration, matched with the power generation capacity, is given. The simulation model based on the full-control device is built in the PSCAD environment, which verified the accuracy of the control strategy and the favorable dynamic adjusting performance. Finally, by the prototype developed, the effectiveness of the new regulation method for the voltage at the point of interconnection in the distribution network is proved.

articleTitle: Intelligent Diagnosis Model Based on Optimized Probabilistic Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Existing intelligent fault diagnosis models for equipment are insufficient in time-consuming and complication, making it hard to apply to practice. A novel intelligent diagnosis model has been carried out in this paper to improve this issue. Firstly, the process that experts realize the reasoning diagnosis by experience is analyzed to design an intelligent analysis flow. Based on the probabilistic neural network, the fault knowledge learning and reasoning from a large number of samples are carried out. Then the fault knowledge is mapped into a high-dimensional spatial distribution to realize the optimization of the probabilistic neural network. Finally, the fault bearing data is used to verify model performance.

articleTitle: An Optimal Procedure of Gun Weapon System Alignment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For any shipboard gun weapon system to be effective, it must have high accuracy. The way of maintaining the system accuracy is to properly align elements of the system, such as tracking radar and gun. The traditional procedure of alignment is fully completed and detailed, however, it will require a long time and serious conditions. In this paper, we prove the practicability of regarding tracking radar as a reference in the alignment, meanwhile, we put forward a method of verifying the variations of train and elevation fast, and develop a novel procedure of alignment. Experiments have already supported our method.

articleTitle: A Configuration-Based Method For Conversion Between Binary Structure Data And JSON
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Binary structure data is a common data format widely used in network packets and other fields with high performance requirements. Binary data is usually generated by C/C++ programs and consists of pure data without field indicating and description. In the meanwhile, JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) is a human-readable data format. JSON is language-independent and widely used for data interaction. We proposed a method based on configuration for mutual conversion between the binary data and JSON.

articleTitle: A Design of Nuclear Power Monitoring Communication Control Module Based on Redundancy Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: By using large number of analog devices formonitoring in nuclear radiation area ,the scale of central control system is too large and the circuit has safety hazards. To solve the shortcomings, a nuclear power monitoring communication control module based on redundancy technology was developed. The module performs the communication between the central control system and field monitoring units through a preset protocol. The data and instructions can be transmitted by only one data bus. And improves the complicated connection between the central control system and the underlying device. The stability and continuity of data transmission is ensured by the redundancy techniques and polling mode for the underlying devices on the bus. The simulation of the failure situation of the board during actual operation is carried out and the results verify the effectiveness of the communication control module based on redundancy technology developed in this paper.

articleTitle: New Vehicle Auxiliary Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the problems during long-distance fatigue driving, the resolution method is aids drive system. The scheme recognizes the lane by vision and enables the vehicle to automatic cruise for a long time after starting the aids drive system. In addition, according to the video, moving objects are detected by analysing the video. Consequently, the system could identify the building, pedestrian, vehicle and other obstacles accurately. Finally, millimeter wave radar measure the distance of obstacles in surrounding environment and enable the car avoid the obstacles timely.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Question Answering System Based on Medical Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, smart medical systems play an increasingly important role. The traditional medical question answering system can only answer the preset questions. This paper introduces a model of intelligent question answering system based on knowledge graph. It analyzes how to construct a knowledge graph using the neo4j graph database, and uses convolutional neural network to semantically parse user questions. To a certain extent, the system has improved the understanding of user questions and can give better answers.

articleTitle: Study on Self-balancing Control of Express Distribution based on Cluster Dynamic Matching
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: On some takeaway platforms, there are often delivery delays or some orders without delivery workers. In this paper, a self-balancing control model of express distribution is proposed to achieve high fulfillment rate. This model mainly designs the cluster dynamic matching scheme and incentive pricing algorithm, and adopts the feedback regulation mechanism of the number of delivery workers. When the number of delivery workers in a cluster area is relatively insufficient, the model starts incentive pricing algorithm and cluster dynamic matching scheme to increase the number of delivery workers until the relative balance between the number of delivery workers and the number of orders. On the contrary, the number of delivery workers will gradually reduce to a balanced state. The simulation result shows that this model can effectively improve order completion rate.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Transform in Automatic Batching of Cement Raw Meal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to reduce the large hysteresis effect of raw meal preparation in domestic cement plants, the near-infrared online analyzer is used together with the expert system to gradually replace the off-line laboratory testing, which greatly reduces the time-consuming detection of raw meal components and improves production efficiency. However, the production environment of the cement plant is noisy and the interference is serious, which is not conducive to the on-line testing. In this paper, the optimal wavelet function was selected through experimental verification, and the hard threshold method based on Rigrsure rule was used to de-noise the near-infrared spectrum of cement raw materials. After de-noising, the signal-to-noise ratio was the maximum, the root-mean square error was the minimum, and the de-noising effect was good, which provided a theoretical basis for fast online acquisition of the composition information of cement raw meal.

articleTitle: A novel low-noise open-loop sample and hold using the chopper technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A novel sample-and-hold circuit structure, suitable for high-speed analog-to-digital converters (ADCs), is proposed in this paper. By applying a chopper structure to the proposed sample-and-hold circuit, the value of nonlinearity is decreased in the frequency range of [0-30 MHz]. Therefore, the sample-and- hold circuits with the chopper structure can achieve optimal sampling frequency and accuracy. Finally, the simulation results demonstrated that the proposed sample-and-hold circuit with fully differential double sampling is an effective tool for improving sampling accuracy and frequency.

articleTitle: Correctness Evaluation of Handwritten Chinese Characters Based on Relaxation Matching
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To realize intelligent teaching of Chinese characters handwriting, an ex-post evaluation technique about the correctness of handwritten Chinese characters is proposed. The basic idea contains two steps: firstly, the font matching is performed between the handwritten characters and template characters; then, feedback on the writing errors in the handwritten characters is given according to the matching results. Regarding the aspect of font matching, the relaxation matching algorithm is adopted and improved in this paper, which can obtain an accurate font correspondence at the level of stroke segment. Regarding the aspect of error feedback, we integrate the local errors accumulated in the handwritten characters, and present an appropriate feedback scale. Experiments indicate that this technique has excellent stability and wide applicability.

articleTitle: Data Processing of Roundness Error Measurement Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Roundness is an important parameter in evaluating the shape and position error of workpiece. Roundness error evaluation includes least square method, minimum circumscribed circle method, maximum circumscribed circle method and minimum area method. The realization of measurement data processing by various methods is complex and has different accuracy. In this paper, various roundness error evaluation methods are analyzed. The GUI software of graphical user interface is established and its evaluation process is realized by using the software of Matlab. The data processing program of MATLAB has the advantages of simple and reliable program, short processing time and greatly improved calculation accuracy. The simulation image can be obtained and the speed of data processing is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research on gesture recognition control of UAV based on CNN+FCN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are the focus of development and Cultivation in China, especially in artificial intelligence. Current UAV control mainly carries out related flight tasks through a certain professional training of pilots'hand-held remote controllers, which is undoubtedly not conducive to the popularity of UAVs. In recent years, the rapid development of artificial intelligence, especially in image recognition, has achieved good results. In many practical applications, its identification ability surpasses human beings and brings opportunities to the development of all walks of life. In order to popularize UAV better, this paper studies the introduction of gesture recognition control in UAV, and puts forward a scheme of camera mounted in UAV and human gesture shooting and recognition, which simplifies the cumbersome control of UAV.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Estimation of JOM-4 Overhauser Magnetometer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Overhauser proton magnetometer is a scalar magnetometer measuring the total magnetic field based on dynamic nuclear polarization (DNP) effect. As a critical specification, sensitivity indicates the relative uncertainty of the instrument's repeated measurements on a stable magnetic field. The appropriate sensitivity estimation method can make the sensitivity estimate more accurate. In this paper, the principle of operation is described, the structure of the Overhauser magnetometer is illustrated, and the measurement process is discussed in detail. The experimental results of the RF output and envelope show the quality of the signal. In addition, combined with the synchronization method, the fourth-order difference algorithm is proposed for sensitivity estimation. By calculating the standard deviation of the difference between the two synchronized instruments, the synchronization method can eliminate the environmental interferences and diurnal variation. Moreover, instrument drift is also effectively suppressed due to the high-pass characteristics of the fourth-order difference function. Finally, the experiments are implemented in low EMI environment, and the sensitivity is estimated by utilizing the fourth-order difference algorithm. Experimental results show that the estimation method proposed here suppresses interferences effectively, and the sensitivity estimate is 0.0186 nT@5 s.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Power Inductor Automatic Test System
