publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a key part of the circuit, the dynamic characteristics of power devices directly affect the performance and life of the equipment. Studying the dynamic characteristics of power devices is an important prerequisite for designing high-power circuits. In this paper, the physical characteristics of the power inductors of a high-power boost circuit are analyzed in detail, which provides a theoretical basis for determining the test content and finding the test method. The test circuit is analyzed in detail, and the saturated current and inductance value of power inductors are tested, which makes up for the shortcomings of the existing inductor testing instruments that can't measure saturated current.

articleTitle: Synchronization of Driving Motors of High-Speed Maglev Railway Turnout
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper concerns the synchronization of driving points of high-speed maglev railway turnout to protect turnout from stress concentration when switching line. A moving trajectory model of driving points is built according the principle of elasticity and the relation between turnout curvature and driving motor dynamics is described considering engineering status. To enhance synchronization performance, this paper proposes a novel error compensator which considers previous synchronization errors through a forget factor, then the control scheme is established. Finally, simulation demonstrates that the proposed compensator decreases the synchronization error by 98%.

articleTitle: Design of PLC-based 3D Carving Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the advancement at industrial automation, the triaxial linked system has been widely applied at various industrial fields. The paper introduces a kind of carving system which is based on three-phase asynchronous motor and servomotor. PLC could make a general treatment to the signal from the internal timers for each shaft, the ON/OFF signal and the input signal of the sensors. The program in the PLC may generate certain time series to drive the system at regular operation and that each part works at the set logic sequence for the final goal to make the system function accurate carving. Meanwhile, the system could be immune to the unexpected interference, including that from the dust, and then operate at a stable and safe way.

articleTitle: Research on Definition of Digital Mockup and Application of Zoning Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the definition of satellite digital Mockup was given, and the digital Mockup was classified according to three dimensions, and the method of constructing the digital Mockup in the order of overall to detail, from high to low, from outside to inside was given. The design of satellite digital Mockup was a gradual refinement process. In order to accurately describe the state of each stage of satellite digital Mockup, the concept of maturity was introduced, and the order and rules of model evolution were given according to the maturity of digital Mockup. The application scope of the digital Mockup was given, and the emphasis was laid on the partition optimization design. Through the study of definition of digital mockup and application of zoning optimization, to adopt digital technology in satellite development can improve the level of satellite development.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of The Car Damper under Road Spectrum Based on Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To investigate the reliability of the car damper more accurately, a test car of Chinese independent brand was employed to collect signals under different roads in the road test field, the random vibration theory and spectral theory were applied to eliminate the anomalous points, trend items and test the stability of the collected road spectrum. After the bench test device was equipped with the damper, the hydraulic cylinder was driven to control error in a specific range between the response signal of the spring and the road signal, the excitation signal was determined finally. The random load of the damper seat under the corresponding road spectrum was calculated according to the processed random signal, and theoretical analysis has been conducted through the stress-strength interference model. The Monte Carlo method was applied to verify the numerical simulation, indicating when the load times of the road spectrum were the life index, the reliability of the damper seat on two types of general roads was similar and was higher than that on the Belgian road. The reliability of the damper seat was also calculated under two whole road spectrum (about 60,000 kilometers of the road test site), and the bench test has been used to verify the reliability of the damper seat.

articleTitle: Pelvic Trajectory Analysis for Lower Limbs Rehabilitation Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Pelvic motion parameters during a gait cycle are important features for gait disorders. The six degree of freedom of pelvic is an important factor to keep balance during a gait cycle. In this paper, we propose a new method to generate a personalized pelvic motion during a gait cycle based on Support Vector Regression (SVR) algorithm. The real-time pelvic displacements can be obtained upon the prototype of lower limbs rehabilitation robot mentioned in this paper. Through the SVR algorithm, we confirm the parameter of training model and generate a pelvic trajectory fitting the data set. We also define a confidence interval around the curve which supposes to be tolerance zone in the coming rehabilitation process or a new subject. Then we use a cross validation method to verify the generalization performance of the curve. The experimental results extracted from our low limb rehabilitation robot demonstrate that the curve generated by us is close to the ablebodied natural pelvis motion. In the end, we discuss the method and consider the future work of our research.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Continuing Education Teaching Resource Database Based on IPv6
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the promotion of educational information construction and the rapid development of the Internet, more and more resources are flooding the campus database. The disorder of structure and management difficulties have become a difficult problem for colleges and universities. The teaching resource management platform is to manage the teaching resources of colleges and universities. A good platform, but the existing teaching resources and resource management platforms are mostly in the IPv4 network environment. This paper analyzes the existing teaching resources of the Continuing Education Institute, studies and designs a well-structured teaching resource library, and develops a teaching resource management platform for students. The platform is based on the IPv6 network environment, strictly controls resource quality, improves resource transmission rate, and provides reference for other management platforms based on IPv6 network environment.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Calibration Scheme for Reactor Circulating Loop Coolant Flow Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Affection of static pressure may cause some error when differential pressure transmitter be used. Based on the reactor coolant flow rate measurement arithmetic do not calculates affection of static pressure, analysis is performed on the TP1RCP59 procedure in the reactor coolant flow rate measurement, during the commissioning of Unit 1 of Fuqing Nuclear Power Plant. Together with site tests and test verification. It has been found that the calibration arithmetic of TP1RCP59 is right, but not perfect. Once the Sensor should be replaced ,better arithmetic is provided by this article. Meanwhile the differential pressure used to calculate the reactor coolant flow rate is not exact, which should be ameliorated.

articleTitle: Application of an Adaptive Direct Current Offset Elimination Algorithm Based on FPGA in Orthogonal Demodulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the coherent demodulation of the FM signal, an uncertain frequency deviation exists between the demodulated carrier and the modulated carrier, which will generate a direct-current (DC) offset in the demodulation signal and directly affect the performance of the system. An adaptive interference cancellation method based on least mean square (LMS) is proposed to eliminate the DC offset in this paper. Compared with the method of filtering the DC offset by using a high-pass filter, the LMS algorithm has low latency and low implementation cost. The method is implemented and verified on the field-programmable-gate-array (FPGA) platform by hardware description language. Simulation results show that the LMS algorithm can eliminate the DC offset from the demodulated signal within 1.5ms.

articleTitle: Electronic Image Stabilization based on Laplacian Bit Plane and Matching Block Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, an electronic image stabilization method based on Laplacian bit plane and matching block classification is proposed. The method uses Laplacian to extract the edge information of the image to construct bit plane. Weight is used to measure the feasibility of the vector becoming local motion vector and global motion vector. The matching result of each matching block and the global motion vector of the previous frames are combined to obtain the global motion of the current frame, which is used to compensate for frame motion to obtain a stable image. Finally, it is proved by experiment that the algorithm proposed in this paper requires a small amount of calculation and can eliminate the interference of small objects in the field of view. For CIF images, the algorithm can achieve real-time image processing, removing and reducing the jitter of the image. Compared with traditional bit plane matching electronic image stabilization methods, this algorithm lays stress on the full utilization of gray information and the adaptability of the algorithm when there is a small foreground object in the field of view.

articleTitle: Logistics Vehicle Scheduling Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the logistics data collected by the logistics cloud platform, the logistics vehicle scheduling problem is modeled and solved by genetic algorithm. The better optimization results are obtained, which minimizes the transportation cost of the vehicle and completes the delivery of goods under the required time and rated load. Compared with the current logistics distribution system based on manual scheduling, it has certain practicability.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Analysis and Suppression Methods in Electrowinning Copper Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a double reverse star rectifying device with an annual output of 20,000 tons of electrolytic copper in a copper plant is taken as the research object. Firstly, the working principle of the double reverse star thyristor rectifying device is analyzed, and the theoretical analysis of its rectifying circuit is obtained. High harmonics present and verified by simulation experiments. Then, for the corresponding harmonics, a harmonic suppression system constructed by the principle of induction filtering is proposed. For the rectifier transformer, in order to achieve the zero impedance of the winding, the harmonic flux of the secondary winding and the filter winding must be equivalent to zero in the design process, thereby providing a flow channel for the harmonics. Finally, according to the overall structure of the system, the mathematical model of the power induction filter rectifier transformer is established, and the filtering effect is designed according to the derived harmonic flow path. In order to better achieve the filtering effect, the DC output current is controlled by the PI controller to achieving a constant value. By constructing a simulation model, the analysis results show that the system can suppress harmonics well.

articleTitle: Power Line Carrier Communication Based on Wireless Charging System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the wireless power transmission system, monitoring the charging status of the charging device online is very important. This paper designs a power carrier system that can be used to monitor the charging status of the wireless power transmission system in real time. The power carrier is realized by QPSK quaternary phase shift keying in digital modulation method, and the magnetic coupling resonant wireless power transmission is realized by fuzzy PID control. The MATLAB simulation proves that the system can monitor the state of charge in real time, and the power line carrier can be used for wireless power transmission systems.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Stabilization for Sampled-data Systems Based on Adaptive Deadband-triggered Communication Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper introduced an adaptive deadband-triggered communication scheme for sampled-data systems. In the sampled-data systems, the transmitting data was followed to deadband-triggered communication scheme, and the deadband’s threshold can adaptively adjust. In this consideration, the model for sampled-data systems was presented. By using the Lyapunov functional approach, sufficient stability analysis and stabilization criteria for the sampled-data systems were obtained in terms of linear matrix inequality.

articleTitle: A Star Map Recognition Algorithm based on Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To facilitate the online application of the star sensor, a fast star map recognition method based on pattern recognition is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the searching range of navigation stars is determined by searching observation stars in the designated celestial area. Then, the transformation matrix from the celestial coordinate system to the image coordinate system is used to calculate the coordinates of stars on the twodimensional imaging plane. On this basis, the simulated star map is generated by computer simulation. Then the grid algorithm is used to extract the pattern features of the star map, and the feature database of the navigation star is constructed. Finally, the star map recognition is realized by matching the features of the observed star map with the feature database of the navigation star. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has strong robustness, small storage space, and fast calculation speed.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of the failure of commutation on the phase selection of the current mutation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of power supply, automatic coincidence technology is widely used in high voltage transmission lines. In the distance protection, in order to make the measuring element accurately reflect the fault distance, it is necessary to find out the fault loop and distinguish the fault phase. Therefore, the phase selection element is indispensable in the distance protection logic, among which the phase selection element based on the current mutation has been widely used in the distance protection. This paper first introduces the principle of phase selection of current mutants and then reveals the mechanism of the effect of the failure of commutation on the element of current mutants. The analysis shows that the strength of AC system will affect the phase selection performance of the current phase selector during the failure of commutation. Finally, a solution based on voltage phase selection is proposed, and the simulation results show that the new phase selection method is more suitable for AC/DC hybrid system, and can achieve the purpose of phase selection correctly.

articleTitle: Design of Command Effectiveness Evaluation Software for Overseas Anti-terrorism Operation Command System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the complexity of overseas anti-terrorism operations, the effectiveness of its command system is evaluated by the method of constructing evaluation system software. The evaluation system software can be divided into five levels: infrastructure layer, resource layer, support layer, application layer and standard specification layer. The functions consist of five subsystems: data collection and information, static evaluation, dynamic evaluation, expert evaluation and interaction, and comprehensive processing and visualization. The specific evaluation methods include N-ADC static evaluation method and GERT network dynamic simulation method. Finally, the main page composition and evaluation process of the evaluation system software is described.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Vibration Masking System against Acoustic Signal Restoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The non-contact measurement that can restore the speech information by recording the voice-induced vibration on the surface of the objects is one method of signal restoring. And vibration masking is an effective way against signal restoring by non-contact measurement. Aiming at vibration masking system against acoustic signal restoring, in this paper, we analyze the vibration characteristics on surface of glass, then a vibration propagation decay model on surface of square glass is proposed. The relationship between the vibration intensity caused by speech and the intensity of the sound source is measured. Also, the relationship between vibration intensity produced by vibration converter and the sound pressure emitted from vibration converter is tested. The results show that the masking effect performs well when the vibration generated by the vibration converter is 15dB higher than the vibration caused by the speech.

articleTitle: Mechanism of Career Construction Facing The Human-Machine Interaction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The accelerating digitization and automation of work in the 4th industrial revolution will have an enormous impact on business management and individuals’ career experiences. A framework is proposed to demonstrate the Employees' career construction based their interaction with smart machine to improve career adaptability. Empirical results suggest that the efficiency, usability and sensibility of the interaction between human and machine will improve the career perception, and visceral design of interaction can significantly enhance employee's capability construction in their career journey.

articleTitle: Superheater and Reheater Desuperheating Water Control with Partial Smith Predictive Correction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The desuperheating water control is critical to steam temperature regulation for most coal-fired units in response to rapid peak shaving and frequency modulation. The classic cascade control performance is difficult to meet the requirements of its large inertia and large delay. The practical application of algorithms such as model predictive control and neural network control is also greatly limited due to its nonlinearity, measurement uncertainty and time-varying characteristics. The system is modeled in two parts, where the main inertia and delay subsystems are easier to obtain accurate models. Then a partial Smith predictive correction method was proposed to be combined with classic cascade PID controller. The applications in a 600 MW supercritical boiler and a 1000 MW ultra-supercritical boiler had demonstrated a more stable and efficient performance than the classic cascade control, and it is simple and much easy to use.

articleTitle: Weak Fault Feature Extraction Method for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles based on Wavelet Packets and FFT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To address the problem that the traditional fault feature extraction method cannot be applied to the field of weak fault detection of autonomous underwater vehicles, a multidimensional feature extraction method based on wavelet packets and the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is presented. The method in this paper first reduces noise in the controller and sensor data based on the wavelet packets. Then, the empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and FFT methods are used to extract the energy features and the improved frequency domain feature of the noise-reduced data, respectively. The experimental results show that this method provide identification accuracies that are reliable and high, and it is suitable for the identification of weak faults for autonomous underwater vehicles.

articleTitle: End-to-end Physical Layer Optimization Scheme Based on Deep Learning Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: 5G large-scale commercial enterprises will provide high-speed and low-latency communication services, but it also challenges optimization of system. In particular, the conventional block-by-block design communication model has less interpretability and increases the complexity of physical layer optimization. Fortunately, deep learning has an inherent advantage in structured information representation and data extraction. Therefore, in this paper, based on deep learning autoencoder scheme is proposed to perform end-to-end physical layer optimization. Firstly, a two-stage training mode is proposed to improve the generalization of the neural network. Secondly, in order to decrease the system overhead caused by channel state information (CSI) feedback, utilizing autoencoder to reconstruct CSI by its compression feature. The simulation results show that the phased training can effectively improve the convergence rate, the compression and quantization of CSI alleviates the system loads.

articleTitle: An Improved UKFNN Based on Iterative Renewal for Intelligent Modeling of Aluminum Electrolysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Establishing an intelligent production model for aluminum electrolysis has always been a technical problem due to the existence of more parameters and multiple chemical and physical reactions in the manufacturing system of aluminum electrolysis. An iterative renewal approach tagged with Iterated Unscented Kalman Neural Networks (IUKFNN) is developed to approximate the intelligent modelling of direct current consumption from the electrolytic aluminum industry in this study. In the propose model, iterative idea and UKFNN are integrated. And the new idea of iterative updating is adopted to improve estimator precision of the model. To be more precise, after estimated states are obtained in the UKFNN algorithm, the estimated value is returned to the measurement updating to re-sample, so that the estimated value is more accurate. The experimental results indicate that the model can significantly predict the direct current consumption in the manufacturing system of aluminum electrolysis, and the precision of the model IUKFNN is higher than UKFNN. Consequently, this paper presents a better intelligent modeling method for further approaching the real energy consumption model in electrolytic aluminum manufacturing process.

articleTitle: The Fatigue Strength Analysis of Knuckle Arm based on the Cosine Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The knuckle arm lever of cylindrical surface is easy to break in actual application. The non-uniform load structured by cosine load types and APDL are applied. The finite element calculating model of knuckle arm is established by using ANSYS in this paper, the finite element simulating is proceeded, and the truth break factor is founded. Through the structure optimization design of the knuckle arm, and the fatigue strength analysis of the improved structure, the information can predict the fatigue life. The above works can be the means for providing essential theoretic gist for further improving the structure design.

articleTitle: Design of Time Attendance System in Coal Preparation Plant Based on Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper puts forward the attendance system based on face recognition on the problems existing in the current coal preparation plant personnel attendance. Due to the special working environment of the coal preparation plant, this paper first preprocesses the image, including image filtering and image enhancement, to facilitate post-face recognition.

articleTitle: Non-specific Facial Expression Recognition Based on Tensor and Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a non-specific facial expression recognition algorithm. Firstly, according to the hypothesis that "similar people have similar expressions" [1], the tensor singular value decomposition is used to find the facial expression image most similar to the non-specific face for similarity calculation, thereby updating the non-specific facial expression image. Then the updated facial expression image is input into a six-layer convolution neural network and the recognition result is obtained. The experiment was tested on the Japanese female expression database to obtain a good recognition rate. The results show that the algorithm is effective in nonspecific facial expression recognition.

articleTitle: Study on Influence on Sensitive of Thermosensitive Element to Open Jet Angular Velocity Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The mechanism of the influence of the setting of the thermal sensor on the sensitivity of the open jet angular velocity sensor is explained. Using the fluid-solid coupling method, the distribution of gas velocity at different input angular velocities at the thermosensitive element in the sensor is calculated. The calculation results show that when the angular velocity is input around Z axis, the distance d=0.6mm between the thermistor wires can reduce the influence of eddy current in the jet sensitive chamber, increase the temperature change of the thermistor wires, thus increase the output voltage of Wheatstone bridge, and improve the sensitivity of the open jet angular velocity sensor.

Author Keywords: Open jet angular velocit y sensor

articleTitle: Bi-level Planning of Distribution Network Considering DG and ILR under the Open Electricity Market Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The power system reformation has changed the operating mode of the electricity market, and has a profound impact on the planning and operating of power supply companies. New standard of planning is analyzed and the bi-level planning model of distribution network is established considering DG and ILR under the open electricity market environment. The objective of the upper model is to minimize the cost of investment, and to maximize power supply reliability and power quality. While the lower level is to dispatch the DG output and ILR in the operation stage of distribution network optimally. The upper level model is mixed integer nonlinear program , which is solved using genetic algorithm . The lower level model is continuous nonlinear program, which is solved using prime dual interior point method. A modified IEEE-33 bus system is used to testily the proposed model. Analyzing the income of power supply company, the power sales side market competition is considered in the lower level model, adapted to the change of profit pattern..

articleTitle: Diversity-based JADE Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In adaptive DE, the parameter p is used to balance the algorithm exploration and exploitation ability. Selection of suitable p in the evolution process is an ongoing challenge for adaptive DE. Population diversity is an effective measure showing the distribution of individuals in the search space. In this paper, use of diversity as a search strategy selection criterion for calculating p in adaptive DE is proposed. The proposed algorithm normalizes the calculated diversity to [0, 1] and calculates p according to the normalized diversity using an exponential function. Higher diversity yields higher p, providing the proposal with higher exploration ability, and vice versa. The accuracy of the proposed algorithm was experimentally compared to those of five other advanced DE variants using benchmark functions from IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation 2017. The results show that the proposed algorithm achieved the best performance among all variants for most benchmark functions.

articleTitle: Photoemission mechanism of GaN photocathode:a first-principle study
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To explore the photoemission mechanism of GaN photocathode and make clear the role played by the intrinsic gallium oxide at GaN surface, the Ga-O-Cs model was built and the properties of adsorption energies, mulliken charge distribution, work functions and density of states were calculated with the first-principle density functional theory(DFT).By calculating the surface adsorption energies of different models, we know that all the surface adsorption energies are negative, and the models are reasonable. The work function results indicate that although first connection of oxygen atom with gallium atom will lead to much higher value enhancement, while the subsequent deposition of cesium atom will achieve more decrease of work function to achieve NEA status. The calculated work functions are in good coordinate with experimental photocurrent change with different coverage. Meanwhile, the tested electron affinity variations are reasonably explained with the proposed and calculated Ga-O-Cs model. These calculations supply a theoretical evidence of the photoemission mechanism of GaN photocathodes, which would direct the following GaN and AlGaN photocathodes preparation technique.

articleTitle: Digital Design of Radiation-resistant Intelligent Instrument Control System for Nuclear Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The instrument control system is an important part of the nuclear power plant. At present, the instrument control system of the domestic nuclear power plant still adopts analog control in the irradiation area, requiring many hardware resources and cumbersome operation. The radiation resistance design of the system is carried out by using irradiation-resistant chip, radiation-resistant module, radiation-resistant bus and lead shell, and the digitization and intelligence of the instrument control system in the irradiation area are realized.

articleTitle: Search Center System Based on Database Transmission and Web Crawler
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of society, the supply and demand of society are increasing, and the work of individuals is also diversified, complicated and extensive. The workload and types of work of enterprises are increasing, and the number of application tools is increasing. To maximize work efficiency and reduce waste of working hours, search functions can be used to quickly find the required application tools or information. The keyword information will be displayed by retrieving relevant information stored in the database. Firstly, all relevant content is searched according to the user's role permission for display, and the user may display part of the summary content of the searched information to optimize the user experience. The data transmission function can also be realized through the HTTP server, the short message platform in the search center is established, and the information data is sent to other users of the platform.

articleTitle: Restore the Original data by Embedded data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Network is an important representation method to describe related objects. For network, the most core research is to reasonably represent the characteristic information of nodes in the network, which is called network representation learning. In recent years, many scholars have proposed many excellent representation learning algorithms, through which the original network data can be embedded in low-dimensional representation, which can help us classify the nodes in the network, and the nodes can also be used as point coordinates in Euclidean space for visualization. Existing algorithms are all aimed at embedding the original data, but how to use the embedded data to restore the original data when the original data is incomplete has not been studied by scholars. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes two solutions of deep learning, one is the artificial neural network method based on deep learning, and the other is the attention mechanism method based on deep learning. The experimental results of this paper show that these two methods are very effective.

articleTitle: Multipath Interference of Large-scale Obstacles in Civil Aviation Complex Environmental Airports
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the multipath interference of large-scale obstacles around the localizer, and proposes a solution to reduce multipath interference by adjusting the planning design. The multipath interference effects of obstacles in different directions have been studied based on the wireless signal propagation, simulation technique and the antenna theory in this paper. Take an airport for example, the theory derivation and the simulation experiment show that even if the obstacles around the runway meet the requirements of civil aviation standards, if the obstacles are relatively large and the clearance signal is relatively strong, which will affect the DDM value of the center line of the runaway. It is necessary to consider the multipath interference of large obstacles in the civil aviation design stage, and finally provides the basis for the construction of the navigation station.

articleTitle: Optimal Method of Intelligent Vessel Schedule Based on Multiple Population Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Port plays an important role in water transport, since its operation efficiency is associated directly with local economy. Berth allocation is the key for port productivity, which can be improved by a proper vessel schedule. This paper addresses the problem of vessel schedule in discrete port. An optimal method based on Multiple Population Genetic Algorithm (MPGA) is proposed to minimize the total stay time of vessels. In order to improve the operability of optimal method, we develop a kind of mixed-integer chromosome representation for MPGA. Computational experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness of the optimal method. The result shows that, compared with Simple Genetic Algorithm (SGA) and First Come First Served (FCFS), the MPGA method can obtain a better solution in different schedule conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal Path Planning for Construction Region Based on Potential Function
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Rapidly Exploring Random Tree Star (RRT*) obtains the optimal path for high-dimensional complex dynamic environments by randomly sampling nodes. Although RRT* has been proven to have probabilistic completeness and asymptotic optimality, there is still a contradiction between optimal solution and rapidity. Based on the problem, we will introduce an algorithm, Potential Region RRT*. Region is constructed through the necessary information in the space, such as root nodes, the goal node, and various obstacles. The size of the sampling area is limited by the area and unnecessary sampling points are reduced. The reduction of sampling points influence the optimal solution of the path, therefore artificial potential field method is integrated into the algorithm to get a better solution.

articleTitle: Inter-cluster multi-hop routing algorithm for wireless sensor networks based on ISODATA clustering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of uneven clustering and poor energy consumption control of layered routing protocols in wireless sensor networks, an inter-cluster multi-hop hierarchical routing algorithm based on ISODATA clustering (IICMH) is proposed. Firstly, in the stage of network clustering, the ISODATA clustering algorithm is used to select the clustering center, and then the cluster head nodes are selected according to the central position of each cluster, and the election results are broadcasted by the base station. In terms of cluster head election mechanism, the algorithm sets an energy threshold T for comparing with cluster head to evaluate the specific situation of residual energy. When the value of residual energy is higher than that threshold, no new election is needed. On the contrary, it will trigger the next round of new elections, selecting new cluster heads and then update them to the base station in real time. The simulation results show that the algorithm has good performance in balancing network load and prolonging network lifetime.

articleTitle: An Improved Coding Modulated in CO-OFDM system and its Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this study, we first present a coherent optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (CO-OFDM) system We then proposed an efficient improved LDPC coding method to further improve the performance of the system. The results show that a CO-OFDM system use of the different combination of coding and modulation modes has great influence on the transmission capacity, bit error rate, optical signal-to-noise ratio and anti-dispersion ability of the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Class E Push-Pull Power Amplifier for Low Power Wireless Energy Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Power amplifier is suitable for wireless energy transmission because of its high energy conversion efficiency and simple circuit topology, in low power wireless energy transmission. Class E power amplifier output efficiency is highest, combined with the basic class E power amplifier circuit, this paper proposes a class E push-pull power amplifier power transmission circuit, E class push-pull power amplifier equivalent model and the relevant formulae are established. The correctness of the model and related formulae are verified by combining the device parameters in theory and experiment.

articleTitle: Uav in fog identification based on simplified model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The identification of low-altitude and low-speed the unmanned aerial vehicle (Uav) is a popular problem in the field of computer vision. The traditional identification method can solve most problems, but there are blind spots for low-altitude Uav. By contrast, the deep learning can better solve this problem, but the effect of CNN and other methods is poor in the case of fog. In order to solve this problem, we will apply CNN to dehaze the image. At the same time, for the sake of our subsequent recognition model is more accurate, more real-time, we put forward on the basis of the residual model, using the different sizes of convolution kernels, combining the Inception block and MobileNet[1] network. Our proposed model maintain the better identify accurate rate, increasing our recognition speed. Therefore, this paper aims to train multi-scale convolution model, which can effectively identify low-altitude and slow-speed Uav in fog. Experimental results show that this method is feasible.

articleTitle: Fluid-solid Coupling Simulation of Open Jet Angular Velocity Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper describes the fluid-structure coupling simulation technique and calculation of an open jet angular velocity sensor. Using Ansys-CFX software, the fluid-structure coupling simulation was carried out by establishing three-dimensional solid model, meshing, setting coupling surface, loading and solving. The two-way coupling method is used to improve the accuracy of simulation results. This method improves the theoretical research accuracy of the open jet angular velocity sensor.

articleTitle: Influence of High and New Information Technology on Informationization Construction of Military Equipment Maintenance Support
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the field of equipment maintenance support, information technology presents some characteristics. The first is integration of command information system function. The second is intelligent of support equipment and technical means. The third is integration of information technology of military and civilian. To promote the informatization construction of equipment maintenance support, we need to scientifically formulate the development plan for the application of information technology in the field of equipment maintenance support, strengthen the construction of the security capability of the equipment maintenance support information system, and strengthen the risk management of the supply chain of equipment and facilities in the field of equipment maintenance support.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Several Word Clustering Models
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Sparse-data problem is a main issue that influences the performances of statistical language models; statistical language model based on word classes is an effective method to solve sparse-data problems. This paper presents a definition of word similarity by utilizing mutual information of adjoining words, and gives the definition of word set similarity based on word similarity, and puts forward a bottom-up hierarchical word clustering algorithm which can get global optimum. Experimental results show that the word clustering algorithm is of high executing speed and have good clustering performances. We then interpolated the class-based models with the word-based models and found that it mitigates remaining sparse-data problems of statistical language models.

articleTitle: Analysis of Automatic Frequency Tuning for Wireless Power Transfer Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, according to the circuit model of magnetic resonance radio power transmission system, the change of resonance frequency of the system with the coupling coefficient between coils is analyzed. When the coupling coefficient between coils changes, the system resonance frequency can be tracked automatically by the control method of combining Bang-Bang control with fuzzy PID control. This method can automatically adjust the working frequency of the system to the resonance frequency within the working range of the system to ensure the maximum load power of the system. The control method is simulated by MATLAB/Simulink simulation software. The simulation results show that the method can track the resonance frequency of the system quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backstepping Sliding Mode Control for Electro-hydraulic Position Servo System of The Artillery Projectile Transfer Arm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive backstepping sliding mode control method for electro-hydraulic position servo system of the artillery projectile transfer arm with nonlinear characteristics and parameter uncertainties. The adaptive law of uncertain parameters is given by adaptive algorithm and the discontinuous projection is used to ensure that the unknown parameters are bounded. The switching control function is used to ensure that the chattering problem is effectively suppressed. Simulation results show that the adaptive backstepping sliding mode control method tracks the desired trajectory more rapidly and accurately than the PID control method. The performance of the adaptive backstepping sliding mode control method is also verified without the projectile on the arm.

articleTitle: A neural network optimization calculation method based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Taking BP neural network as an example, this paper introduces the concept of optimized genetic computation and expounds the background of network optimized calculation method based on optimized genetic computing method. This paper analyzes neural network optimized calculation design method based on the optimized genetic calculation method. Finally, the operation of neural network based on optimized genetic computation is simulated and verified.

articleTitle: The Dilemma and Outlet of Social Governance from the Perspective of Network Security
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The rapid development of network information technologies such as 5G communication, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing has greatly changed the way people live and interact, and penetrates into every aspect of people's daily life. Cyberspace and real life are becoming more and more integrated, and virtual society is closely intertwined with the real society. The network security has become an important issue that cannot be ignored in the information age which has gradually become an important task in current social governance. Human beings are also facing new challenges when they enjoy the bonus of the Internet era. Based on the basic problems of network security, the paper analyzes network security which brings four challenges to social governance. Finally, four feasibility recommendations were proposed to meet the challenges.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis Of Influence Of Nearby Buildings On The VOR
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The very high frequency omnidirectional radio range(VOR)is an aeronautical radio navigation system which operates in the VHF band of 112-118MHz and can provide the aircraft with its magnetic azimuth relative to the ground station in the range of 360 degrees[1],[2]. With the development of the city and the improvement of the construction, more and more high-rise buildings appear near the VOR, some exceed the standard GB6364-2013" Electromagnetic environment requirements for aeronautical radio navigation stations"[3] and MH/T 4003.1-2014"the regulation of civil aviation communication, navigation and surveillance equipment (stations) siting Part 1: Navigation"[4] requirement, It may affect the normal operation of VOR. On the basis of computer modeling, the influence of the buildings on azimuth error and 9960Hz AM modulation of VOR are simulated and analyzed, then the improvement and optimization suggestion are given.

articleTitle: System-wide Model Analysis Technology of Abnormal Line Loss Based on Dynamic Parameters and Global Variable Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Nowadays line loss has become one of the most important assessment indicators for power grid enterprises and power generation enterprises. Line loss is not only an important indicator linked with economy, but also has a far-reaching impact on the economic operation status of power enterprises. At the same time, abnormal line loss is often positively correlated with the poor operation status of equipment and backward operation mode and so on. In fact, solving an abnormal line loss problem is also a solution to the hidden troubles of primary and secondary equipment and improvement of the operation mode of power grid, which has a far-reaching impact on the stable, safe and stable operation of power grid. In this investigation, the factors affecting line loss are found out through large data analysis. Based on the configuration of primary and secondary equipment, the whole system-wide model of line loss is established by using dynamic parameter method. The equipment or operation mode that causes abnormal line loss analysis is divided into two parts. The rectification scheme is evaluated, and the Lean Management Level of Line Loss is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Light Supplement Control System in Chicken Coop
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The quick progress at the modern agriculture benefits from the subversive advancement at a variety of agricultural technologies. Depending on the modern agricultural technology to promote the production could reduce the consumption in terms of labor, material and finance. It would be the top demand for the agricultural modernization. The design uses the single-chip computer as its master control part to introduce a system to check the lighting and light supplement devices in the chicken coop. The system could regulate the light supplement volume and duration based on the change of the illumination intensity. And the LCD1602 configured functions real time displaying the parameter of illumination intensity in the chicken coop. In Sichuan province China, the summer features long daytime and short night. Thus, the design considers two modes, respectively in winter and summer. The system realizes the software programming on the base of hardware configuration. The program could automatically regulate the illumination intensity of the chicken coop, with certain practicability.

articleTitle: Bilateral strategic decision-making method of renewable energy transaction based on conditional risk value
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the impact of renewable energy interconnection on the traditional electricity market and the different demand for electricity from different capacity users, this paper proposes a conditional risk value (CVaR) based business transaction model. According to the market share, the loss functions of renewable energy generators and thermal power suppliers with different capacities are superimposed to obtain unilateral loss functions. User price data are obtained through large data statistics. On this basis, the possible losses of bilateral electricity transactions under different risk conditions are given, and the optimal trading strategies are sought according to the preferences of users and traders. The results show that Large-capacity users tend to be more confident and less risky.

articleTitle: Red Emitter in Wearable Intelligent Monitoring Shirt
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: the intelligent luminescence emitter in wearable monitoring shirt was prepared in this paper. When the intensity of light was weak, the wearable monitoring shirt could emit special wavelength in the red color. This could help escaping in fire hazard, earthquake and other dangerous condition. In the duck environment, red color could help people in distinguishing each other. Red emitter was important and intelligent in integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of a Micro Omnidirectional Jet Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The mechanism of jet generation and circulation in a micro omnidirectional jet generator is explained in this paper. The flow field in this micro omnidirectional jet generator is calculated by using COMSOL, a multi-physical field simulation software, through three-dimensional modeling, meshing, loading and solving. The results of calculation and analysis show that: (1) Load transfer analysis method can be used to achieve high-precision finite element numerical calculation based on fluid-structure coupling. (2) There are four orthogonal jets in the jet generator, which are complete and have the same flow state. The average velocity of the jets is v=5.52 m/s. The research method in this paper can lay a theoretical foundation for the structure optimization of multi-axis jet inertial sensor and microfluidic chip.

articleTitle: Periodic Test Procedure Improvements in Digital-Control Nuclear Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper illustrates the classification and restriction of periodic test, and gathers statistics about abnormal incident occurred during plant periodic test activities, reaches a conclusion on the impact to the test of human errors. This paper also makes a description of the features of digital control system's functionalities. The analyzing process focuses on the test items that require maintenance workforce to force and simulate test conditions. Based on the features of the DCS with references to the periodic test events caused by human errors, the paper comes up with feasible methods to simplify the periodic test process and to minimize human intervention other than unavoidable manipulations during start-up and end-up. The practical implementation of Fuqing Nuclear Power plant on this subject is also concluded in the end for peer reference.

articleTitle: Investments of Distributed Static Series Compensator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Power load is constantly changing with the development of national economy. The existing investment methods usually adopt Net Present Value method to make disposable investment in power equipment. Based on the ability of distributed static series compensator to regulate the parameters of the power systems , this paper proposes four functions, including the investment cost function which considers the control effects of the distributed static series compensator, the economic benefit function depends on increased transmission capacity, the economic revenue function caused by the wider range of stable voltage safety, and the economic revenue function caused by the wider range of stable power angle. Then, this paper proposes an investment decision method, which applied a real option binary tree pricing model in the distributed static series compensator investments. Results show that the investments method based on option binary tree can achieve higher returns than that based on Net Present Value method.

articleTitle: An alignment analysis of military information system architecture based on portfolio decision approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Business-IT alignment (BITA) is an important research problem of military information system architecture (MISA). Extant research has achieved and controlled the MISA to alleviate the BITA issue from the perspective of architecture management. This article attempts to address the problem in the architecture design phase in advance, in order to maintain a suitable alignment level at the beginning. For problems correlating with BITA in the design phase, functions-systems alignment (FSA) is selected as a study point, and portfolio decision analysis (PDA) is utilized to discuss information systems portfolio problem in it. Method feasibility is demonstrated through an anti-missile case. This paper contributes to improving the alignment quality of MISA by considering the PDA method.

articleTitle: Application of Boundary Observer for Linear Hyperbolic Systems in Oil Pipeline based on MacCormack’ Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the application of linear hyperbolic system equations in oil pipelines. In order to overcome the shortcomings of practical measurement difficulties and facilitate the application, a linear hyperbolic boundary observer is constructed. This hyperbolic boundary observer can directly apply the relevant knowledge of control theory. Then the feasibility of the observer is proved by the error system and the original system satisfying the exponential convergence by MacCormack' method. Emphasis on the application of MacCormack algorithm in linear hyperbolic equations and the correctness of the theory is consequently verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Meter Monitoring System Based on MCU Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the requirements of meter reading in the station area, the design principle and remote communication scheme of the system are established, and the overall design scheme of the system is established. In view of the shortcomings of GSM communication, GPRS data communication scheme is adopted. According to the working principle of the system, the data acquisition, digital-analog conversion and data transmission processes are analyzed and studied, which improves the data transmission capability of the system. In the hardware design of the system, the main controller adopts AT89C51 8-bit MCU, serial communication includes RS-232, RS-485 and various communication interfaces. The design of sampling circuit combines filter circuit and phase-locked loop circuit, which effectively improves the accuracy of data acquisition and anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Research on "Cloud-Edge-End" Security Protection System of Internet of Things Based on National Secret Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet of Things applications, Internet of Things technology and applications have become more and more popular, and the perceived risk of sensing layer terminals, transmission and application has become more and more important. This paper first analyzes the security risks faced by the Internet of Things from the perception layer, transport layer and application layer; then describes the cryptographic algorithm technology and its application; Finally, based on the cryptographic technology, the security protection measures such as security authentication, data transmission and storage between the sensing layer, the edge side, the network layer and the cloud platform are designed respectively, and the security system based on the key system is proposed.

articleTitle: Real-time Simulation of No-load Grid-connection Based on dSPACE Doubly-Fed Wind Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a flexible grid-connection method, idle-load grid-connection is widely used in AC excitation variable speed constant frequency (VSCF) wind power generation systems with Doubly-Fed Induction Generator (DFIG). In this paper, the idle-load grid-connection control strategy of the VSCF doubly-fed wind turbine is designed. Under the condition of open circuit on the stator side, the rotor exciting current is adjusted to realize VSCF at the stator side while decoupling the output active power and reactive power. Finally, a semi-physical real-time simulation platform of doubly-fed wind power generation system based on dSPACE is established. As a result, there was no inrush current at the time of grid-connection, which verified the correctness of the control strategy, at the same time, accuracy and real-time of the control system were proved.

articleTitle: A real-time simulation design of multi-path fading channel based on SOS method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Sum of Sinusoids (SOS) has the advantages of good consistency and simple implementation in the field of wireless channel simulation, so it has been widely used in channel simulation equipment. Based on the analysis of SOS simulation method and the design of simulation parameters, the design of real-time channel generation and real-time channel superposition in FPGA is completed. The hardware design of large-scale and small-scale fading for real-time channel simulation is given in detail. The principles of high-precision delay, long-delay and real-time channel superposition modules are also given. The performance parameters of the channel simulator are tested, and the performance of the channel simulator is verified.

articleTitle: A Clutter Model for LFM Radar Used in STAP
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Compared with conventional pulse radar, the clutter signal model of LFM (Linear Frequency Modulated) pulse compression radar has its particularity due to the superposition effect. Compared with ground radar, the clutter model of airborne radar is more complex because of the difference of Doppler frequency of each clutter unit caused by the motion of airborne radar. In view of the characteristics of LFM pulse compression signal and airborne radar, a clutter model of LFM pulse compression signal applied to airborne radar is proposed, and the statistical characteristics of clutter before and after pulse compression are simulated and analyzed. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the new model.

articleTitle: Operation Control Strategy of Microgrid Based on Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The large capacity battery energy storage system can stabilize the fluctuation of the power generated by the micro source, provide voltage and frequency reference when the control method in the islanding mode, becoming an essential component of the microgrid. According to this, researching the operation control method of energy storage system in the power grid, coordinating with the wind power system, while stabilizing the power, realiazing charge and discharge energy storage operation. According to the characteristics of traditional synchronous generator with inertia and damping, the virtual synchronous generator technology is put forward. The virtual synchronous machine control technology is applied to the converter of the energy storage equipment, realizing system voltage regulation and frequency modulation. Using simulation software constructed simulation model of wind storage integrated power generation system based on virtual synchronous generator, to verify the feasibility of the control strategy.

Author Keywords: charge and discharge energy storage operation
wind storage integrated power generation system

articleTitle: A Model Reference Adaptive Controller With Feedforward Decoupling for Active Magnetic Bearing Rotor System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Active magnetic bearing (AMB) rotor system is widely applied in the industry for its remarkable advantages. However, it is a typical open-loop unstable mechatronics system suffering from nonlinear and couple characteristic. In this paper, the feedforward decoupling method is used to deal with the couple relationship of different axes. And the model reference adaptive control (MRAC) method is applied to improve the control performance and robustness and overcome the uncertainties. This control method makes the system output reach to the reference model by the designed adaptive law. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Fast Global Active Contour Model with Local Information
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the edgeless active contour (CV) model, an improved model is proposed in this paper. Because CV model only uses global intensity information to complete image segmentation process, so the processing of inhomogeneous images is not good, and even there will be error segmentation. In view of the disadvantage of CV model, we consider adding local gray information items to the energy function of CV model. In order to speed up the evolution of the model, we improve the global and local terms according to the method of reference [9]. At the same time, the energy penalty term is added to the energy function to avoid the re-initialization of CV model. Finally, in order to verify the practicability and validity of the improved model, some images are selected for MATLAB simulation experiments. The experimental results of the improved model are compared with those of the original CV model and the model in reference [8]. It is concluded that the improved model has higher segmentation accuracy and efficiency for uneven gray images.

articleTitle: Research on Wheeled Inspection Robot Drive System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The inspection robot is an industrial-specific robot. It can realize a variety of sensor information fusion, multiple communication methods, multiple intelligent control methods coexist, and can be autonomous navigation and positioning. with broadly application foreground. In this paper, the structural design of the wheeled detection robot is proposed, and the wheel drive system of the wheel detection robot based on STM32F405 and DRV8302 is designed. A set of brushless DC motor servo system with speed, current and position three closed-loop structure was designed for testing. This paper mainly introduces the hardware design of the robot chassis drive system. And the experiment shows that the hardware design can well meet the actual operation needs of the inspection robot.

articleTitle: Study of a Three-Parameter Fractional Order PID Controller and its Optimal Tuning Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a simplified fractional order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controller with only three pending parameters is proposed by building the relationships between the controller parameters. An estimation model of the optimal relationship coefficient between the controller parameters is built in order to guarantee good dynamic performance of the control system. Then the optimal three-parameter PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controller can be tuned analytically according to the estimated relationship coefficient. The three-parameter PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controller is applied to the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) speed control. Motor speed control simulations are performed and then the robustness, step response performance and anti-load disturbance performance of the three-parameter PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> control system are verified.

articleTitle: A Two-dimensional MEMS Scanning Mirror Control Method based on Direct Digital Synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The two-dimensional MEMS scanning mirror is the core component in laser radar. It can obtain high quality imaging, based on its advantages of high resolution, fast imaging speed, small size and low price. A two-dimensional MEMS scanning mirror control method based on direct digital synthesizer is presented in this paper. This circuit achieves the phase accumulator of double direct digital synthesizer with FPGA, and directly realizes all kinds of frequency modulation of arbitrary waveform directly by digital method. In order to improve the drive performance of the two-dimensional MEMS scanning mirror, a 5th-order elliptic function filter is used to filter the sinusoidal driving signal of direct digital synthesizer. Testing results indicate that the proposed method of arbitrary waveform generator based on direct digital synthesizer can drive the two-dimensional MEMS scanning mirror with the characteristics of high scanning control precision and wide scanning range.

articleTitle: Identification of Critical-to-quality Characteristic in Complex Products Based on the Adaptive-Lasso Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Targeting the problem of the redundancy in complex product quality characteristics, the Adaptive-Lasso method is introduced into the identification of Critical-to-quality Characteristic. By using the Adaptive-Lasso method to filter variables, reduce the dimensions of the original quality data sample set, and obtain the order of the correlation between the quality Characteristics in the sample set and the quality category, the quality Characteristics with the highest classification correct ratio are selected to form the Critical-to-quality Characteristic subset. On this basis, the classification correct ratio of the selected Characteristic subset is tested by using the support vector machine. The example shows that compared with the traditional ReliefF method and Lasso method, this method can effectively remove the irrelevant and redundant features in the original data set to achieve the purpose of identifying the Critical-to-quality Characteristic.

articleTitle: An Ultra-wideband GaAs pHEMT Distributed Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A 0.5-7 GHz power amplifier (PA) is designed and fabricated in a 0.15 μm GaAs pHEMT process in this paper. To achieve a broadband power performance, this PA implements a nonuniform distributed amplifier configuration with four amplifying cells. Meanwhile, the transistor-stacking technology is applied in this PA to enhance the wideband power gain. Biasing with a 12 V drain voltage, this PA shows the measurement results of about 1-watt output power in the frequency range of 0.5-7 GHz with corresponding power added efficiency of 18-24%. The measured S-parameters show a very flat gain (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub>) of 14±0.4 dB, a maximum input return loss (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>) of -16 dB, a maximum output return loss (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22</sub>) of -11 dB. The chip occupies a small chip size of 3×2.5 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Application of Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity Test in the Detection of Hard Foreign Object in Farmland Soil
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The pulse velocity of the ultrasonic wave in the soil can reflect the elastic parameters and characteristics of the soil. In order to study the feasibility of using ultra-sonic pulse velocity (UPV) to detect hard foreign matter in the soil of farmland (within 40cm), sand was selected as the research object, and an ultrasonic pulse velocity test device was designed and used with non-metal ultrasonic detector. The acoustic parameters of the soil samples before and after the embedding of hard foreign bodies were measured, and the feasibility of the application of the detection of hard foreign bodies in the farmland tillage layer by ultrasonic pulse velocity test was analyzed. The results show that it is feasible to use the ultrasonic pulse velocity test to detect the hard foreign object embedded in the farmland layer according to the variation of the ultrasonic wave propagation velocity and the amplitude of the sound wave in the soil medium. This study provides an experimental basis for the next stage of the project.

articleTitle: ARG-Based Malignancy Evaluation for Pulmonary Nodule Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Malignancy evaluation is an important stage in lung cancer diagnosis. However, due to the complexity of medical image data, processing the images costs a long time. Aimed for this problem, we propose a method based on the Attributed Relational Graph (ARG) in this paper to measure the degree of pulmonary nodule malignancy, with And-Or Graph (AOG) and Markov Blanket (MB) used for dimensionality reduction. Our method is tested on real images of Shanghai Chest Hospital and Shenyang Shengjing Hospital with classification accuracy 70.85%, and tested on the IDRI-LIDC database with accuracy 75.01%. The method can help to identify and analyze the benign and malignant nodules correctly and quickly.

articleTitle: A 7.0–8.0 GHz High Efficiency Medium Power Amplifier Design and 3-D Modeling for FEA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a 7.0 GHz to 8.0 GHz medium power amplifier (PA) using a 0.15-μm GaAs pHEMT process. To achieve the wideband high gain and high efficiency, the proposed PA applies a two-stage topology and two series LC output matching network targeting the optimum efficiency impedances over the desired bandwidth. To implement the finite element analysis for this design, a manual modeling method is proposed to generate the 3-D model of the PA in ANSYS WORKBENCH. Measurement results show that the PA achieves a small-signal gain of 26-27 dB, a saturated output power of about 25 dBm with PAE of 47% from 7.0 GHz to 8.0 GHz.

articleTitle: SAR Image Ground Object Recognition Detection Method based on Optimized and Improved CNN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve overfitting of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) image ground object recognition detection, in this paper CNN was optimized and improved for obtaining improved performance. Firstly, tanh function was selected as activation function to make CNN stably converge. Secondly, dropout was adopted in hidden layer of CNN to reduce overfitting. For the problem of CNN fell into local minimum value after adopting dropout, this paper proposed a weight update method of the `variable step size + gradient descent with momentum', which could make CNN escape local minimum value and weaken oscillation. Finally, optimized and improved method of the `tanh + dropout + variable step size + gradient descent with momentum' was proposed, which effectively reduced overfitting. Effectiveness and accuracy of proposed method are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Application of Discrete Whale Optimization Hybrid Algorithm in Multiple Travelling Salesmen Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the standard whale optimization algorithm cannot directly solve the multiple travelling salesmen problem(MTSP), this paper proposes a discrete whale optimization hybrid algorithm (DWOHA) .
