A small amount of optimization of ant colony optimization is used to provide some elite individuals for the initial population to reduce the number of global searches. Propose a principal and subordinate chromosome coding method with smaller solution space to reduce the space complexity of the algorithm and improve the efficiency of optimization. Redefine the operation rules to apply the characteristics of MTSP discrete solution space based on the whale's unique location update method. Construct a triangular neighborhood structure to increase the local mining efficiency of the algorithm and improve the convergence accuracy. Through simulation experiments on several test sets, the results are compared with other algorithms which proves that DWOHA has an excellent performance in solving MTSP.

articleTitle: An improved Viterbi algorithm for instantaneous frequency extraction of overlapped multicomponent signals
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Instantaneous frequency extraction of multicomponent signals with time frequency overlapped components has been a challenging task in radar, sonar and other applications. Viterbi algorithm on time frequency distribution can be potentially applied to estimate instantaneous frequencies of multicomponent signals, but it may track wrong instantaneous frequency curves when signal components intersect each other in the time frequency domain. In order to suppress this switch problem, this paper assumes the estimated instantaneous frequency curves on a finite interval can be approximated by liner, quadratic or higher-order polynomials, which should not vary seriously after instantaneous frequencies cross the entire time frequency plane. Then, a novel penalty function describing the variation of polynomial instantaneous frequencies is developed. Furthermore, the fitting technique based on least square method is applied to calculate the penalty between the predicted instantaneous frequency point and instantaneous frequency candidates. Performance of the proposed algorithm on several simulated multicomponent frequency modulated signals indicates the proposed algorithm can obtain more accurate instantaneous frequencies than Viterbi algorithm can by suppressing the switch problem.

articleTitle: Optimization Design for Wireless Power Transfer System under the Variation of Load and Coupling Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The variation of load resistance and coupling coefficient are two key factors affecting the output characteristics of wireless power transfer system during the charging process. Both the variation of coupling coefficient caused by the position deviation of primary and secondary devices and the variation of load resistance during charging will result in the low output power and efficiency of the wireless charging system. In view of the above problems, this paper studied the constraint conditions of the compensation network of several wireless power transfer systems, and analyzed the output characteristics of the wireless power transfer system of each compensation network under the variation of load and coupling coefficient. The LCL-LCL type compensation network structure was selected for optimization design and according to the variation characteristics of output power and efficiency with load and coupling coefficient, the method of optimizing the compensation network parameters was proposed. The output power value of the design system was further optimized by adding a dc-dc converter circuit. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed optimization design method was verified through the system simulation.

articleTitle: Optimum Design and Modal Analysis of Reducer Worm Drive for Belt Conveyor by Matlab and ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Worm drive is an important form of transmission in the belt conveyor, which is essential for equipment safety and stability. In order to meet the requirements of strength reliability and safety, reducing material consumption and cost saving is a subject worth studying. Through the MATLAB platform, the optimal design of the worm drive was studied. The basic parameters of the worm shaft and the worm gear were optimized. Based on optimization parameters, solid model of worm drive was established through 3D design software UGNX. The model was imposed into the ANSYS and modal analyzed, and the first six natural frequencies and vibration patterns of the gear were obtained. The results of the modal analysis can provide a reference for the design of the gear and the improvement of the reducer.

articleTitle: Verification Method and Experimental Study of UHF Partial Discharge Detection Equipment Based on GTEM Cell
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The UHF partial discharge detection technology has been widely used in the state detection of power grid equipment. However, the manufacturing process of equipment from different manufacturers, the influence of on-site detection environment, and the operation and maintenance of instruments directly affect the on-site detection performance of UHF partial discharge sensors and detection devices. Therefore, it is of great significance to carry out the verification and comparison test research on the performance characteristics of UHF partial discharge sensors. This paper studies the performance testing method of UHF PD testing equipment, gives the testing principle and method of UHF sensor's average effective height, testing sensitivity, dynamic range, correct identification rate and stability of PD types, establishes a performance verification and comparison testing platform for UHF PD testing equipment, and compares and analyzes the performance parameters of high frequency PD sensors from different manufacturers in combination with the actual field application of UHF PD sensors. Research shows that the transmission impedance and testing frequency of imported high frequency sensors are better than those of domestic equipment. The performance check and comparison test research of UHF PD detection equipment provides an important basis for the arrival acceptance and regular check of UHF PD detectors, and also provides strong technical support for field testers.

articleTitle: Policy Uncertainty and Stock Market Returns: Nonlinear Analysis Based on MF-DCCA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper studies the relationship between policy uncertainty and stock market returns by using multifractal detrended cross-correlation analysis (MF-DCCA) method. We choose China economic policy uncertainty index (CNEPU) and Shanghai stock market returns as the research object of this paper. Using detrended fluctuation analysis (MF-DFA) method to examine the multifractal properties of CNEPU change series and Shanghai stock market returns, we find that both returns and CNEPU change series have multifractal characteristics. And using multifractal detrended cross-correlation analysis (MF- DCCA) method, we find that there exists strong anti-persistent cross-correlation between Shanghai stock market returns and CNEPU change series. Besides, we find that the fat-tail distribution is the main reason for the multifractality in the cross-correlations.

articleTitle: The Correction Technology of Abnormal Power Based on Arbitrary Division of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the current situation of failure of data collection and abnormal data collection in the same period line loss calculation and access data of power grid, the abnormal data of various data integrated in the same period system is relatively high, and the abnormal information screening, management and verification of data are lacking. In this paper, based on the topology recursion of transmission network, the function of correcting abnormal data in any divided area is presented. The calculation relation among the unbalance rate of bus bar, main transformer power loss and transmission line power loss is generated through transmission network topology recursion technology, and the substation. Through the transmission network topology recursion technology and the principle of node power balance, the abnormal substation is checked and repaired by itself in the station, and according to whether it can be checked and repaired by itself, it is determined whether to expand the power grid division area and the scope of check calculation. As much as possible, the normal data of other areas are used to check and correct the abnormal data of the suspected substation, which can quickly and effectively lock and correct the abnormal data, thus improving the availability rate and calculation quality of the theoretical calculation data of line loss.

articleTitle: Sparse Component Analysis Using Continuous Wavelet Transform for Blind Source Separation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Blind source separation (BSS) has been widely used in image processing, vibration analysis, signal filtering and other field for many years. Recently, sparse component analysis (SCA), an effective BSS method, has received a lot of attention. Compared with the traditional method, SCA has a wider range of use because it has more relaxed constraints on the observation signal. The sparse representation of signals is an important part in the operational framework of SCA. For this important part, a sparse component analysis method using continuous wavelet transform (CWT) was proposed in this paper. Firstly, this paper introduced the principle of classical blind source separation problem, and explained the framework of sparse component analysis. Then, continuous wavelet transform was introduced to get sparse representation of observation signals and the operation process of the method was explained. Finally, a numerical simulation case was designed and implemented to prove that CWT has higher accuracy than STFT, and the selection rules of various parameters of CWT were discussed. The simulation results showed that the SCA using CWT can extract the mixed matrix with high accuracy and the method still has high efficiency under the noise level of 30dB.

articleTitle: Research on data traceability of unified identity construction of physical assets of power grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: It is a management innovation project based on the traditional equipment management and the whole life cycle management of assets. The uniform identity code of the physical assets of the power grid is unique and runs through the whole life cycle of the assets, which can effectively push the digital management process of asset management and is an important embodiment of the ubiquitous power Internet of things. At the same time, it puts forward the correlation and traceability of real asset identity, and simultaneously promotes various business applications based on data connection. The physical assets data can be traced to substation as the main body in the stock of equipment data control, can also be regional unit as the main force, analyze the main 14 and substation and regional affiliations, such equipment based on GIS map data dynamically generated power grid assets close-up view, intuitive display station distribution of the main equipment, the equipment in PMS2.0, accounting, operations, maintenance, production technical and other business data verification and quality tracking.

articleTitle: Research on Layout Planning of Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The potential of new energy vehicles has been acknowledged broadly which leads to the gradual development of electric vehicles and charging network. We built a statistical model which is based on the data from Tesla Supercharging Network in order to estimate the demand for charging capacity and charging station scale. Then in the consideration of rapid growth of electric vehicles in South Korea, a schematization is created to coordinate the positioning of charging stations, following the Three Principles suggested in W.Christaller’s Central Place Theory. Then to adapt the research to countries of different circumstances, some factors are quantified to get scores for 6 different countries in terms of the Three Principles respectively. We use bivariate analysis to examine the influential factors related to the positioning of charging station.

Author Keywords: Site layout model of charging station

articleTitle: MetroNet: A Novel Data-Driven Fault Diagnosis Method Applied to Wheel Bearings of Metro Trains
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The wheel bearing is a vital component of metro train, therefore, the fault diagnosis of wheel bearing is essential to ensure the reliability and safety. In recent years, some intelligent fault diagnosis algorithms have been proposed and achieved great success. However, to validate the performance of the proposed model, most researches only focus on several public datasets because of the limitation of data acquisition, which easily leads to inconsistent diagnosis after transferring the trained model to the real industrial scene. Therefore, this paper proposes an excellent method to implement data acquisition in industrial scenes. Based on data augmentation, we totally created the dataset with 40000 samples. Aiming at the training data, this paper proposes a novel data-driven fault diagnosis model named MetroNet that is applied to wheel bearings of metro trains. Notably, MetroNet is mainly constructed by CNN and RNN, and it can capture temporal correlation and spatial correlation of raw sensor data. Furthermore, the CNN adopts an innovation method of convolution over height and pooling over weight. The performance of MetroNet is evaluated on the testing dataset, and the optimal accuracy of fault diagnosis can be increased to 97.20%.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Design of Warranty Strategy Considering Warranty Cost and Availability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This study designs extended warranty strategy for engineering equipment by considering the warranty cost and availability requirement. Aiming to minimize the cost rate and maximize the availability simultaneously, a multi-objective maintenance optimization model is established. Various maintenance modes are adopted, including minimal maintenance, replacement and imperfect maintenance based on dynamic improvement factors. The failure rate threshold and replacement cycle are taken as the decision variables. By using the fast elite non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II), the Pareto optimal solutions of extended warranty policies are obtained. Case study is implemented to illustrate the validity of the optimization model. It shows that compared with single-objective optimization, multi-objective optimization can achieve a lower cost rate and higher availability. Meanwhile, it can obtain better and more optimization results to promote the flexibility of the warranty policies.

articleTitle: NTOPNG based Traffic Monitoring and Modelling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Firewall deployment is a case-based approach, which is sensitive to the network environment and traffic patterns. Improper setup and configuration on firewall will cause the degradation of network performance. Therefore, the performance testing of a firewall product under realistic traffic environment is crucial. This paper evaluates the traffic monitoring and capturing tool, ntopng, under 1 Gps and 10 Gps link speeds respectively. The ntopng functions are tested in order to retrieve the required traffic features. A traffic modelling method is proposed based on the extraction of historical data. The ntopng performance in terms of packet loss is examined with using different packet capture technologies.

articleTitle: Node correlation causal inference of spatio-temporal association data based on Bayesian method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Spatio-temporal association data refers to spatial feature information flows that have spatio-temporal associations with each other and change over time. The mining of spatio-temporal related data has attracted much attention and has been widely used in many fields. At present, many researches of spatio-temporal data mining can only infer the association mode of spatio-temporal objects from the system. Therefore, based on the complex network theory, this paper proposed a spatio-temporal data networked node correlation inference method based on Bayesian method. Based on the network topology structure, the sample statistics method was designed according to time and space information. The conditional probability between network nodes was calculated so that it was applied to the node correlation causal inference. Finally, the method was applied to two typical spatio-temporal correlation data networks - seismic network and pest-relational network, and the prediction accuracy was 76% and 80%, respectively. In addition, this paper analyzed the relationship between the accuracy of the prediction and other factors such as test set size, structural core and magnitude limits.

articleTitle: Research on Contactless Power Transmission System based on DCDC charging module for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Abilities of UUV depend on scopes of navigation and cruise duration, while power system plays a significant role in UUV’s issues, which were researched widely in recent years. The contactless power transmission system is coupled coupler connection which achieves a lower efficiency. In this paper, a DCDC charging module of contactless power transmission system is developed and investigated focus on a cascaded LLC resonant converter to obtain higher power level and efficiency at charging system. The operating principles of proposed converter are described and specific design procedures are carried out as well. Eventually, a experimental prototype of proposed converter is implemented to verify the power level and efficiency as designed.

articleTitle: Cloud Data Monitoring Management and Visual Application System Based on Spring Boot
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The system has developed cloud-based data monitoring management and visualization applications based on Spring Boot. The springboot micro-service framework make system configuration and monitoring easier. In order to adapt to various page layouts, the front-end page used HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, bootstrap and other technologies. The system realized multiple functions of data management, data downloading and Baidu map visualization. The use of Baidu maps has enabled the visualization of more intuitive and distinctive air quality data. The program has been deployed in the Ali Cloud, which facilitates users to remotely access web projects. The combination of Spring Boot framework and AJAX has achieved complete separation of front and back ends, which makes the system have good stability, real-time and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Fault Location Based on Rough Set and Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Under the background of the popularization of smart meters and the further upgrading of centralized reading equipment, relying on two-way communication system in some non-measurement and control areas of distribution network, power enterprises can also obtain users'multiple electricity values through smart meters in time or in real time. Therefore, for a given distribution network topology, in the non-measurement and control area of the distribution network where the user's meter information has been collected, the user's smart meter information, the user's telephone complaint information and the equipment alarm information are taken as the condition attributes of the fault classification to establish the fault decision table, and find the minimum reduction. Then, according to the three kinds of information, attribute matching of the reduced fault decision table is carried out to determine the fault section. The simulation results show that the proposed method greatly reduces the number of complaint calls needed for fault location and shortens the time of fault location.

articleTitle: The Research on an Inter-phase Coupling Switched Reluctance Motor With Short Flux Path
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents an inter-phase coupling switched reluctance motor with short flux path structure. Its rotor is made up of cast aluminum and silicon steel U-shape core, in order to ensure the flux closed with a shortest path. This structure could provide higher power density, lower iron loss and manufacturing cost, lighter weight and higher cooling capacity. A five-phase 10/8 poles SFP SRM is analyzed in this paper. The performance of torque and the harmonic components of the radial force wave are verified by finite element method, which compared with normal SRM. This paper provides a new designing thought for high power density and high efficiency motor, which has theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: Research on civil aircraft conflict resolution based on TBO
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the increase of airspace density, it is an important measure to improve flight safety, as well as hot issue in this field, that preventing the air collision between aircrafts, or aircraft and the threat in complex weather. Aiming at the two-layer conflict resolution capability required by the concept of TBO, this paper proposes two conflict resolution algorithms for tactical layer and strategic layer respectively. On tactical layer, a method for short conflict resolution based on artificial potential field algorithm is put forward. It improves the potential field function so as to solve the problem of unreachable and no-convergence in application. The multi-aircraft conflict resolution is verified by simulation. On strategic layer, the Genetic Algorithm (GA) based on disturbance mode implements a middle-term conflict resolution and then the conflict-free optimal path of 10 to 20 minutes in advance is obtained. The population of route points is constructed by real number coding; the GA solve method of traversing the initial solution space with multiple disturbance mode is proposed; the elitist strategy is applied to increase performance. Experiments prove the methods proposed in this paper can ensure the aircraft meets the two-layer conflict resolution requirement of TBO.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Convolutional Neural Network in Oil Well Drawing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The indicator diagram is a method for judging the type of failure of the pumping unit system. Since many oilfields still recognize the collected dynamometer by manual analysis, there is an error in manual identification. Due to the complicated working environment of the pumping unit, the pumping system will encounter various problems and cannot accurately identify the type of fault in time. In this paper, the fault indicator diagram is taken as the research object, and the convolutional neural network is the theoretical basis. With reference to the design idea of the more mature convolutional network model, the basic network is optimized. Then, the Bagging algorithm that improved the voting mechanism was improved, and the accuracy rate of 0.7% was improved. On this basis, the recall rate was 4.56% higher. Meet the needs of the actual production environment, with good predictive effects and practical performance.

articleTitle: Improved Instantaneous Derivation dq Detection Voltage Drop Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the power quality problem of voltage dynamic drop caused by the intermittent output of a large number of distributed power sources (DG) in micro-grid, an instantaneous derivation dq algorithm combined with delay-free finite impulse response (FIR) digital filtering is proposed. Based on the phase-locking method of FIR digital filter and "zero-crossing phase-detection", it is applied to the phase-locked control of instantaneous dq transformation. The traditional instantaneous dq transform is delayed by 90° from the single-phase voltage signal to change the αβ coordinate to a single-phase signal. The differential β-coordinate is used to form the αβ coordinate, and the delay-free FIR digital filter is used to replace the low-pass filter of the conventional instantaneous dq, and the filter is filtered. Before the link is preset, the non-fundamental components in the signal are filtered out and then the instantaneous derivation dq transform is performed. The FIR digital filtering algorithm combined with the instantaneous derivation dq algorithm realizes the voltage sag amplitude, phase abrupt change and voltage dynamic change start and stop time of the micro-grid. Finally, the micro-grid model is built by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform, the fault type and harmonic source are set, and the instantaneous derivation dq algorithm combined with FIR digital filter is compared with the traditional voltage sag method. The simulation results show that the instantaneous dq derivation algorithm combined with FIR filtering has better real-time performance, and the recognition effect of the power quality problem of the voltage sag caused by the distortion voltage is improved, which satisfies the dynamic voltage restorer (DVR) voltage. The real-time and reliability requirements of the inspection.

Author Keywords: delay-free finite impulse response (FIR) digital filtering

articleTitle: Application of Trajectory Clustering on Improved Artificial Intelligence Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Capacity of grid participants such as photovoltaic panel, wind power and electric vehicles has shown rapid growth, while the technology in the industrial sector has continued to innovate, and many types of power load characteristics have undergone tremendous changes. This paper proposes an improved worker intelligence load forecasting method based on trajectory clustering. The method clusters different fluctuation patterns of daily load curves, summarizes the influencing factors, and improves the intelligent prediction method. It is suitable for load forecasting in areas where load characteristics are not significantly consistent and where external stimuli are significantly affected. Solve the distortion problem of traditional load forecasting for continuous prediction of new energy and random power load. The calculations are carried out for areas with industrial agglomeration and new energy capacity. The results show that the method can accurately reflect the future load trend from the perspective of feature correction.

articleTitle: UXO localization procedures applied to potable TEM sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Localization of unexploded ordnance (UXO) with transient electromagnetic (TEM) system is a principle and necessary problem in detection procedures, especially beset by low data diversity and high positioning uncertainty. In this paper, procedures for targets location are presented in detail with cued data collected by potable TEM sensor JPMD, which is designed to provide diverse time-domain data of high quality with one transmitter coil and five 3-component receiving coils. Based on the single dipole model, the target is located with the data collected at a single spatial point by the differential evolution (DE) optimization algorithm which can be subdivided into three steps. With the structure and parameters of JPMD sensors and data inversion process described briefly, a field test site of 5 m × 5 m measurement grid was conducted to present the specific UXO localization procedures at Jilin University. Results indicate that all the UXO-like targets can be detected distinctly with JPMD. The location of single object can be inversed rapid in tolerable error at one single point. For two objects with overlapping signals as one, the inverted horizontal position is basically in the middle of them and depth is a bit smaller than theory.

articleTitle: A Transparent Microstrip Antenna Using Grapheme Film
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A transparent microstrip antenna based on grapheme conducting film is proposed in this paper. With the unique advantages of high conductivity and high light transmission, grapheme film, a new two-dimensional material, can be used to design transparent antennas. The conductive grapheme film is used instead of the metal layer of microstrip antenna, focusing on the restriction of light transmittance and radiation performance of microstrip antenna. On the basis of retaining the original function of the antenna, the transparent design of the antenna is realized. The antenna have a small size of 15mm×15mm×1.1mm, the visible light transmittance greater than 72%, and the port reflection coefficient less than -10dB from 5GHz to 20GHz. A wider band matching is achieved than traditional microstrip antennas. The designed antenna can be integrated in the display screen, windows and other transparent parts, which will not take up extra space, solving the problem that the space is too small to design antennas and the multifunction is required.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of single event crosstalk in multi-lines system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With device feature size scaling down, single event crosstalk (SEC) effects should be considered carefully in the early design stages of circuits applied for space and ground radiation environments. A model for predicting SEC in 3-lines system is proposed based on the point admittance and the distribution network of the lines. By using the presented model, 1000 random generated circuits are modeled and tested. The simulation results show that the model has average error 5.52%, whose results match SPICE very well. The relevance between the parameters of the lines and the prediction accuracy of the model is analyzed by using grey theory. Keywords—single event crosstalk; model; multi-lines system; point admittance; interconnect

articleTitle: Research on Occlusion of Satellite Solar Array based on Collision Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Protrusions on the satellite surface, especially the antennas might occlude the solar array when the satellite deploying in-orbit. This paper presents a line segment intersection method based on collision detection to simulate and calculate the solar array occlusion. First, the rectangular battery cells of solar array are divided to triangle meshes, and the subdivision degree of the meshes can be improved by linear interpolation. Then, a 3D graph scene is built to simulate the satellite deploying in-orbit. The line segments from the sun point to the entire triangle meshes’ center are created, and the intersection between the line segment and satellites’ other parts are tested during the real-time rendering process of the scene by the line segment intersection method. Then the occlusion rate can be calculated by the quantity of intersections, and the calculation precision can be improved by increasing the interpolations times. Meanwhile, the occluded triangles of the solar array are rendered to generate the shadow effect to improve the sense of reality. Finally, the method is verified by an example, and the result shows that it has a good precision and a good sense of reality.

articleTitle: Mongolian Information Retrieval Method Based on Word2vec and Topic Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To capture the real intention of users’ needs more accurately from the increasingly abundant Mongolian information and return the retrieval results that best meet their needs, a Mongolian information retrieval method based on Word2vec and LDA topic model is proposed in this paper. Combining Mongolian grammatical features, this method builds a model based on LDA three-tier Bayesian structure to mine the hidden topic distribution and feature word distribution of documents, expands user queries according to Word2vec model to obtain words similar to user query keywords semantically, and then uses topic model to model extended vocabulary. Finally, according to the user’s query topic, the similarity between the query topic and the document topic is calculated, and the document with high relevance to the query topic is returned. The experimental results show that the effective combination of Word2vec and LDA model achieves better results than the traditional model with initial query in the representation of latent semantics.

articleTitle: Detection of UXO-like Targets with Portable Transient Electromagnetic System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the advantages of strong anti-interference ability and high spatial resolution, electromagnetic induction (EMI) has proven to be successful in unexploded ordnance (UXO detection. Portable transient electromagnetic system can work in a variety of complex conditions where the large and heavy vehicular systems cannot be readily used. The detection of UXO-like targets with portable transient electromagnetic (TEM) system is discussed detailed in this paper. Firstly, with description of the single dipole model for UXO response approximation, the location and characteristic response extraction for UXO-like targets is talked with the DE algorithm. Then, the improved sensor of the portable TEM system with a single-layered transmitting coil and five 3-component receiving coils is introduced. The transmitting coil is constructed with a diameter, number of turns, and transmitting current of 0.5 m, 30, and 5 A, respectively. The receiving coil is constructed with a length, number of turns, and resonant frequency of 6 cm, 600, and 180 kHz, respectively. Finally, 12 UXOs and 6 harmless targets buried in the area of 10 m × 6 m at different depths in different orientations have been detected with the improved portable TEM system. Target location and characteristic response have been estimated by DE algorithm with the measured response. The experimental results show that the high-quality data provided by the improved portable TEM system combined with the DE algorithm based on the dipole model can locate and characterize the separated targets accurately. Most of the position errors are within 10cm in x position and 5cm in depths for separated buried targets. For the multiple-targets buried together, the system can still locate and characterize the targets even if the response of two targets overlaps.

Author Keywords: electromagnetic induction portable transient electromagnetic system

articleTitle: A complex conjugate gradient training algorithm with Barzilai-Borwein stepsize for complex-valued neural networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Complex-valued neural networks (CVNNs) have become a hot research topic in neural network community for their powerful ability in dealing with complex-valued signal problems. However, as one of the most popular training methods for CVNNs, complex gradient method still suffers from slow convergence and easily traps into the local minima. To this end, in this paper we combine the conjugate gradient method and the Barzilai-Borwein method, and propose a complex conjugate gradient training method with Barzilai-Borwein stepsize for complex-valued neural networks. The superiority of the proposed method is substantiated with two numerical examples.

articleTitle: Radar Coherent Detection and Parameter Estimation for Maneuvering Target Based on KT-CICPF
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, target detection has drawn more and more attention in the field of radar signal processing. This paper addresses the coherent integration problem for detecting radar maneuvering targets involving range migration (RM) and Doppler frequency migration (DFM). A novel method based on keystone transform (KT) and coherent integration cubic phase function (CICPF) is proposed. In specific, the RM is firstly removed by KT and fold factor phase compensation. Then, the CICPF estimates velocity and acceleration of target. Finally, the coherent integration is achieved after compensating the RM and DFM. Both simulations and real data processing results validate the performance of proposed method.

articleTitle: Bucking coil used in unexploded ordnance detection with transient electromagnetic system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Off-time response is usually measured by transient electromagnetic (TEM) system to detect subsurface targets. Compared with off-time response, on-time response of TEM system is more sensitive to high-conductivity targets, such as UXOs. However, it is difficult to obtain on-time response directly due to the strong primary field response. The key problem for on-time measurement is to eliminate the primary field response. Bucking coil is adopted here to compensation the primary field of transmitter coil at receiving coil for on-time response measuring. Firstly, the structure of the sensor with transmitting coil, bucking coil, and receiving coil is presented. Then, the primary field of transmitting coil and bucking coil at the position of receiving coil is calculated theoretically. With the side length of transmitting coil, bucking coil and the receiving coil fixed, the number of turns for transmitting coil and bucking coil are optimized for the best compensation. Calculated results show that the best compensation effect can reach 0.53%. Finally, the sensor with a transmitting coil (constructed with a side length and number of turns of 96 cm and 30, respectively), a bucking coil (constructed with a side length and number of turns of 26 cm and 8, respectively), and a receiving coil (constructed with a side length of 6 cm) was built. Measured results show that the primary field response after compensation is no more than 1% of the original response, and the maximum amplitude is only 0.4V. The on-time response of targets can be accurately recorded.

articleTitle: Development of Synchronous Line Loss Analysis and Diagnosis System Based on Arbitrary Segmentation of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of power system information, various professional automation systems have been upgraded to form a variety of data for the power grid. Therefore, it is increasingly necessary to make full use of the massive data and to screen the effective information for the analysis of power line loss in the new era.This paper will research and develop a set of grid-based arbitrarily segmentation synchronous line loss analysis and diagnosis system based on massive data. Through the study of arbitrary segmentation methods and principles, the correction and fusion of multi-source data in arbitrary divided regional power grids can be realized, and the quality of data can be improved. Usability, provide data support for grid loss analysis, solve the problem of large-scale data error rate of synchronous line loss, and realize periodic processing of synchronous line loss statistics.

articleTitle: Collaborative space solution and simulation of 7DOF dual-arm rehabilitation robot
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Clinical research has proved that bilateral rehabilitation training based on robot-assisted system can effectively improve the rehabilitation effect of patients. The collaborative space of dual-arm robot must be analyzed first when developing rehabilitation training tasks. Aiming at the problem of the collaborative space of the 7 degrees of freedom (DOF) rehabilitation robot, a method combining the Monte Carlo method and the traversal search comparison method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the kinematics model is established by using the standard Denavit-Hartenberg (DH) method according to the configuration of the manipulator, and then the positive kinematics equation of the manipulator is obtained. Secondly, the Monte Carlo method is used to obtain the workspace of each arm, and the traversal search comparison method is used to obtain the collaborative space of the dual-arm rehabilitation robot. Finally, simulations are performed in the MATLAB toolbox to verify the correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Design of Paper Counting Algorithm based on Texture Image
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the stacked paper placed parallel to each other, the characteristics of the side texture image are analyzed, and an algorithm for counting compensation combined with the overall information is proposed. Considering that the most algorithms only deal with one-dimensional information, it is easy to generate the blind area of counting, resulting in false detection and missing detection. On this basis, this paper counts the edges of the paper in combination with the overall image information. This method detects the binarized side image of the paper at the suspected position by using a rectangular template to eliminate the false detection position and recover the missed detection position. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the algorithm is significantly improved, and the counting error is controlled within the required range.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a New Intelligent Substation Network Security Defense System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to enhance the network security protection level of intelligent substation, this paper puts forward a model of intelligent substation network security defense system through the analysis of intelligent substation network security risk and protection demand, and using example proved the feasibility and effectiveness of the defense system. It is intelligent substation network security protection provides a new solution.

articleTitle: An Improved Cluster Header Switch Gateway Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on cluster head gateway switch routing protocol, this paper proposed an improved Cluster head Gateway Switch Routing Protocol for the problem about heavy cluster head load and high energy consumption. In the clustering mechanism, this paper utilizes the node connectivity, the node neighbor change rate and node remaining energy as the weight influence factors to calculate the node weight. In the routing protocol, this paper proposes a hybrid routing protocol. Then this paper utilizes analytical hierarchy process to calculate the weights of the three factors and obtain the node weight. Finally, the OMNET experiment is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the improved protocol in increasing cluster stability and reducing cluster head load.

Author Keywords: Cluster head Gateway Switch Routing Protocol

articleTitle: A Compact Slot Antenna for UWB Positioning Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An ultra-wide band (UWB) slot antenna with a compact size is proposed for positioning application in this paper. The miniaturization characteristic of the antenna is obtained by folding the radiation patch. And the slots etched on the patch are optimized to improve the impedance bandwidth. This presented antenna with the dimension of 15× 20 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and has an operation bandwidth of 3.10 GHz-5.74 GHz (59.7%). Finally, the positioning performance of the antenna was measured in the UWB positioning system and a positioning accuracy of 4 cm is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on the Video Fire Detection System based on Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Through the analysis of flame characteristics, the algorithm of contour scanning, the algorithm of sharp-angle, the algorithm of flame discrimination, other mechanism analysis and software design, combined with the system hardware design, the video fire detection system based on image recognition can be designed. The performance of the system has been tested, The test results show that the flame can be identified quickly and accurately, and the reaction time of the system can be improved to within 2s.

articleTitle: A compressed sensing denoising algorithm for astronomical images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In image denoising, to overcome the shortcoming that the uniform threshold in iterative thresholding algorithms of compressed sensing (CS) can't separate the image from noise completely in each step scale leads to the reconstructed image still contains much noise, an optimized threshold is proposed to replace it. And then iterative thresholding algorithm based on the designed threshold is proposed, We apply the proposed algorithm for astronomical images denoising. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can remove more noise effectively, improves the recovered images quality. Even when the compressed ratio is low, it still has a better reconstruction performance.

articleTitle: Broadband and High-gain Antenna based on Novel Frequency Selective Surfaces for 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For 5GNR band, a high gain and broadband antenna based on frequency selective surface is proposed. The central frequency of the antenna is 2.7 GHz and the gain is 8.75dBi. Because of the ingenious design of frequency selective surface as band-stop filter, the antenna has good radiation pattern characteristics in two NR bands (2515MHz~2675MHz and 3400MHz~3600MHz) containing 5G. (Antenna gain, and directivity). The simulation results show that the gain of the structure in 2.6 GHz and 3.5 GHz bands is 8.76 dBi and 5.06 dBi respectively. The experimental results show that the structure has good application value.

articleTitle: Ship target detection algorithm based on improved deep learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Faster R-CNN algorithm is a deep learning network model based on regional suggestion network, which is applied to the field of target detection and recognition. Extracting a small number of pixels in the original image and generating a downscaled image can improve the detection efficiency of Faster R-CNN. Scene semantic narrowing is be directed at specific types of regions and geographical locations in the image. By performing targeted analysis on these regions, it can be interpreted more carefully, and the image is better applied to Faster R-CNN. The deep convolutional network with the narrowing function of the theme is studied. The main factors that affect the understanding of image content accumulated by human visual cognitive experience and computer vision research are summarized into various themes, and the appropriate theme is selected as a narrow sub-network according to the task. Realize the optimization of the Faster R-CNN algorithm by implementing a collaborative deep network with clear functions in the overall black box and subnet. The experimental results show that the proposed method can significantly shorten the detection time of the algorithm while improving the detection accuracy of Faster R-CNN algorithm.

articleTitle: A fast weld region segmentation method with noise removal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Weld region segmentation (WRS) is a key step in the recognition of defects from radiographic testing (RT) to ensure manufacturing and service quality of large-scale equipment. Traditional methods for WRS are time consuming and susceptible to image noise, particularly defect edges in the weld region. To address these issues, a fast WRS method is proposed in this paper to effectively remove the noise in RT images. First, a new image segmentation method based on beetle antennae search and clustering analysis is applied to segment an RT image and rapidly obtain a binary image. Second, a weld region boundary segmentation method is presented to eliminate noise based on morphological filters, remove defect points using object deletion, and obtain a continuous and smooth boundary of the weld region. A collection of radiographic weld images from a steam turbine manufacturing enterprise are then used to validate the proposed method. The results show that the proposed method has advantages in terms of reduced computation time and complexity compared to traditional methods. Furthermore, the WRS using the proposed method exhibited little image noise and few local defect points, accurately reflecting the boundary of the weld region both with and without defects.

articleTitle: Surface displacement monitoring of small slow landslide based on vision system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The occurrence of landslide is uncertain, and its surface displacement data is an important physical quantity reflecting the occurrence process of landslide. Therefore, we propose a visual based small displacement landslide surface displacement monitoring method. The method uses binocular stereo vision technology to monitor small slow landslides, and through image preprocessing, feature extraction, three-dimensional coordinate solving and other methods to solve the displacement of the marker body, so as to achieve the purpose of obtaining the displacement of the landslide surface. The experimental results show that the method has small measurement error, low cost and easy implementation.

articleTitle: Cancelable Iris Recognition with DPL
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The security of users may be one of the challenges that need to be addressed in the practical applications of iris recognition. In order to prevent the theft of iris patterns, non-invertible transformations are desired to be adopted. Combining random projections (RP) with dictionary pair learning (DPL) mode, a cancelable iris recognition scheme is proposed in this paper. Using the framework of DPL, dictionary pair of synthesis dictionary and analysis dictionary can be learnt jointly for iris pattern classification, which greatly reduce the computation complexity without sacrificing match accuracy. And cancelable iris templates are created with random projections. It is very difficult to extract useful information from the transformed iris patterns, which can enhance the related security. The suggested algorithm of cancelable iris recognition with DPL is also robust with the sectored random projections. Experiment results on public datasets have shown that a robust and accurate cancelable iris recognition can be obtained.

articleTitle: Password is Not Dead and Can be Used in Local Identification for Remote Authentication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Password is the most famous authentication technology in electronic networks due to its convenience for applications. This paper investigates and points out that sharing-based password authentication leads to privacy leakages and guessing attacks. In order to overcome the vulnerabilities, this paper proposes a reformed password authentication method. It shares random credential and localizes password with multiple factors using terminal devices. Furthermore, the security of password authentication is demonstrated with hybrid privacy optimizations. Finally, the analysis illustrates that password not only achieves secure authentication, but also helps to protect privacy.

articleTitle: Sea Surface Boundary Line Detection Based on Edge Energy Feature Matrix of Sequential Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Accurate detection of sea surface boundary line(SSBL) can decrease the search range of maritime target detection with an important meaning. However, it is a challenge task to detect the sea surface boundary line under the interference of various sea waves, rolling mountains, clouds, vessels, sea fogs, uneven illumination etc. This paper proposed a new sea surface boundary line detection algorithm based on edge energy feature matrix of sequential images. We enhance the stable edges by edge superimposition of sequential edge images, which creates edge energy feature matrix for better detection of SSBL. Then, the improved algorithm of Hough transform is utilized to compute the edge energy of straight lines. Finally, the maximal energy straight line was detected as SSBL. Experimental results show the proposed algorithm has strong anti-interference ability and has obvious advantages over other similar algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Planning of the Biped Robot based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper describes a method for the biped robot squat down planning, which can achieve the movement of squat down stably and glidingly. Use the three-link inverted pendulum model to make the robot get a stable trajectory. Use a five-order polynomial function to prescribe the initial and final positions and velocities for the robot during squatting down. Use the genetic algorithm to adjust the parameters of polynomials with taking the ZMP(zero moment point) as the optimization objective. Finally, verify the feasibility of the method by simulation.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Optimal Control for Distributed Power Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The performance of the distributed power flow controller with traditional linear controller may be deteriorated due to a large-range change of the operating condition. Thus, a new nonlinear power flow control strategy for the distributed power flow controller based on exact linearization via feedback was presented. The 5th-order nonlinear models for the distributed power flow controller both in the shunt side and the series side were fully linearized via selection of the Lyapunov-like output function, the appropriate nonlinear coordinate transformation and the state variable feedback. Then the corresponding nonlinear optimal controller for the distributed power flow controller is designed. The simulation results based on PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform show that the proposed power flow control strategy for the distributed power flow controller is correct and effective, and also show that the proposed control strategy for the distributed power flow controller has better control effect than the traditional linear control strategy for the distributed power flow controller.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Vulnerability Scanning and Security Enhanced System For Oracle Database
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Databases store the important information of a company, and once it is leaked, it will bring immeasurable losses. Determining how to find vulnerabilities and effectively repair them were the main objectives, we design and implement a modular Oracle Vulnerability scanning and security enhanced system, which can effectively scan and repair known vulnerabilities of Oracle database. Users can customize and extend related functions for specific vulnerabilities. The experimental results showed that the system can effectively detect a variety of vulnerabilities and supplied easy to use automatic repair functions, which provided solution to the serious security problems of the Oracle database for SMEs (small to medium-sized enterprises).

articleTitle: Soft-target Model Predictive Control for PMSG-based Wind Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Among various renewable energy technologies, wind power is one of the most popular one due to its multiple benefits. Wind power is produced by wind generators, permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG)-based wind generator is popular for its advantages such as gear-less, high efficiency, and low cost. However, because of the stochastic nature of wind, the effective control of PMSG-based wind generator is a challenging task. In order to address this issue, in this paper we propose an optimal control method for control of PMSG-based wind generator. In this method, model predictive control (MPC) approach is utilized, which enable the optimal control of control of PMSG-based wind generator. In addition, considering the highly uncertainty in wind speed, we introduce the concept of soft-target control, which makes the proposed control method more practical. Simulation results validate the performance of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Data Cage for Traffic Administrative Law Enforcement Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the overall deployment of comprehensively implement the rule of law, there is an urgent new and higher requirement in regulating law enforcement behavior and improving the law enforcement supervision and management level. In order to realize the administrative law enforcement and supervision of "standardization, intelligence, Informatization", it is urgent to solve outstanding problems such as supervision and management of the whole process of law enforcement. This paper proposes the use of information technology, based on big data related technology and Bayesian algorithm, through the automatic supervision and early warning and management of law enforcement, to gather the whole process of law enforcement information, from multiple directions, multi-faceted law enforcement data cage, recording the whole process information, keep the power operates in the sun, providing effective support for new model of law enforcement supervision and management.

articleTitle: A Multilayer Collaborative Defense Model Design for Power Dispatching Data Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid, the scale and business application of power dispatching data network are gradually expanding, and the security threats are increasing. Combining with the network structure and the problems faced, this paper proposes a multilayer collaborative defense model design idea, and gives a complete set of implementation method from the perspective of model structure, function and mechanism. The design combines the concept of autonomous defense in the local domain and collaborative defense with the cross-domain, achieving rapid response and disposal of security threats, improving security risk monitoring and overall defense capabilities.

articleTitle: Location of Buried Target with Method of Auxiliary Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: It is a key problem to locate a buried target in UXO detection. The inversion algorithm based on the principle of least squares requires a large number of forward calculations to estimate the position of a target. The method of auxiliary sources (MAS) which can directly locate a UXO-like target is presented here without forward calculation. With a brief description of single dipole model for a UXO-like target, the basis of target location with magnetic field and scalar magnetic potential is deduced theoretically. Auxiliary sources made of elementary magnetic dipoles on a plane are applied to estimate the equivalent scalar magnetic potential from the measured magnetic field. Firstly, the moment of elementary magnetic dipoles is estimated by matching the measured magnetic field with the auxiliary sources modeled field. Then, the equivalent scalar magnetic potential is calculated with these elementary magnetic dipoles without a priori knowledge of the target’s location. Finally, the position is calculated directly with the measured magnetic field and the equivalent scalar magnetic potential. The responses of four UXOs excited by a z-component square transmitting coil are recorded by a 9×9 3-component receiving coil array. With the auxiliary sources on a plane under the measurement grid, the equivalent scalar magnetic potential is calculated precisely. Experimental results show that the measured magnetic field matches well with the auxiliary sources modeled field, and the estimated positions of all targets are highly consistent with the measured ones. The horizontal error is within 2 cm, and the depth error is within 6 cm.

articleTitle: Testability Study of Medium Voltage Rectifier Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The medium voltage rectifier generator is an important part of the ship's integrated power system. It undertakes the task of continuously supplying power to the ship's weapon equipment. The quality of its operation directly affects the stability of the entire power system and affects the combat effectiveness and vitality of the ship. At present, the domestic research on the testability of medium voltage rectifier generators is in its infancy, and the level of fault diagnosis and prediction of generators is not high. In this paper, FMECA is carried out on a medium voltage rectifier generator of a certain type of ship, and the typical fault mode is sorted out. Combined with the test related requirements, the evolution characteristics, symptoms and precursors and test parameters of various faults are analyzed to form the fault mode set, which lays a foundation for subsequent test design work.

articleTitle: Relation Classification via CNNs with Attention Mechanism for Multi-Window-Sized Kernels
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Relation classification is an important ingredient task in the construction of knowledge graph, question answering system and numerous other natural language processing (NLP) tasks. With the application of deep neural networks (DNNs) such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs), relation classification task has achieved satisfactory results. However, many proposed models can not take well advantages of multiple window sizes for filters in CNNs and finally hurt the performance of this task. Moreover, unlike public and general dataset that has a large quantity of instances from natural languages or daily conversations, the performances of many deep neural networks with high complexity are not well enough for a small corpus in specific fields. To work out these problems, we propose a novel CNN model with attention mechanism for multi-window-sized kernels to capture the most important information and test our system not only on a general dataset of SemEval 2010 but also on a small dataset built from Chinese fundamentals of electric circuits textbook artificially. The experimental results show that our system outperforms the baseline systems for the SemEval 2010 relation classification task and validate the effectiveness of CNN on the specific Chinese small corpus relation classification task.

articleTitle: Cinnamomum Camphora Classification Based on Leaf Image Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Plants play a very important role in our daily life providing us with food and oxygen. It is necessary to build an aut omatic system for recognizing plant Convolutional neural netw orks (CNNs) have become effective identification method especial ly in computer vision in recent years because they achieved outst anding performance on different tasks, such as image classificatio ns. In this paper, we have shown performance comparison of usin g the seven pretrained deep convolutional neural network(Alexne t, Googlenet, Resnet50, Resnet101, Inceptionv3, Inceptionresnetv 2, Squeezenet) that employed fine-tuning technique to retain the l ast three full connection layers and get the classication model. We applied our method to Cinnamomum Camphora leaf dataset clas sification,.the experimental results showed that the proposed met hod is quite effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Study on Overflow Characteristics and Measurement System of UHVDC Grounding Pole
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The leaked DC current on the grounding pole could cause a huge loss to the power equipment, etc. What's more, the leakage current is difficult to measure directly. However, the current research has not yet had a good measurement of the current in the ground. In order to monitor the distribution of surface current near the grounding pole. Firstly, this paper constructed a calculation model for the distribution law of ground current of the straight-line grounding pole under the monolayer soil model, and the cross-shaped grounding pole under the mixed soil model, then obtained the current density between 0-50A/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Secondly, design and develop the grounding current distribution measurement system based on electromagnetic induction and wireless communication principle. This system is capable of capturing and measuring weak current in the ground, and it can transmit current data by GSM. Finally, the grounding environment simulation platform was built and the practicality of the measurement system was measured and verified.

articleTitle: The Guidance Strategy for Maneuvering Target with Phased Array Radar Seeker
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the phased array radar seeker (PARS) in the long-range detection tracking high-speed large maneuvering target exists slow response characteristics, the idea of integrated guidance strategy based on line-of-sight angle rate (LOSAR) feedforward compensation and LOSAR extraction model for two-channel is put forward, which can accelerate the response speed of PARS and keep the target within the beam angle range. In this study, the extended kalman filter (EKF) with a constant command maneuver model is used to estimate feedforward compensation LOSAR and target acceleration. The estimated LOSAR is feedback to the control-loop LOSAR output point of PARS, thereby improving the tracking velocity of the beam control system effectively. The estimated target acceleration is used to calculate the proportional guidance law, thereby improving missile guidance precision. In the simulation, Effect of the integration guidance strategy of PARS on tracking performance with the EKF is investigated. Simulations indicate that the proposed strategy and method are accurate and have certain practical value in engineering.

articleTitle: Influence of Different Gas Parameters on Sensitivity of Thermal Expansion Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the effects of gas heat capacity, thermal conductivity, viscosity coefficient and pressure on the sensitivity of thermal expansion fluid gyro were studied. The temperature field and flow field of sensing component were calculated by using COMSOL software. The flow velocity decreases with the increase of specific heat capacity, thermal conductivity of the working gas. But the flow velocity increases with the increase of pressure in the cavity. there is no significant change in flow velocity under different viscosity coefficients. The sensitivity of thermal expansion flow gyro increases with the increase of specific heat capacity of working gas and pressure in the cavity. But the sensitivity decreases with the increase of thermal conductivity and viscosity coefficient of the working gas.

articleTitle: Design of Equal Potential Integral Detection Device for High Voltage Electric Energy Metering Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the self-boosting bipolar double-winding voltage transformer and the zero-flux LPCT current transformer are used to develop the equipotential overall error detection device for high voltage energy metering equipment. The device comprises a three-phase programmable power source, a three-phase integrated high-voltage energy metering device detection calibrator, an adaptively adjusted high-voltage equal-potential current transformer and a double-secondary winding bipolar voltage transformer. It solves the problem of secondary leakage current of standard current transformer and meets the overall inspection requirements of high-voltage energy metering device.

articleTitle: A Conceptual Framework for the Trusted Environment of E-commerce Transaction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a conceptual framework for the trusted environment of e-commerce transaction (TEET) from multiple perspectives according to the literatures of online trust theories. The framework aims to guide how e-commerce establishes a trust transaction environment in practice and help e-commerce reach its full potential. It elaborates the basis of building a trusted transaction environment for e-commerce, including principles, elements and dimensions. The principle puts forward the purpose and goal of TEET. The element is a five-factor model, which summarizes the main content of the TEET. The dimension is the perspective of specific and in-depth analysis of the trusted e-commerce transaction environment, including stakeholder perspectives and transaction process perspectives.

articleTitle: Disguising Gait Detection and Recognition Based On Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In a standard gait recognition model, the disguising gait sequence will lead to error recognition. A disguising gait detection and recognition model is proposed in this paper. We proposed a new gait cycle detection method based on the variation curve of distance between the ankles. And we introduce the polynomial fitting method to filter the noise of the curve. A model-based fusion feature representation is used in the model, which is combined the static and kinetic features extracted from the skeleton of the human body. A LSTM-based autoencoder network is introduced to encode the feature sequences to a single feature vector. The disguising detection is conducted by calculating the similarity of the feature vectors of the contiguous gait cycles. In the normal gait recognition module, a parallel deep learning network is adopted to improve the feature extraction ability and accuracy of the recognition model. The effectiveness of the proposed model is evaluated on two gait datasets, which are acquired by Kinect sensor. The experiment results demonstrate the proposed model is capable of disguising gait detection, and has a relatively high recognition rate.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Operation States of Dry-type Transformers in the Middle Route of South-to-North Water Diversion Project Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the consideration of practical application, an index system of evaluation based on the standard and regulation for dry-type transformer is proposed. According to the characteristics of index system, the fuzzy matrix on indicator evaluation and the remark set could be established. Meanwhile, the weight based on experts` remark and the comprehensive fuzzy evaluation matrix abiding by layered theory could be constructed. Then, the mathematic model of operating evaluation for dry-type transformer could be established. Furthermore, the result could be tackled by the fuzzy method of distribution, and the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process adapted to the evaluation of dry-type transformer operation is proposed. As is demonstrated by the engineering project , the method is practical and the result obtained by the method is of great feasibility and comprehensive. Therefore, the method has a great reference value for the construction of maintenance plan.

articleTitle: Translation line UAV inspection Image quality assessment based on Salient edge Blur Metric
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The recent development of UAV in translation line inspection leads to more efficient inspection than human. The image quality of UAV is an import rule to judge the UAV inspection effectiveness. A global and local features fusion based method is presented for UAV image quality evaluation in this paper. For the evaluation of overall quality of image, it combines sharpness index in frequency domain and the distribution density and orientation features of edge lines in space domain to judge the existence of the camera shake blur. And the average width of salient edges is analyzed to determine the blur degree of local details in image. Finally, this evaluation method is verified effectively through many inspection images. It shows its effectiveness and robustness under various complex background and different contents of the image, and the evaluation result is consistent with 5 standards of subjective evaluation. So the method will be suitable to the intelligent recognition and analysis.

articleTitle: Coverage-Based Variational Generative Decoder for Abstractive Text Summarization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Neural abstractive summarization models, based on the attentional sequence-to-sequence model, can generate simple summarization from source text. However, these models inevitably face with repetition problem, and ignore the rich structure information contained in target summarization. To alleviate these problems, we propose a generation model that combines the coverage mechanism and neural variational inference to make full use of all information in sentences. First, we employ Variation Auto-Encoders(VAEs) for generating latent variables, which obtain the latent structure information in target summarization. Second, we introduced coverage mechanism in final decoding process, which is expected greatly improve the weights of those important parts in the encoder and effectively reduce repetition problem. Abstractive summaries are generate by combining the generated latent structure information and the coverage information. Experimental results on LCSTS dataset show that our model outperforms baseline methods.

articleTitle: Power off Punctuality and Lithium Battery Pack Equalization Method based on STM32+AD7280A
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the application of current equipment in Beidou satellite and other aerospace fields, a power-off punctual system with STM32F103 and AD7280A as the core was designed. When the main power supply was cut off, the lithium battery pack continued to supply power and ensured that the output remained stable during the switching process. Used LTC4359 and MOSFET to build switching circuit, realized stable switching of power supply-battery, battery-power input and make system anti-backflow. The AD7280A was used to collect each lithium-ion battery voltage and temperature and the current sampling circuit was used to accurately measure the battery parameters.
