Through the analysis of the ship's combat performance index and the factors affecting the operational effectiveness of the ship equipment, a single ship effectiveness evaluation model is established, and then the prospective theory is introduced to establish the expected effectiveness model of the ship system. With the goal of maximizing the expected effectiveness of the ship system, various constraints are proposed based on practical problems. The particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the multi-ship level repair plan model, which is helpful for decision makers to develop a scientific and reasonable ship level repair plan.

articleTitle: Coverage Problems in WSNs: Current Development and Key Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are composed of a series of sensors deployed in a certain location, which have been widely used in industrial, environmental, military, and health fields in recent years. The node deployment of sensors provides coverage for the area of interest and ensures the connection and communication of the wireless network. The coverage problem was investigated thoroughly in the literature and several algorithms and techniques were proposed. This paper summarizes the status of the research, different types of coverage, common sensing models and optimization algorithm used in coverage problems.

articleTitle: Test Evaluation of Emergency Communication Network Planning Based on Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: At present, Tactical Internet has become an important part of the new generation mobile communication support system in the battlefield of our army. Network planning is the core link of the organization and application of Tactical Internet equipment. It is not only an important guarantee to achieve efficient and smooth command ,but also an urgent problem to be solved when mobile communication equipment is equipped with troops. Therefore, paper attempts to introduce artificial intelligence technology to design a scientific and reasonable experimental evaluation method. Developing the test appraisal and evaluation activities based on intelligent Emergency Communication Network planning and an attempt is made to explore the technical approach of artificial intelligence test appraisal and evaluation under the current military intelligence prospects.

articleTitle: Invisible-Guardian: Using Ensemble Learning to Classify Sound Events in Healthcare Scenes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The dramatic increase of senior population worldwide is challenging the existing healthcare and support systems. Whereas traditional home health monitoring systems (like video-based method) often cause users’ discomfort with severe feeling of privacy intrusion, which impedes the popularity of home health monitoring systems. Then Invisible-Guardian is proposed, an ensemble learning (EL)-based high-efficiency auditory information centered healthcare system for the elderly at home. The system collects everyday sound, like door open and close through a sound sensor array arranged indoors. Information such as the current event type is obtained after preprocessing, extracting features, classifying with the EL and supplemented by the inertial sensing units. If an emergencies event occurs, such as fall, the information will be sent to the doctor and relatives immediately, which greatly protect the daily life safety of the elderly living alone. The feasibility of the system is verified by human activity recognition experiments, and the recognition accuracy reaches 94.17%. Compared with the traditional home health monitoring method, it not only reduces the cost burden of hardware equipment, but also monitoring elders’ daily life with less feeling of privacy intrusion. what’s more, it minimizes the amount of data and ease of calculation, which improves the efficiency of home health monitoring for the elders and more favorable to the safety of the elderly living alone.

articleTitle: Online Path Planning of Mobile Robots Based On Elliptic Influence Domain and Improved Artificial Potential Field
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, an elliptic influence domain and improved artificial potential field method (EID-IAPF) is proposed for online path planning of mobile robots. This paper has established a collision risk area model and has obtained dynamical elliptic influence domain of obstacles. Also, the velocity-repulsive potential equation is introduced to modify the traditional artificial potential field method (APF), which improves the capacity of path planning of the robots. Finally, a simulation of complex environment with narrow channels is constructed to verify the feasibility of the method, and to compare with the traditional APF. It proves that EID-IAPF can effectively improve the path planning efficiency of mobile robots.

articleTitle: Linear Distribution-based SHADE with Variable Population Size
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In adaptive DE algorithms, the parameter p is used to strike a balance between the algorithm's exploration and exploitation abilities. In this paper, an effective method for generating a suitable p value is proposed. The probability distribution function (PDF) of p is viewed as a linear function. At the start of the evolutionary process, the PDF of p is a linearly increasing function. Hence, there is a high probability of p having a high value. With successive generations, the PDF of p changes to a linearly decreasing function, and there is a high probability of p having a smaller value. Furthermore, a method for allowing a variable archive size is also proposed. After each generation, the archive size for the next generation is computed. If the archive size has to be reduced, the worst-ranking individuals are deleted from the archive. The accuracy of the proposed method is computationally compared with those of eight other advanced DE variants using benchmark functions from the IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation 2017. The results show that the proposed algorithm achieves the best performance among all the variants for most of the benchmark functions in the case of 30-dimensional problems.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Cups
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of society, thermos cups are not only used as containers for drinking water, but also have been designed by much more new and scientific functions. They may be designed of showing temperature and indicating safely. Besides, in the design of this paper, the cup can also have the function of heating. In this paper, intelligent cups were designed. These cups could monitor water temperatures in real time. There was a fingerprint unlocking device that ensures safe drinking in the cups. Wireless transmission function was a convenient function.

articleTitle: A Convex Hull Based Approach for MIMO Radar Waveform Design with Quantized Phases
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this letter, we focus on designing constant-modulus waveform with discrete phases for the multi-input multi-output (MIMO) radar system, where the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) is maximized in the presence of both the signal independent clutter and the noise. Because of the NP-hardness of the above formulated problem, we take advantage of successive convex hulls of the discrete feasible region to relax the original hard optimization problem to a sequence of several continuous quadratic programming (QP) subproblems. Compared with the conventional SDR technique, the proposed method yields approximated solutions with lower computational costs. In the final part, several numerical simulations were taken to prove the effectiveness of the proposed methody.

articleTitle: Walker robot structural design and performance analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low freedom of movement and poor operability of patients with traditional rehabilitation therapy, a walking robot with pelvic support function is designed. Firstly, the implementation of six degrees of freedom of pelvic support mechanism and kinematics calculation are introduced. Secondly, the working space and the dexterity of the movement are analyzed within the normal range of motion. Then, the force of the patient during exercise is calculated through various experiments. The certification body can satisfy the patient's exercise requirements in six degrees of freedom and provide feedback force when the patient deviates from the normal range of motion.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation of the Early Warning System for Hypersonic Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The hypersonic vehicles have the characteristics of high flying height, high speed and strong maneuverability. Current early warning systems typically allocate resources only for conventional targets, and there are few resource allocation methods for hypersonic vehicles. In this paper, the Markov model of hypersonic vehicles is established based on the motion characteristics of the target, and an early warning resource allocation method based on hidden Markov model is proposed. Among them, based on the information entropy, the information generated by the consumption of unit resources is used as the objective function of resource allocation, so that resources can be used reasonably. Finally, the validity and feasibility of the proposed model are verified by case study.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Trip Accident of Generator Set in Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To improve and maintain the operation stability of the synchronous generator is one of the basic conditions to ensure the economic and safe operation of the power system improve and maintain the stability of the synchronous generator. Excitation fault often cause unstable opertation of generator, even tripping, so we have to attach importance to it. This paper took the example of a tripping accident of XX power plant, analyse the process of tripping caused by adjusting excitation not timely after non-plan switching automatic excitation to manual excitation. And we discussed the theories of power angle characteristics and leading operation, studied on stability limit of generator opration, in order to analyse the principle of losing stablily. Meanwhile, we verified the inevitability of accident by loss-of-excitaion criterion. Besides, basing on Matlab we conducted the fault simulation, which confirmed the correctness of analysis. At last, we brought up some reasonable suggestions on avoiding this kind of accident.

articleTitle: Study on Sensitive Mechanism and Numerical Simulation of Thermal Expansion Fluidic Gyroscope in Three-Dimensional Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the sensitive mechanism of thermal expansion gyroscope in 3D model is studied. The three-dimensional model of thermal expansion gyro is established, and the temperature field and flow field in gyro cavity are calculated by COMSOL Multiphysics software. The results show that the temperature field is distributed symmetrically in the cavity with angular velocity applied. The temperature between thermistors will change due to Coriolis force. In the range of ±25rad/s, the temperature difference rate is 3.426×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>K/rad/s and the nonlinearity is 7.87% with the range of ±25rad/s.

articleTitle: Design of building equipment Internet of things system based on blockchain technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: At present, with the rapid development of Internet of things technology, there are more and more intelligent devices connected to the Internet of things, which are faced with many problems such as unsafe data, easy disclosure of privacy and difficult sharing of data. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a flat and center-less building equipment Internet of things system based on blockchain technology, so as to better realize accurate perception, reliable transmission and intelligent processing of the Internet of things. The application of blockchain technology and Internet of things technology in intelligent buildings ensures data security, improves system operation efficiency and provides a new method to solve the problems of Internet of things.

articleTitle: Design and Development of DL850E Data Acquisition Software Based on VXI-11
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A type of ground-to-air equipment needs to collect a lot of signals during product overhaul. With the continuous development of deep-repairing, the test equipment can not complete all the signal processing of the product. It needs a multi-channel oscilloscope to acquire the key parameters of the test data. Designing automatic data acquisition and processing software based on MFC through the establishment of multi-channel Yokogawa oscilloscope and Ethernet communication method through Ethernet. The results show that the industrial computer can remotely use the DL850E FTP server to collect and store product data through the VXI-11 protocol, and automatically upload it to the IPC to classify and store the collected multi-channel dynamic time domain voltage signals.

articleTitle: Study on Buffering and Motion Control of Quadruped Explorer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To address the problem of insufficient driving capacity of wheel explorer in rugged terrain, a quadruped explorer with 12 DOF was proposed. The dynamic model of quadruped explorer was established in gazebo, the integrated method of buffering and motion control was verified through simulation which showed that the landing impact upon explorer landing leg was significantly reduced and the explorer gait motion was both stable and flexible.

articleTitle: Towards the Development of Framework for Semantic Web Interface
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This research work will focus exclusively on the evaluation of the ‘Semantic Web interface’ and to identify the gap in these days’ research approaches, to propose a diverse way out to advance the ‘semantic web interface’. Semantic Interface, refers to user’s language that is been called as the product of interactions by the web and semantic interpretation. The interaction abounds in natural language and it might be establishing the subsystems of grammar. In this paper, main focused is to examine models and identify the dimension, wherever research is lacking. As described, the semantic interfaces worked mainly on the user’s input and linked that input with the data stored in the back-end and obtained the most accurate and demanding results. At the initial level, in this paper, described the approaches carried out so far in the field of the semantic interface. Subsequently the evaluation, so that will be able to identify how much it developed up to this moment, how much development prerequisite and how much development required. Then, define the entire missing domain. Our motivation for this work is based on the advantages offered by the semantic web.

articleTitle: Study on Sensitive Mechanism of Micro Jet Angular Velocity Sensor Based on Fluid-solid Coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Fluid-solid coupling analysis is carried out for the sensitive mechanism of micro-jet angular velocity sensor. The fluid-structure coupling method based on ANSYS and CFX is used to calculate the distribution of gas velocity at different input angular velocities at the thermal resistance wire in the angular velocity sensor. The results show that the gas velocity at the two symmetrical thermistor wires is equal at rest; the deviation of gas velocity is proportional to the angular velocity in the range of 0°/s to 60°/s; and the difference of gas velocity at the two symmetrical thermistor wires increases with the increase of angular velocity. Fluid-solid coupling analysis opens up an effective way for optimum design of micro jet angular velocity sensor.

articleTitle: A Multi-rate Fast Model for Modular Multilevel Converter Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) topology obtains more attention recently in the field of high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission for its several advantages. However, the detailed model of MMC with a large number of switch components leads to slow simulation speed and affect the quick validation for new-designed MMC system. This paper presents an alternative model using arm equivalent circuit method and multi-rate processing strategy to speed up the simulation. The result of the proposed method shows 19.4 times acceleration than the detailed model when adopting the proposed model, demonstrating the practicability of this modeling method.

articleTitle: Application and Simulation of Energy Storage Device
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Energy storage can effectively realize demand side management of power system, eliminate peak and valley difference between day and night, smooth load, and promote the application of renewable energy. Therefore, energy storage technology has become an important part of power system operations and received sufficient attention in recent years. This paper introduces several energy storage technologies and compares their advantages and disadvantages, as well as the research trends on them at home and abroad. In addition, to analyze the adjustment of the storage system for power generation under the circumstances of disturbance, a simulation, which is established with PSCAD, is carried out on a renewable-energy-supplied, isolated system, in which there is or isn't an energy storage system when a disturbance occurred in the supplied side. The result shows that the energy storage system is beneficial for the stability of the new-energy-supplied system.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of DFIG During Grid Fault
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A stability analysis model is established for DFIG (doubly-fed induction generator) with power grid fault to study its stability. The control strategy is proposed adding damping controller to the rotor side control of DFIG. It still analyzes the fault ride through ability of DFIG under different crowbar impedance. The simulation results show that the low voltage ride through ability of DFIG can be effectively improved by adding the damping controller and selecting the appropriate crowbar impedance value. The operation of wind turbine is realized safely and steadily during power grid fault.

articleTitle: A modular CubeSat concept for on-orbit assembly on the space station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to complete the on-orbit assembly of microsatellites operated by astronauts on the space station and carry out on-orbit service and space tests, the modular CubeSat concept is proposed by combining the concept of standardized modular assembly with the CubeSat technology, and then the CubeSat building system is upgraded from board-level modular assembly to functional modular assembly. Firstly, on the basis of the functional independence and physical independence, the CubeSat is divided into several functional blocks having standard structure and interfaces, and the symmetrically arranged female-male-female standard interface is used to realize flexible assembly between adjacent blocks. Secondly, two kinds of mechanical docking interface are introduced and their advantages and disadvantages are analyzed in detail. Thirdly, the theoretical mechanical analysis, finite element calculation and prototype tests are carried out on the mechanical docking interface. The experimental results show that the precision and strength of the mechanical docking interface can meet the assembly requirements on the space station. The proposed modular CubeSat concept and standard mechanical docking interface are compatible with the traditional CubeSat structure, without occupying its internal space, and can realize the modular assembly of CubeSat.

articleTitle: Design of Multifunctional Bracelet Detecting Alcohol
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: multi-functional alcohol detection bracelet is very useful today. Its circuits are designed and rely on single chip microcomputer. When you are drunk, the alcohol detection module can monitor the alcohol. And the concentration of alcohol value is sent to the LCD liquid crystal display screen in real time. This ability can detect the content of alcohol in human blood. This bracelet is multifunctional, which means both timing and alcohol testing functions.

articleTitle: An Optimized Residual Network with Block-soft Clustering for Road Extraction from Remote Sensing Imagery
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: the task of road extraction from remote sensing imagery faces many challenges, traditional methods require complex extracting processes with relatively low precision. Deep learning methods such as convolutional neural network, VggNet, AlexNet, GoogleNet can obtain higher accuracy of road extraction, but requires lots of computing resources, training time and unsatisfactory real-time performance. Based on the reasons mentioned above, this paper proposes an optimized residual network with block-soft clustering (ORNBSC) for road extraction from remote sensing imagery. The block-soft clustering module aims at extracting essential features from satellite images and reducing the dimensionality, therefore accelerating the extraction speed. Meanwhile, the residual neural network module to improve the accuracy of extraction. Groups of experiments using Massachusetts roads dataset demonstrate that the ORNBSC model achieves better performance than traditional methods on precision of road extraction from remote sensing imagery.

articleTitle: A visual saliency based sample augmentation method for image patch similarity comparison
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a sample augmentation method for Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) based image patch similarity comparison methods, which have presented obvious superiority compared with the conventional methods. In our method, we augment the learning samples by pre-processing them with their visual saliency maps. By using the saliency enhancement samples rather than the raw samples, the trained CNN models are more robust to the background changes and disorderly minor interferes, and therefore achieve higher comparison accuracy. In the experiments, we test our method by combining it with the 2-channel CNN model, and then compare with the primary 2-channel CNN, Siamese and Pseudo-Siamese CNN models. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method: it makes the learning networks obtain higher comparison accuracy and have stronger stability at the same time.

articleTitle: Construction of IT Communication Enterprises’ Network Capability Based on High-order Dimension
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the lack of research on the dimension of IT communication enterprises' network capability, at the same time, there is a lack of empirical research on the dimension of network capability. Therefore, this paper proposes a high-order dimension model of IT communication enterprises' network capabilities, and uses the sample data of 262 Chinese IT telecommunication enterprises to carry out the structural equation analysis for the competitive models. The results show that the high-order dimension model has very ideal fit statistics. The network capability’s higher-order dimension model proposed by the research has great significance to improve the network capability of IT communication enterprises in China and can improve their competitive performance.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Simulation of Automobile Tailgate Electric Pole
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Electric pole is an important equipment to automatically open or close the tailgate of vehicle. To make its structure compact, a planetary reducer with fewer teeth is designed for the electric pole. Then, the mechanical and electrical analysis is applied to the electric pole. Mechatronics simulation is carried out in Matlab and the results show that the electric pole designed can reach specified angles.

articleTitle: Analysis of vibration characteristics for cam absolute gravimeter via improved MEEMD-HHT method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An accurate determination of gravitational acceleration has been playing an important role in the areas of metrology, geophysics, and geodetics. Vibration interference is the main factor affecting the accuracy of absolute gravity measurement based on optical interferometry. A novel research on vibration characteristics for cam absolute gravimeter was proposed with the improved MEEMD-HHT method. After the adaptive decomposition of the measured signal, the vibration data was analyzed and studied with the time-frequency spectrum and energy spectrum. Experimental results show that this method can restrain mode mixing effectively, and accurately obtain the energy distribution of each frequency band of vibration. This research can improve the accuracy of absolute gravity measurement and lay the foundation for the design of high-precision vibration absorber.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a new type of Marine Engine Room Alarm Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: an engine room alarm monitoring system is a core part of ship’s Marine Automation System. The level of designing and implementing the system is very crucial for the safety and the sound operations of a ship. Therefore, the system should be effective and reliable. In this paper, the structure of the engine room monitoring and alarm system was designed, including hardware and the software. The program of PLC and SCADA designed by the TIA portal software was employed to implement all monitoring and alarm functions.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning for the Fighter Theater
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The Fighter Theater is an AI game in which heroes of the two sides compete against the opposite side by finding energy stones or fighting against enemy heroes based on state-machine algorithm. We propose new strategies to heroes from each side and modify the state-machine algorithm to increase the confrontations of the game environment. Besides, inspired by deep reinforcement learning, we use convolutional neural network to model Q-function and implement Deep Q-Networks with experience replay to train one side of the game. Experimental result demonstrates despite the high dimensionality of raw pixel input, the side with Deep Q-learning can boost the performance of heroes by finding an optimal policy and is capable of outperforming the opposite side that is controlled by the state-machine algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on News Value Feature Item Based on User Attention
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the update of network technologies and the large increase in the number of news releases, it is more important to choose news topics that are more in line with the audience entry point and higher news value. Based on the random forest algorithm, this experiment utlizes the news value knowledge system to construct the news value feature items, and formulates the algorithm to quantitatively calculate the feature importance of the new value feature items to provide a more accurate and usable method for the research of news value prediction, which can help journalism works better and more effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Time Concealed Channel Technology of Cloud Computing Platform Based on Shared Memory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Security issues severely restrict the development and popularization of cloud computing. As a way of data leakage, covert channel greatly threatens the security of cloud platform. This paper introduces the types and research status of covert channels, and discusses the classical detection and interference methods of time-covert channels on cloud platforms for shared memory time covert channels.

articleTitle: Adaptive back-stepping tracking control of the hypersonic vehicle with input saturation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper studies the tracking problem of hypersonic vehicles subjected to external disturbances, modeling uncertainty, and input saturation. The adaptive anti-saturation control scheme is designed based on the first-order command filter, dynamic surface control and auxiliary system. The proposed control strategy not only uses adaptive algorithms to estimate the external disturbance, but also introduces an auxiliary system to solve the problem of input saturation. The stability of the closed-loop system with respect to the proposed control scheme is proved by using Lyapunov theory, and the results of numerical simulations are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Agent-Based Simulation for Function-oriented Satellite
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As an essential part of AI, agent-based modeling depicts the top phenomenon through "bottom-up" dynamic interaction. This paper analyzes the detective function of satellite, explores and gives DSP&SBRIS satellite agents. Then using the system composing by agents simulates detective module of satellite agent. The outcome of which approved that agent based modeling is of great extensibility and agility.

articleTitle: Automatic control of multi-platform anti-submarine torpedo based on discovery probability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The attacingk form of single platform with single weapon and the complexity of the marine environment have resulted in low probability of detection of anti-submarine torpedo, which is difficult to meet the needs of battlefield . By analyzing the maneuverability of submarine and the detection error of transducer, the submarine target hidden area can be determined. By analyzing the anti-submarine torpedo search characteristics, a multi-platform anti-submarine torpedo coverage model based on discovery probability can be established, which can effectively improve the discovery probability of submarines. Based on the multi-platform anti-submarine torpedo coverage model, the automatic control of the multi-platform antisubmarine torpedo simplifies the attack process, improves the discovery probability , and provides theoretical support for the coordinated anti-submarine operations.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi-Rotor UAV Virtual Reality System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Multi-rotor UAVs have important applications in many fields such as military and civilian life, among which quad-rotor UAVs are the most widely used. Because of its non-manner characteristics, the ground staff needs to monitor and guide the flight operations of the quad-rotor UAV through the ground monitoring system. Therefore, how to improve the visualization and interactivity of the ground system and realistically display the flight path is one of the hot and difficult spots in related researches. This paper proposes that using the Unity3D virtual reality development platform to apply virtual reality technology to the quad-rotor UAV flight control system, which has important theoretical significance and practical value.

articleTitle: Sequential Detection of Location Verification Based on Double Thresholds
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Location information is ubiquitous in wireless networks and the authentication of such information is becoming increasingly important. Especially in vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs), authentication of location information is of critical importance to the safety and security of the system vehicles. In this work, we first use sequential detection to the location verification algorithm. We analyze the false positive rate (the probability that a legitimate vehicle is detected incorrectly) and the detection rate (the probability that malicious vehicle is detected correctly) to test the performance of the sequential location verification algorithm. The traditional single threshold detection algorithm has poor detection performance under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). To fill in this gap, we also proposed the double thresholds detection in location verification system. The double thresholds detection technology can reduce the influence of noise on detection performance and make the location verification result more reliable. Experimental results illustrate that the sequential detection of double thresholds based location verification system (SD-LVS) has advantages over other location verification systems (LVSs). The methods in this paper are useful for a series of location-based applications.

articleTitle: A Facial Expression Recognition Methond Based on Improved HOG Features and Geometric Features
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Facial expression recognition plays a very important role in many applications. In order to extract facial expression features better and improve facial expression recognition rate, this paper proposes an expression classification method that combines facial texture features and geometric features. Firstly, an improved HOG operator is proposed to better extract the edge information of the expression texture. Then, using an ensemble of regression trees algorithm to effectively extract facial feature points, and through a large number of experiments, define and select effective expression geometry information. Finally, the expression classification is realized by fusing the improved HOG operator to extract texture feature information and expression geometry information. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm achieves better results than the general texture feature recognition algorithm.

articleTitle: A Geometric Positioning Method of Mine TOA based on Improved Kalman Filter and Parameter Fitting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a large number of equipment existed in the mine roadway, non-line of sight (NLOS) delay of electromagnetic wave propagation will have an adverse impact on the positioning accuracy of time of arrival (TOA) of the mine, which cannot meet the problems of underground emergency rescue, personnel operation management and the construction of mine Internet of things. According to the formation of NLOS, the propagation delay of electromagnetic wave NLOS in roadway is divided into random NLOS delay and fixed NLOS delay. Combined with the characteristics of ranging error caused by the two types of NLOS delay, a geometric positioning method of mine TOA based on improved kalman filter and parameter fitting is proposed. Firstly, the symmetrical double-sided two way ranging (SDS-TWR) is adopted to eliminate the influence of synchronization delay and timing error on TOA positioning accuracy. Then the improved kalman filter algorithm is used to filter the random NLOS delay error of roadway. Finally, parameter fitting and projection geometry algorithm are used to improve the positioning accuracy of the system. The simulation results show that the proposed method has a significant inhibiting effect on TOA positioning error and can realize the effective application of TOA method in NLOS environment of mine.

articleTitle: Positioning of Wheeled Robot on Spherical Tank based on Improved EKF
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of precise positioning of the wheeled robot on the spherical tank, an improved extended Kalman filter (EKF) self-localization algorithm combined with road signs is proposed, and the mobile robot positioning system simulation model is built in MATLAB. Firstly, the spherical tank environment of robot movement is established by using the simulation program, and then, the EKF algorithm is used to establish the state model of the two-wheeled robot on the spherical tank. Besides, the observation model is established by using three parameters: the distance between the robot and the landmark point, the azimuth angle and the relative displacement in the Z-axis direction, then the priori state estimation value is obtained. Finally, the data collected by the external sensor is fused to the priori estimate, and the position of the robot is corrected to obtain an accurate posterior state estimate. The simulation results verify the accuracy and reliability of the positioning system.

articleTitle: Design Puncturing Polar Codes : The Odd-numbered Criterion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: We propose the odd-numbered criterion to design puncturing polar codes and a new puncturing algorithm was put out in this paper. In view of the unreasonable puncturing selection standards, unsatisfactory decoding performance and high computational complexity of the current algorithms, we do many analysis and comparison and find some rules, then we present the odd-numbered criterion, analyzing its' reliability and effectiveness. According to it we design a new algorithm based on correlation coefficient we defined, and the results manifest that the algorithm can greatly improve the decoding error rate performance of the polar code while reducing the computational complexity, it can bring great benefits to the application of the polar code in the digital communication system significantly.

articleTitle: A Numerical Calculation Method for the Response of Loop Antenna to Electromagnetic Pulses
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Combined with the thin wire algorithm and the oblique line algorithm of finite difference time domain (FDTD), the electromagnetic pulse coupling calculation of curved scatters is further studied. At the same time, a new coaxial feed model for calculating thin-wire antenna is proposed. Then on the base of this, the electromagnetic pulse response of loop antenna, which is widely used in practice, is calculated numerically. The loop antenna in free space is compared with the half-loop antenna fed by coaxial transmission line. The results are verified by the method of moments. The results show that the numerical calculation method proposed in this paper is correct. This method can provide theoretical basis and reference data for electromagnetic protection design of loop antenna in vehicle system.

articleTitle: Gradient Tolerance Estimation of Overhauser Magnetometer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Overhauser proton magnetometer is a scalar quantum device for total magnetic field measurement based on the dynamic nuclear polarization (DNP) effect. The earth generates a weak and uniform magnetic field about 18 μT to 60 μT. The magnetic anomaly in the survey area will generate a gradient magnetic field which decreases the accuracy of the magnetometer. The gradient tolerance is the maximum magnetic field gradient that the magnetometer can tolerate. A gradient coil consisting of two circular coils connected in reverse has been constructed to estimate gradient tolerance value of Overhauser magnetometer. The distance between the two circular coils is set as √3 R, where R is the radius of the circular. Calculated results indicate that the uniformity of the gradient can reach 99% in the range of 5×5×11 cm when the radius of the circular R is set as 0.3 m. Proton precession signal and sensitivity of Overhauser magnetometer under gradient field from 0 nT/m to 12000 nT/m are investigated. Beat phenomenon is observed under high gradient field. The experimental results show that under the background field strength of about 54500 nT, the fluctuation of the measurement results increases with the increase of the gradient.

articleTitle: A Functional Test Module Design of a High-speed Interface IP Core
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Technological progress and market pressure force SoC (System on Chip) design companies to adopt higher speed interface to meet the demand of bandwidth for large amount of data transmission. As one of the high-speed communication IP, TEMAC IP can make the FPGA chip itself with the processing function of the Ethernet MAC layer, which greatly improves the transmission rate of the data, but also carries more test challenges. This paper designs a BIST test structure for the FPGA embedded TEMAC IP core. This BIST structure can test the main functions of the TEMAC data sending module, data receiving module, flow control module, the HOST bus and address filter module. The results show that the BIST structure we designed can satisfy the function test requirements of TEMAC through the board-level test.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Index Construction of Electric Power Multi-source Measurement Data considering Spatio-temporal Correlation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The operation of complex AC/DC power grid changes rapidly and dynamically, which objectively puts forward higher requirements for on-line analysis, and it is urgent to improve the basic data quality of power grid. Because of low quality and poor synchronization of the basic data of power grid, it is impossible to accurately map the actual operation of the power grid. At the same time, the cross-system data matching degree is low and the data correlation is poor, so it can not support the multi-scale data analysis for all kinds of applications. In this paper, the associated method of multi-source heterogeneous data in the power grid is studied. Combined with big data's access characteristics, big data storage, big data retrieval and artificial intelligence technology, the high-speed data storage and index architecture of power big data are constructed, and a multi-dimensional index reflecting the associated relationship of operating data is established from the dimensions of time, space, application, device and so on. It is easier to analyze multi-source data, to improve the basic data quality of power grid, which provides effective support for accurate data analysis and evaluation of power grid.

articleTitle: The Method of Approximate Particular Solutions for a Kind of Nonlinear Reaction-Diffusion Equations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the numerical solution of a kind of nonlinear reaction diffusion equations, which describe many important models in the fields of physics, biology and chemistry. A meshless method based on the method of approximate particular solutions (MAPS) and Radial Basis Functions (RBFs) is proposed. Numerical results are compared with the exact solutions and the results of some other proposed methods to confirm the truth of the accuracy and effectiveness of the algorithm. From the numerical examples we can see that the errors are small and the profiles are similar.

articleTitle: An Indirect Location Method for Indoor Target Tracking Based on Single Acoustic Vector Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The traditional capon spectra estimation is not suitable for extracting direction of arrival (DOA) under impulse noise. In the case of tracking and locating a single target with a single acoustic vector sensor (AVS), the extracted DOA may be incorrect at low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), especially when there is an interference source near the target. In order to track and locate the target accurately even when the measurement is disturbed by abnormal values, an improved capon spectra estimator is proposed by combining cubature information filtering (CIF) and gating technology. Finally, the effectiveness of proposed method is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Water Level Prediction of Community Secondary Water Supply Tank Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Compared to the LSTM model, the GRU model can be used to reduce significantly the computational time and the model size without losing the accuracy. For the sake of reduction risk of the insufficient water supply in the community, this paper establishes a GRU neural network model to predict the water level of the water supply tank. This GRU model solves the short-term memory problem in the recurrent neural network , at the same time, in order to speed up the training of the model, the GRU model is trained by the characteristics of the computational cluster based on the distributed framework. The GRU model is validated by a simulated water supply tank system in the laboratory, the example calculation results show that the GRU neural network model has good feasibility and accuracy in the prediction of the secondary water supply tank level in the community water supply system.

articleTitle: Building Tag Systems Based on Advanced Semantic Hierarchical Clustering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An improved method based on semantic analysis and clustering algorithm for building tag systems was proposed. First, Hive is employed to process data. Then, Advanced Semantic Hierarchical Clustering (ASHC), which is an adaptation of Semantic Hierarchical Clustering (SHC), is used to build synonym relationship and hypernym-hyponym relationship of the tag trees and enhance the precision and efficiency of tag systems. In the end, removing some obviously incorrect paths and isolated nodes. For evaluating the performance of the method, the tag coincidence rate, the hypernym-hyponym coincidence rate and the accuracy are used to assess the precision of merging and constructing tag systems. The results show that compared with SHC, the accuracy of ASHC increases 2.7% averagely, and after adjusting tags, these metrics are improved more than 3.9%. Based on this, tag systems with higher precision and applicability can be built.

articleTitle: A New Fuzzy Neural Network Controller Based on Compromise characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For general fuzzy control, it takes time and effort to adjust the controller after determining the fuzzy rules; When the fuzzy controller with correction coefficient changes, the whole rule table will be affected, which can only make some characteristics meet the control requirements of the system. In order to solve these problems, a new type of fuzzy control strategy is designed in this paper. This method can effectively overcome their shortcomings on the basis of retaining the advantages of the above-mentioned fuzzy control, and uses neural network technology to improve the control accuracy and robustness of the new type of fuzzy controller. Through the simulation research of the first-order inertial system with pure delay, the characteristics of the proposed algorithm such as high control accuracy and small jump are verified.

articleTitle: Collaborative filtering algorithm based on user interest change
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The collaborative filtering algorithm can provide personalized service recommendations based on the user's personal interests. In view of the shortcomings of traditional similarity measurement methods for user interest changes, this paper proposes a collaborative filtering algorithm based on user interest changes. When calculating the user similarity, the time penalty function is added to the traditional Pearson correlation coefficient, and then the score prediction is used to obtain the target user's rating data to make recommendations for the user. The improved algorithm can adapt to the change of user interest under the change of time. The experimental results on the MovieLens dataset show that compared with the traditional algorithm, the proposed algorithm can make recommendations for users more accurately.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Discrete Frequency Conversion Soft Start
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high impulse current and low initial torque of three-phase asynchronous motor under the traditional starting modes, the soft starting technology of discrete frequency conversion is adopted to realize the full or heavy load starting of the motor. For the different trigger modes of the thyristor, a five-pulse sequence trigger mode is adopted, that is, five-pulse sequences are used instead of the wide pulse, which solves the problem that the conventional trigger modes cannot trigger effectively. Finally, the system simulation model is built and the hardware system based on DSP is constructed, which verifies the correctness of the theory.

articleTitle: Antenna Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks capture information through convolutional operators. Because of the size limitation of convolution kernels, the feature maps generated by convolutional neural networks have rich local information but lack global information. We present a new convolutional module named Antenna Module to enhance feature maps in convolutional neural networks. It could capture original and global information directly from original images that could be merged into feature maps for making up for the shortcoming of feature maps. We design a series of experiments to study the performance of our module. We mainly used ResNet for our experiments and we also verify our module with Inception.

articleTitle: Stereo vision SLAM system based on ORB
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Vision-based Simulation Localization and Mapping (VSLAM) is divided into front-end and back-end, front-end including visual odometer and loopback detection, and the back-end including optimization and map-building using stereo camera, this paper by using calculation of parallax to calculate image pixel depth, by using the ORB corners to realize feature points extraction and matching, and then apply graph optimization to implement local map optimization, by using Bag-of-Words (BoW) module to complete loopback detection, finally, this paper realizes the ORB angular point-based sparse landmark map. This paper provides the realization of the stereo vision based on ORB, and then discuss the direction of further development on SLAM.

articleTitle: The Reliable and Traceable Design of Fieldbus Network Applied in Nuclear Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Fieldbus technology is a hotspot in automatic area, and it is beginning to be used in the I&C system design of NPP. But the design requirement of NNP is more rigorous the general industry. For the reliable and traceable design requirement for fieldbus network Applied in Nuclear Power Plant (NPP), this paper provides the practical design principle and design process of fieldbus network to guide the engineering application to fulfill the requirements of reliability and traceability in NPP, which include design steps, design document route, reliable structure of fieldbus network and reasonable allocation principle of fieldbus device.

articleTitle: Stress Analysis of Submarine Cable Tension and Torsion Test Device Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to ensure that the tension and torsion test system can complete the normal test of submarine cable torsion, it is very important to analyze the maximum torque that the system can withstand. In this paper, the finite element simulation software ANSYS is used to model the submarine cable tension and torsion test system. The torque of 1kNm, 5kNm and 10kNm is applied to the model and solved. The main force position of the torsion device was evaluated by analyzing the changes of displacement, stress and strain after the model was twisted. The results show that after applying the maximum allowable torque of 10kNm to the submarine cable tension and torsion test system, the system is not damaged, and the displacement, stress and strain changes are consistent with the actual situation, and the work of torsion testing of the submarine cable can be completed. This paper provides a method and data reference for the evaluation of the operating parameters of the submarine cable tension and torsion experimental system.

articleTitle: Detection of Methane Concentration Based on Dielectric Barrier Discharge
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Ordinary ionization type gas sensor for spark discharge occurs on the methane concentration detection and explosion danger, this article puts forward the concentration of methane detection based on dielectric barrier discharge, the fluid - chemical kinetics hybrid method combining software Comsol simulation analysis and study the relationship between the discharge current and methane concentration, and analyzed the voltage amplitude, pole spacing and thickness of dielectric layer's influence on the discharge current, the simulation results show that the discharge current and methane concentrations there is a single value relationship, is expected to reduce the risk of methane concentration detection at the same time.

articleTitle: Research of Intelligent Control of Pump Storage Power Station in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Energy storage is one of the most important parts of the smart grid, and the pump storage power stations (PSPS) which are applied most widely are the largest scale energy storage facilities in China. PSPS can provide positive effects on peak and frequency regulation, improve the electricity quality. Reliability guarantee is made for applying new energy to the power system by PSPS. This paper takes the control system of a large pump storage power station as an example to analyze the intelligent control function of pump storage power station which is put into operation in China southern power grid.

articleTitle: Application Research of AR Holographic Technology based on Natural Interaction in National Culture
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development and wide popularization of computer technology, the most natural interaction modes between human and computer, such as voice interaction and somatosensory interaction, have become a new research field. Interactive AR holographic technology covers three international research hotspots: natural interaction, augmented reality and holographic projection. It has tremendous vitality and market prospects. The new interaction concept of AR holographic technology is that under the background of digitization and the promotion of new technologies of AR and holographic technology, the interaction subject has changed from passive and semi-active to real initiative. Into the comprehensive communication in the virtual world created by AR and holographic technology, people can watch and experience new experience environments in the situation. The protection of the national culture of AR holographic technology is being transformed from traditional technical means into digital protection means. With the help of digital images, three-dimensional display, virtual reality and other technologies, the digital protection, inheritance and development of national cultural heritage has become a research and development hotspot. In this paper, natural interaction, AR technology and holographic technology are applied to the inheritance and protection of national culture. A kinect-based AR holographic interactive display scheme is proposed. Taking Dai culture as an example, the key technologies are analyzed to prove its feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-interference Performance of MBOK under AWGN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: M-ary Bi-Orthogonal Keying (MBOK) is known and has attracted a great deal of attention in recent years. In this paper, According to the analysis method of the system performance under AWGN, it studies the performances of system against broadband interference, single-tone interference and multiple access interference under AWGN channel based the spreading and de-spreading model of MBOK. Furthermore, it analyses the corresponding theoretical performances of error rate and makes a comparison with MOK through simulations.

articleTitle: A QoS Routing Optimization Algorithm Based on Hierarchical Multi-Controller Coordination
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-constrained multiobjective path optimization algorithm (MCOPF). The algorithm is designed for software-defined wide area networks(SDWAN). The control plane and the data plane are separated and logically centralized. The algorithm divides the request flow into delaysensitive stream and other streams. In addition to guaranteeing the QoS (quality of service) of each data flow, the goal of the algorithm design is to ensure the delay-sensitive stream request to the maximum extent and make better use of network resources. In order to improve the effectiveness of the algorithm, we adopt a hierarchical multi-controller collaborative framework, which divides the control plane into multiple levels. The root controller has a global view. The domain controller is only responsible for the control of the regional network. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified from both theoretical and experimental aspects. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional multi-constrained routing algorithm, the algorithm not only guarantees the QoS of the delay-sensitive stream, but also reduces the propagation delay and improves the network load balancing.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Effect of Fading Model on UHF Ground-to-Air Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The parameters of relative delay, relative amplitude and amplitude distribution in the fading model reflect the different fading characteristics of ground-to-air communication, and affect the effect of ground-to-air communication. Through the simulation test of UHF ground-to-air communication, the maximum communication distance under different fading model parameters and the output signal amplitude probability distribution function curve of wireless channel simulator are counted, and the mapping relationship between fading model parameters and output is established. When supported by the measured data, the measured signal can be compared with the probability distribution function curve from the simulation test, and the corresponding fading model parameters can be selected to improve the accuracy of the simulation test results.

articleTitle: Vegetation dynamic in the water level fluctuating zone of Three Gorges reservoir area during 2015-2018 using GF-2
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In Three Gorges reservoir area, vegetation of the water level fluctuating zone (WLFZ) plays a key role in the ecological functions. This study develops a spatiotemporal dynamic analysis method for vegetation of WLFZ using Very High Resolution satellite imagery to monitor the characteristic of vegetation recovery in WLFZ of Three Gorges reservoir area in recent years. Five epochs of GF-2 satellite imagery acquired between 2015 and 2018 were analyzed. Multi-temporal vegetation classification maps against meteorological and hydrological data suggested that vegetation coverage of the WLFZ in the whole study area was not increasing over years (it was increased by 19.3% from 2015 to 2017, but decreased by 29.86% from 2017 to 2018.), but was closely related to the hydrology and meteorology of that year. By the spatial overlapping of multi-temporal vegetation classification maps, three and four years of vegetation no-change maps were obtained for spatiotemporal analysis. It was found that there were two kinds of vegetation recovery coexisting in the WLFZ of Three Gorges reservoir area, one shows stability in time and space, account for 32.27% of the WLFZ in the whole study area; another has great uncertainty and was vulnerable to the hydrology and meteorology factors.

articleTitle: Incremental T2DPCA and KT2DPCA with application to face recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Tensorial two-dimensional principal component analysis (T2DPCA), a novel approach considering the third-order tensors as linear operators on the space of oriented matrices, has been proposed recently and showed better performance than traditional principal component analysis (PCA) in image analysis and recognition. Kernel T2DPCA (KT2DPCA), a nonlinear extension of T2DPCA, is a powerful technique for extracting nonlinear structure from data. However, the original form of KT2DPCA requires storing and manipulating the kernel matrix tensor the size of which is the square of the number of samples. This becomes computationally expensive when the number of samples is large. A similar problem occurs with T2DPCA. In this manuscript, we propose an incremental method to recursively estimate the multiple principal tensors. First, Oja’s rule is extended by replacing the general vector product with the defined tensor product, called T-product, in the tensor spaces. Then, to provide a sparse representation, we consider a tensor-based distance criterion. By combining the above two steps, incremental T2DPCA (IT2DPCA) is formulated. Finally, IT2DPCA is further extended to a nonlinear version by using the general kernel trick in machine learning field, but with a new inner product called inside product defined with the T-product in the tensor spaces, and simultaneously with the general inner product defended in vector spaces. Feasibility of the addressed methods is illustrated by experimental results on face recognition.

articleTitle: Web crawler for fault diagnosis of CNC machine tools
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the era of soaring network information resources, as the foundation and an important part of big data, the role of web crawlers is particularly important [1]. In the field of CNC machine tool diagnosis, the data is widely distributed and the data exists in different forms, but with the deepening of industrial automation, digitization and intelligence [2], enterprises urgently need to realize fault diagnosis and troubleshooting of CNC machine tools. Therefore, it is of great practical significance to collect these data and form a knowledge base of CNC machine tool fault diagnosis [3]. This paper introduces the difficulties faced by CNC machine tool fault diagnosis data collection and countermeasures, the basic concepts of web crawlers, distributed crawlers and machine learning-based web crawlers, as well as their respective architectures and crawling strategies.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Gravity Field on the Sensitivity of Thermal Expansion Fluidic Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the influence of gravity field on the sensitivity of thermal expansion fluidic gyroscope is studied. A three-dimensional model of thermal expansion gyroscope is established, and the influence of gravity field on temperature difference between thermistors is calculated by COMSOL Multiphysics software. The results show that the temperature field is distributed symmetrically in the cavity with angular rate applied, and the temperature difference between thermistors will also change due to Coriolis force. The influence of gravity field on gyro sensitivity increases with the increase of angular rate. The effect of gravity field on gyro sensitivity in 3D model cannot be ignored. In range of ±25rad/s, the sensitivity is 2.055×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>K/rad/s with gravity field, and the nonlinearity is 5.69%.

articleTitle: Control of Flexible Ankle Joint Based on Singular Perturbation Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the strong impact of the biped walking robot from the foot during the walking process and enable the foot to adapt to the bumpy road surface, the flexible ankle joint design scheme of the robot is proposed. The singular perturbation theory is used to reduce the model. Combined with state feedback and The fuzzy PID theory design fast and slow dual controllers. While satisfying the stability requirements of the system, minimizing the internal oscillation of the fast-changing elastic system and eliminating the stable residual tension of the system due to the friction. The experimental results show that the fuzzy PID make the system reach the expected position and stabilize the convergence at a faster speed. The fuzzy PID better adapts to the nonlinearity of the system and compensates for the modeling error. Because of the existence of state feedback fast-changing controller, the singular perturbation system can effectively suppress the oscillation of the system during the adjustment process and after the system is stabilized, and eliminate the residual tension of the spring caused by the friction of the ankle joint after the system is stabilized. The slow-changing fuzzy PID controller with the fast-change state feedback controller can effectively improve the overall response performance of the system. If there is no fast-changing controller, system oscillations are more likely to occur, and the system has longer settling time and greater spring residual force.

articleTitle: Heating furnace temperature based on WM-GA fuzzy control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The heating furnace is a kind of nonlinear, pure hysteresis, large inertia, strong coupling, time-varying system. It is difficult for the traditional PID control to achieve stable and energy-saving effects. Fuzzy control is an effective control method, but depends on expert experience and faces the dilemma that rules are difficult to extract. In this paper, a WM-GA(Wang Mendel and genetic algorithm) algorithm is proposed to extract and optimize fuzzy rules. Firstly, the initial rules are extracted by WM algorithm, then the proximity rules of the initial rules are added to the candidate rule optimization space, and then the GA targeting the engegy-saving function,is using to search in the candidate rules to obtain the final fuzzy rule table. Through simulation analysis, the constructed fuzzy controller has good characteristics.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Automatic Control of Ammonia Injection in Power Plant Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Environmental protection has attracted increasing attention. Coal-fired boilers, as one of the main sources of nitrogen oxides, have adopted low-nitrogen combustion technology in large-scale coal-fired boilers and promoted denitrification technology in order to reduce the emission of NOx. This paper introduces the energy-saving and automatic control technology of the denitrification system after furnace and its subsidiary equipment. Emphasis is laid on the realization of NOx closed-loop control by using open external advanced control system and large data artificial intelligence prediction.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Performance Verification and Comparison of Infrared Thermal Imager
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The detecting performance of the infrared thermal imager is directly affected by the manufacturing process, the onsite detecting environment and the maintenance of the instrument. Therefore, it is of great significance to carry out the performance verification and comparison of the infrared thermal imager. In this paper, the verification and comparison system of infrared thermal imager is introduced, including the related technical parameters of the system. Five test items including accuracy, characteristic measurement range, consistent measurement duration, measurement uniformity and ambient temperature effect are discussed. Combined with the practical application of infrared thermal imager, the data analysis of instrument comparison test is carried out and the causes of the unqualified equipment of different models and manufacturers are summarized. At the same time, suggestions are put forward for the performance verification and comparison of the infrared thermal imager. Through the experimental study on the performance verification and comparison of the infrared thermal imager, the results could provide the important basis for the acceptance and periodic verification and technical support for field testers.

articleTitle: Accelerated Robust Adaptive Control Based on High-Gain Observer of Pantograph-Catenary System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The pantograph-catenary system of high-speed trains is a nonlinear system with complex structure. Continuous and smooth contact between the pantograph and the catenary is an important guarantee for the current acquisition. When the train runs at high speed, the pantograph-catenary system will be influenced by many uncertain factors. A simplified linear model cannot provide true and effective system information for controller design. Therefore, a model close to the real scene and a controller independent on the model are needed to establish to futher improve the current collection quality of system. In this paper, a nonlinear coupling model of two freedoms pantograph-catenary system is established. Considering only getting the output of the system, an accelerated robust adaptive control based on high-gain observer is designed. The tracking control problem of contact force between the pantograph and the catenary with the proposed method can be olved and a better control effect is achieved showned by simulation. It is worth mentioning that the tracking error of the system achieve to be ultimately uniformly bounded with an accelerated decay speed.

articleTitle: Adaptive feed-forward control for seeker based on the disturbance observer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the tracking and stabilization performance, a control method combining disturbance observer and adaptive feed-forward control using parameterization is proposed for seeker stabilized platforms. The system identification algorithm is used to identify dynamic model of the true plant. Then the discrete-time disturbance observer is designed. The feedback loop controller is designed using pole-placement techniques. The recursive least square (RLS) adaptive filter is used to build the inverse model of the feedback control loop and in this way, the feed-forward control is constructed. The adaptive filter and the feedback loop constitute a control scheme with two degrees-of-freedom (DOF). Tracking experiments conducted on velocity command inputs verify the validity of the adaptive feed-forward controller. Experimental results show that this method responses quickly to commands. For a sinusoidal signal at the frequency of 30Hz, the adaptive feed-forward controller can obtain an amplitude response without attenuation and the phase lag is reduced to 11° in contrast with the feedback control whose phase lag is 60°. This method significantly improves the transient performance and is superior to the feedback control alone.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Calibration and Comparison Method of Current-type Live Detection Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The current-type live detection technology has been widely used in the state detection of power grid equipment. However, the manufacturing process of equipment from different manufacturers, the influence of on-site detection environment, and the operation and maintenance of instruments directly affect the performance of live detection equipment. Therefore, it is of great significance to carry out the verification and comparison test research on the performance of current-type live detection equipment. In this paper, the performance testing methods of lightning arrester live detector, transformer core ground current detector and capacitive equipment relative dielectric loss detector are studied. The testing principles and methods of resistive current measurement error, full current measurement error, reference voltage measurement error, basic error , measurement repeatability and anti-harmonic interference performance are given. A performance verification and comparison platform for current-type live detection equipment are established. Combined with the actual application situation on site, the performance parameters of detection equipment from different manufacturers are compared and analyzed. Through the comparison test on the performance for the current-type live detection equipment, an important basis is provided for the arrival acceptance and periodic verification of the lightning arrester live detector, transformer core grounding current detector and capacitive equipment relative dielectric loss detector.

Author Keywords: detection of grounding current of transformer core
relative dielectric loss detection of capacitive equipment

articleTitle: Eddy Current Sensor (ECS) based Derailment Feature Analysis in Molten Iron Transportation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of torpedo tank car in the transportation of the molten iron, the derailment feature analysis technology based on Eddy Current Sensor is proposed. In this paper, it was reconstructed that the contact relationship between wheel pair and rail by the Non-contact measurement method based on Eddy Current Sensor (ECS). It is developed that Early warning system of the hidden danger of derailment to controlled the emergency braking of locomotive for the purpose of prevention. This method has high sensitivity, strong anti-interference ability, non-contact measurement and fast response. It will not be influenced by oil, water and other media.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Calculating Method of the Coal Quantity into Furnace for Thermal Power Unit
