In order to better find out the regularity of wind speed ,the paper use wavelet velocity to decompose the wind speed ,and the neural network with different structures to find the wind speed law in different frequency band.

articleTitle: The individual support system for adapting traditional Japanese (Kampo) medicine - to choose right formulation and track patients’ history-
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Recently the problems faced by people with developmental disabilities have been recognized in Japan. In past studies various education behavior management information systems to help overcome their difficulties have been developed by us. A feature of our systems is to consider each individual's specific difficulties and to try to develop a support program `tailor-made' for each person, rather than using the same support system for many individuals. We now think that such a system could also be developed for patients taking traditional Japanese medicine (Kampo medicine) because formulations (decoctions of mixtures of herbs according to specific formulas) have to be prescribed for each patient according to his/her specific physical characteristics and the progression of illness. At the present time, doctors and pharmacists need a lot of knowledge and experience in this field in order to choose an appropriate formulation for the patient.Using a system we developed, it is easy to gather patient information, e.g., changes in symptoms and feelings, and daily activities including ones usually not seen as important for medical diagnosis. Although the amount of the information may be huge, AI may reveal some patterns and relationships not otherwise obvious. Such information may make formulation easier than just depending on the specific knowledge and experience of the formulator. Another benefit of the system is to make tracking of the patient's history easier. Our preliminary case study suggests that this system could have benefits for both doctors and patients.

articleTitle: A curiosity-based mobile robot path planning method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Curiosity plays an important role in the development of biological cognition, which drives animals to explore unknown environments. Inspired by the research of psychology, this paper proposes a curiosity-based mobile robot path planning method with a mental energy function, which is suitable for robot state evaluation. In our proposed method, a novel mental energy function is designed to guide the learning direction of the robot in navigation task. The experimental results show that the novel method we proposed can effectively guide robot to learn environment information. By changing the simulation environment, robot can reach the end point through re-learning the environment, that reflects the autonomous learning ability and the environmental adaptability of robots.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Wave Transmission Performance of Centimeter Band Ultra-wideband Missile Radome
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The missile radome is an effective structure to protect the missile-borne antenna from damage, which enhances the tolerance of temperature and wind resistance, and maintains the aircraft's contour and aerodynamic performance. Its electrical performance directly affects the index and accuracy of the missile-borne electronic information system. In this paper, the axial wave transmission performance of a centimeter-band ultra-wideband missile radome is analyzed by using numerical simulation approach. Then the parameters such as the wall thickness and dielectric constant of the missile radome are discussed, and the radome structure with excellent wave transmission performance in different frequency bands is optimized. Finally, the basic variation law of the wave-transmission rate with the relevant parameters is obtained initially, which has certain promotion value and guiding significance.

articleTitle: Research on Typical Model of Network Invasion and Attack in Power Industrial Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the operation characteristics of power industry control system, this paper deeply analyses the attack mechanism and characteristics of power industry control system intrusion. On the basis of classifying and sorting out the attack characteristics of power industrial control system, this paper also attaches importance to break the basic theory and consequential technologies of industrial control network space security, and constructs the network intrusion as well as attack model of power industrial control system to realize the precise characterization of attackers’ attack behavior, which provides a theoretical model for the analysis and early warning of attack behavior analysis of power industrial control systems.

articleTitle: Multi-robot Task Planning Based on Improved Distributed Auction Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Distributed decision-making is one of the key methods to improve the autonomy of multi-robots. Based on Automated guided vehicle (AGV) task allocation, this paper establishes a distributed task allocation model considering local communication, AGV power consumption and path conflict-free. The continuous and discrete task space is quantitatively described by Bayesian theorem. Finally, numerical simulation is carried out to verify the feasibility of the proposed algorithm in solving multi-task allocation problem.

articleTitle: A Multi-Dominating-Subtree-based Minimum Connected Dominating Set Construction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Different from the traditional wireless communication network, wireless sensor networks(WSNs) have no infrastructure similar to the cellular network, and nodes can only communicate in the way of "flooding", which is easy to cause the problem of broadcast storm. The energy of wireless sensor nodes is actually very limited, which seriously affects the lifecycle of the whole network. Therefore, the research direction of constructing virtual backbone network in WSN arises at the right moment. In this paper, a minimum connected dominating set(CDS) construction algorithm based on multiple dominating tree is proposed. The algorithm firstly takes the node at the core position in each local area of the network as the root node, and constructs several dominating subtrees in the network. Then, some connector is selected to connect the two subtrees that are not connected to each other. Finally, the redundant dominator is cut off to obtain the final virtual backbone.

articleTitle: Optimal Bidding Strategy of PV-Storage System in the Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In power system, the penetration of renewable energy resources, mainly PV and wind power has grown rapidly. To deal with their inherent uncertainty, energy storage (ES) is seen as the most promising technology. It is urgent and meaningful to exploit the operation strategy of PV-ES system in the electricity market environment. So this paper proposed an optimal biding strategy in day-ahead market and a real-time operation strategy for PV-ES system considering the twofold uncertainty from electricity price and PV output. The optimal model has considered the benefit in day-ahead market, benefit and penalty in real-time operation, and the operation cost of ES. We also constructed the operation model under uncertainty for ES. Case study certificates the necessity of incorporating PV real-time power fluctuation in the day-ahead market. The model can effectively balance the day-ahead and real-time benefi.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring System of four-wheel Drive Robot based on Web and Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of existing four-wheeled robot remote monitoring system, such as poor mobility, complex operation and high consumption, a monitoring system based on web and cloud platform is developed. The system is mainly composed of the perception layer responsible for data acquisition, the transmission layer responsible for data transmission, and the application layer responsible for remote monitoring by users. Among them, the sensor and CPU are used to collect the job information of the robot, and then the collected data is sent to the Cloud Server by MQTT protocol through the MQTT module. The data is rendered from the Cloud Server to the page using TCP/IP protocol and AXJX. The experimental results show that the system has good stability, good real-time performance and ideal monitoring effect. It effectively solves the problems of real-time on-site monitoring and remote monitoring of robot operation information.

articleTitle: Multi-Energy Storage Control Based on SOC for DC-Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to control and use the highly random distributed renewable energy and the load with high demand fluctuation better, the energy storage system must be equipped in the microgrid. In DC microgrids, due to differences between battery energy storage system units, the same charge and discharge rate is likely to cause overcharge or overdischarge of the energy storage battery. In order to extend the life of the energy storage battery, the improved droop control strategy should be used to balance the output of each energy storage unit according to the respective state of charge of the distributed energy storage. Regarding the issue above, this paper introduces a new droop control reference voltage and coordinates the energy storage unit output by adjusting the droop control reference voltage. According to the respective state of charge and output power of distributed energy storage, over-charging of energy storage units can be avoided with low SOC(State-of-Charge) energy storage unit over discharge or high SOC energy storage unit over charge. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by Matlab/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Eliminating Shaking Noise for Defect Detection of Steel Wire Ropes Based on Magnetic Flux Leakage Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this study, shaking noise existing in defect detection of steel wire ropes are discussed based on magnetic flux leakage signals while using a multi-channel Hall sensor array. The causes and features of shaking noise are also studied according to the principle of Hall sensors and distribution of magnetic field. Due to the differences between shaking noise and local flaws signals, a shaking elimination method is introduced. To test its feasibility, the experiment is designed under strong shaking noise when using steel wire ropes with some defects. By calculating the Signal to Noise Ratio, the accuracy and reliability are evaluated. This research provides a new train of thought to promote the liftoff distance of detection device and lengthen the lifespan of the detection device.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Detection System for Artificial Installation of Automobile Parts
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the installation requirement of automobile cushion of automobile parts manufacturer, machine vision technology is applied to collect the image of the detected object through the imaging acquisition module composed of industrial camera, industrial lens and light source in the way of light, machine, electricity and software, and image processing software based on Windows operating system is developed. The images are processed and displayed to realize the intelligent detection of whether the automobile part is installed or not. With The system, the problem of missing parts caused by the manual installation against standard operating procedure will be effectively solved.

articleTitle: High-quality face image super-resolution based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Face image super-resolution has received increasing attention. However, since the face has a lot of fine textures, it is very difficult to rebuild for large upscaling factors. We propose a new method for face image SR, using residul dense block(RDB) as the basic unit and the Inception architecture is combined in the low layers. We use the relativistic GAN and the improved perceptual loss defined by the features before activation.For the large scaling factors, our GAN is progressive both in architecture and training. The network proposed achieves excellent performance in the reconstruction of low-resolution face images, especially under large scaling factors such as 4x and 8x.

articleTitle: Kinematics Analysis and Simulation of the Oral Flexible Surgery Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Continuous robot is a series robot with high flexibility, which is widely used in industrial automation, medical treatment, aerospace, ocean, and other fields. Because the joint axes of the robot designed in this paper are perpendicular to each other, and the robot is driven by wire rope, the traditional D-H matrix method applied to the robot with the connecting rod cannot directly carry out the kinematic analysis. Firstly, the traditional D-H method and the elastic body constant curvature deflection theory are applied to the kinematics modeling of the wire rope driven tandem joint robot, and the mapping relations of its driving space, joint space and operation space are analyzed. Secondly, the three-dimensional working space is drawn in MATLAB, and a prototype is prepared. Finally, the principle prototype test was carried out, and the linear error at the end was less than 2.5mm. The experimental results verified the feasibility of the mechanism design and kinematic model of the robot.

articleTitle: Research on the Shortest Path Analysis Method in Complex Traffic Environment Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: At present, the commonly used maps, such as Google Map and Baidu Map, have basically matured for the visualization of urban roads. However, for the complex environment, due to the limitation of Google's scale and the complexity of its roads, it can only show its geographical location, but it cannot show the details of its internal roads and landmarks. This is not conducive to the people's travel here and emergency rescue operations when accidents occur. Faced with this limitation, this paper expounds the related concepts and algorithms of the shortest path. Aiming at the problem of rescue in the face of accidents, this paper proposes a method of shortest path selection based on GIS, which is verified by simple experiments. The effectiveness of the law, in the face of accidents (such as forest fires), can provide basic support for emergency rescue to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Study on Detection Method of Low Contrast Fabric Defects Image Based on Regional Variation Saliency
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low contrast fabric defect detection accuracy, a new detection method based on regional variation saliency was proposed. Firstly, the cartoon texture model is used to filter the fabric image to remove the yarn texture. Then, the texture features of the image block are extracted to construct a visual saliency map to highlight the defect area. Among them, the texture features are calculated based on the regional variation of the image block. Finally, the threshold segmentation algorithm is used to segment the visual saliency map and obtain the defect area. The results show that this method can detect the defect information in the image of low contrast plain or twill fabric more completely than the existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Point Cloud Power Line Segmentation and fitting algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Power line point cloud segmentation is one of the important tasks of airborne lidar (LiDAR) power patrol. In this paper, it is difficult to segment power line point clouds in the absence of power line point clouds, and the existing algorithm models are not comprehensive. A power line point cloud segmentation algorithm based on two models is proposed. Laser point cloud technology is widely used in transmission line operation and maintenance, and some power lines are often missing in laser point cloud data, which leads to the inaccuracy of traditional power line segmentation algorithms. In addition, at present, the academic circle mainly studies the non-coincident model of XOY plane projection of power line point cloud, but lacks the research on the coincident model of XOY plane projection. In this paper, two power line segmentation algorithms are proposed for two power line models (XOY plane projection is not coincident, XOY plane projection is coincident, hereinafter referred to as model 1 and model 2). Through practical engineering experiments and applications, the robustness and applicability of the proposed algorithm are verified, as well as the insensitivity to the lack of power line point clouds.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Control Systems for Toner Production Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the technical transformation needs of a toner production workshop in Tianjin, the design and implement of control systems for a toner production line is provides in this paper, which is aimed at solving the problem of safety hazard, low automation, slow-speed response etc. The scheme processes from the Chinese national standards of toner production and requirement in environment protection. Based on PLC sensor technology is applied to fit the particularity of toner production, and the scheme improves the level of control system, which includes the sensing of the temperature, pressure, materials' level of the bins and tanks. It also provides a reference scheme of monitoring and control for similar production lines. The effectiveness and reliability of the system is verified in real production.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of LLC Resonant Converter for X-Ray High-Voltage Power
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low frequency and large volume of LCC resonant topology of X-ray high voltage power supply, the main circuit design of X-ray high voltage power supply is realized by the combination of full bridge LLC resonant converter and bidirectional symmetric voltage doubling rectification. Based on the analysis of the working principle of LLC resonant converter and the output characteristics of the voltage doubling rectifying circuit, the fundamental wave equivalent model of the converter is improved. And the parameters of the main circuit are designed with the aim of improving the power supply efficiency, so as to realize the high frequency miniaturization and low ripple of the X-ray high voltage power supply. The simulation results show that the output voltage of X-ray high voltage power supply is continuously adjustable from 60 kV to 180 kV, the highest working frequency can reach 728 kHz, and the ripple rate of output voltage is less than 0.03%. The correctness and feasibility of the proposed topology are proved.

articleTitle: Research on Security Self-defense of Power Information Network Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: By studying the problems of network information security in power system, this paper proposes a self-defense research and solution for power information network based on artificial intelligence. At the same time, it proposes active defense new technologies such as vulnerability scanning, baseline scanning, network security attack and defense drills in power information network security, aiming at improving the security level of network information and ensuring the security of the information network in the power system.

articleTitle: High power microwave interference effect of radar system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the gradual entry of high-power microwave weapons into the battlefield, the accurate evaluation of high-power microwave interference effects has increasingly important practical significance. Firstly, a radar simulation system based on nonlinear RF front-end is established. The interference effect of high-power microwave on radar nonlinear RF front-end and pulse compression processing module is analyzed. It is concluded that whether the interference signal covers the echo signal in the time domain is the main factor of the interference. Secondly, the same-frequency interference signal with different parameters is injected into the system together with the target echo signal to calculate the target detection probability of the radar system under the disturbed state. Based on the probability evaluation criterion and the least squares method, the data is analyzed, and the mathematical model of the interference pulse repetition interval and the radar target detection probability is fitted. The results show that when the power is large enough, the pulse repetition interval of the interference signal and the target detection probability constitute a power function relationship, and the function parameters are linearly related to the interference signal pulse width. When the pulse repetition interval of the high-power microwave and the radar transmission signal reaches a certain ratio, effective interference can be achieved. Under the same duty cycle, the interference effect of the interference signal with high pulse repetition rate is obviously stronger than that of the high pulse width. The suppression of high-power microwaves can significantly reduce the radar detection performance. The model can be used to optimize the interference pulse design and the prediction and evaluation of interference effects.

articleTitle: Development of Spherical Coils for Overhauser Vector Magnetometer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: One of the main challenges for Overhauser vector magnetometer is to design a finite-sized magnetic field coil with minimal size. A spherical coil consisting of limited number of circular coils is proposed here to produce a region of uniform magnetic. Based on the Biot-Savart Law and finite element analysis, the magnetic field of spherical coil is calculated and optimized. With the region of uniform magnetic set as a cylinder with diameter and length of 6 and 11 cm, the diameter and the number of turns of spherical coil have been optimized as 40 cm and 19, respectively. The calculated results show that the non-uniformity of magnetic field is less than 0.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> with the generated magnetic field as 20000 nT, which meets the test requirements. Moreover, the performance of the spherical coil has been verified by experiments. The relative error of the magnetic dip is 0.2%. Properly reducing the bias current can reduce the measurement error, which is the next research to be carried out.

articleTitle: Modified U-Net Architecture for Ischemic Stroke Lesion Segmentation and Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, to improve the accuracy of detection and segmentation, we modify U-Net architecture to address ischemic stroke segmentation and detection, from ISLES 2018 dataset. In this dataset, CT images (in five modalities) and corresponding ground truth created by combining manual annotations are provided. We use shortcut connections in the architecture, which performs as a residual block. In the meantime, to reduce the overfitting caused by the scarcity of training data, we use elementwise-sum and concatenation in the network. We also use the dice coefficient and the Jaccard index to assess our model. Our architecture can be applied to ischemic segmentation and detection of CT images easily by choosing suitable hyperparameters. Experiment results show that our model can segment ischemic stroke accurately, with the dice coefficient between the segmentation given by our network and ground truth is about 0.77 while the dice coefficient of U-Net is about 0.74.

articleTitle: Holiday Travel Pattern Forecast Based On Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper uses multiple machine learning algorithms, such as random forest, SUV, Logistic, decision tree, BP neural network etc. to predict the traffic conditions and environmental conditions for travel pattern forecast, then compare the results to obtain the optimal algorithm for classification prediction. At the same time, a visitor flow forecasting model is built based on the wavelet analysis and ARIMA algorithm to predicts and analyzes the visitor traffic in the tourist scenic spot.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Safety protection system in electric Power Industry Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Power industry control system is an important of national’s key-infrastructure, it’s security is a matter of national strategic security. This paper reviews the factors that affect the reliability of power industrial control, make a in-depth analysis and mining in the Security detection and Safety monitoring, reinforce weak links. At last, make a prospect in power industry control system’s security.

articleTitle: Improved K-means clustering algorithm for screw locking classification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The traditional K-means clustering algorithm is difficult to solve the nonlinear classification problem. In view of this defect, the kernel function is introduced to transform the nonlinear problem into a linear problem, and then the K-means clustering algorithm is used to classify it. This paper take data average as the central point of the kernel function, simplifying the calculation of the kernel K-means. Compared with the traditional K-means clustering algorithm, the algorithm in this paper has higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain Technology in Distributed Generation Marketized Transaction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In open market environment, the number of prosumers is huge, and their self-interest makes them more demanding on fairness, privacy and non-discrimination. Blockchain technology has characteristics of decentralization, transparency, security and credibility. Introducing ideas and technologies of blockchain into distributed generation transactions, makes transactions based on the principle of cryptography, so that the whole transaction will be transparent, safe, non-discriminatory and fully automated, effectively avoiding problems such as low efficiency, high cost and low transparency of centralized transactions. This paper first analyzes the traditional distributed generation transaction architecture and characteristics. Secondly, it proposes a distributed generation transaction architecture based on blockchain technology. Then it describes the specific application mechanism of blockchain technology in intelligent power purchase contract and measurement certification. At last, conclusions of this paper are given.

articleTitle: Subway 3D Bound Limitation Visualization Method Based on Stereo Vision
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: During subway driving, foreign objetcs such as rolling stones, pedestrians may invade subway driving safety bound, which brings safety hazards to subway normal running. One potential method to solve this problem is foreign body intrusion detection technology with 3D bound limitation visualization module. In the paper, we utilize deep learning and stereo vision technology to extract subway track from binocular camera videos, calculate 3D coordinates of subway track and the vertex coordinates of subway safty boundary section at each horizontal position. By connecting these vertices along with subway track’s direction, the bounding section can be obtained. Finally, multiple sections are combined to form a complete safety bound limitation. The proposed method releases a more intuitive and accurate intrusion determination implementation and provides a potential safty solution for subway assisting driving.

articleTitle: A Design of Mandibular Motion Tracking System Based on Video Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In clinical medical research, mandibular motion tracking is an important indicator for the diagnosis of mandibular related diseases. This paper proposes a new mandibular motion tracking system with video processing. Four cameras are used as a multi-vision system to complete the mandibular motion tracking by measuring the checkerboard markers on the face bow, and the tracking system is implemented on the heterogeneous platform of ARM + FPGA. A new checkerboard corner detection algorithm is implemented on FPGA to overcome the challenge brought by the recognition speed improving of the checkerboard mark. While the high-precision 3D coordinate transformation algorithm is implemented on ARM to improve the accuracy of the system. The experimental data show that the system can process images of 1280×1024@91fps in real-time with an accuracy of 60um.

articleTitle: The Design of Embedded Web System based on REST Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high coupling, large resource waste and low expansibility in traditional embedded WEB system development mode, this paper presents an embedded WEB system development design based on REST style. In this paper, data of the system is abstracted as a resource. The front-end initiates a resource request by the improved AJAX request, and calls the RESTful API to realize resource transmission, and the server processes the client requests through the CGI program. The implementation of this scheme improves the versatility and expansibility of embedded WEB system, and reduces the memory cost of server. It also provides a low-cost design method for embedded systems with limited storage resources.

articleTitle: Scheme Recommendation of Regional Wind Power Access System Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: in recent years, with the rapid growth of installed capacity of regional wind power, the impact of wind power Grid-connected has become increasingly prominent. It is more and more important to recommend the optimal access system scheme for wind power enterprises and power grid companies, taking into account all aspects of the impact. Firstly, this paper puts forward the relevant evaluation index of wind power access system, and makes a comprehensive comparative analysis of the influence factors such as economy, reliability, power quality, local absorption, power grid and power supply development adaptability; secondly, according to actual work experience and multi-level verification results, the analytic hierarchy process (ahp) is adopted to assign the weight of each influencing factor. Finally, the recommended method for regional wind power access system based on analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is proposed. The validity and feasibility of the evaluation method are verified by engineering cases.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Cooperative Spectrum Sensing and Wireless Power Transfer in Single-antenna Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In single-antenna cognitive radio, the sensing performance of the primary user (PU) in the fading channel can be improved by antenna cooperative spectrum detection. However, due to simultaneous cooperative spectrum sensing, CR may consume more storage energy, thereby reducing its transmission performance. In this paper, in order to ensure its transmission performance, a scheme of synchronous simultaneous cooperative spectrum sensing and wireless power transmission is proposed, which can harvest radio frequency energy of PU signals to provide energy consumed by spectrum detection. A time-splitting model is proposed to achieve collaborative spectrum detection, energy harvesting and data transmission synchronization. Optimization problems applicable to the scheme were developed to maximize the spectral efficiency of cognitive radio in the synchronous simultaneous cooperative spectrum sensing and wireless power transmission models, limited by the probability of detection and the energy collected. Finally, the optimal distribution factor is calculated to achieve the maximum spectral efficiency, and the conclusion is drawn through simulation.

articleTitle: GAN Network Solves The Problem of Image Segmentation Across Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Since FCN [1] added deep neural network to image segmentation technology, the image segmentation effect has been significantly improved in recent years. For example, the VOC2012 data set has been improved from 40% to more than 80%, and the effect has doubled. . However, the improvement of the effect is only for the training set and the verification set of the same data set. When the crossdata set is verified, the accuracy rate will drop sharply. In response to this problem, we propose to apply the CycleGAN [2] network to image segmentation to learn the style features between different datasets. It turns out that the processing can improve the effect of image segmentation between different datasets.

articleTitle: The Influence Evaluation of Film and Television Works on Social Media Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: China's science fiction feature film The Wandering Earth released in 2019 has achieved excellent box office results and network responses. Based on that, this paper introduces the classic epidemic propagation model of the small world theory of the complex network, and then analyzes the influence of The Wandering Earth on Weibo which is selected as a representative social platform. Comparing the results of analysis and the movie-related marketing data, this paper portrays the law of the dissemination of film and television works from the dimension of social platform communication.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling of Key Data for Ball Mill Load in Cement Grinding Process
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Ball mill load condition directly relate to the quality of cement products, use the production data to establish an accurate mathematical model is helpful to control the ball mill in a stable state. Aiming at the important parameter of cement combined grinding ball mill load, took the production process as the starting point, analyzed control and controlled variables of mill load, a large number of instruments data were collected through OPC technology, after the moving average filter and correlation analysis calculate, obtained the data that could be used for modeling, the ball mill load forecasting model was established by subspace method, simulation demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Torque Optimization Strategy for Pure Electric Vehicles Based on Drive mode Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Recently, with an increasing environment pollution and energy crisis, more and more attention has been paid to new energy vehicles based on electrical vehicle. In this paper, a control strategy of energy management in PEV is proposed. Firstly, the driving mode which is divided to normal mode and power mode is determined according to the relative accelerator pedal opening and its change rate based on fuzzy control. Then, the compensation torque for power mode is calculated based on the fuzzy controller which has 75 fuzzy rules. At last, the simulation shows that proposed algorithm can accurately recognize the drive mode, and it has a more reasonable compensation torque to improve the output motor torque than the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: A Message Clustering Method Based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Message clustering is useful for many security applications, including network protocol simulation, malicious protocol analysis and network protocol conformance detection. However, most of the existing message clustering methods are based on message similarity measurement, and the similarity measurement is often not accurate. To solve this problem, we proposed a message clustering method based on rough set theory. The method consists of preprocessing phase and rough set theory based clustering phase. Firstly, data stream is transformed to packets, and the messages are extracted from the packets. The messages are separated into business messages and control messages. Business messages are relatively easy to analyze, and the control messages are the main targets to cluster. Secondly, control messages are clustered on the basis of position attributions according to rough set theory, and the clustering results are simplified by the size of clusters. Experimental results show that the proposed method in this paper can cluster messages precisely.

articleTitle: Research and Application of GIS in Wisdom Forestry Wireless Sensor Networks Node Location Selection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of wisdom forestry, wireless sensor networks play an increasingly important role. With its powerful ability of space-time information data management, spatial analysis and visualization, GIS technology will provide a scientific and visual geographic information support platform for the application of wireless sensor networks in forest environment. The paper makes use of solar radiation analysis, visibility analysis, and buffer analysis of GIS to help engineers scientifically selecting the sensing node location, and finally develops a 3D wireless sensor networks visualization system based on WebGIS. The system realizes the map display of the space-time information, which is beneficial to manage sensor nodes efficiently.

articleTitle: Research on Sparse Code Shrinkage denoise in Underwater 3D Laser Scanning Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Noise removal is the pre-stage and essential step for many image processing tasks. Sometimes it is hard to have correct exposure for camera in underwater environment. In general, we need to have long exposure time to collect the weak light signal which increase the background electrical noise and higher than the signal. Underwater laser scanning is such special case with white laser stripe and dark background images. Hence, noise including which dots, lumps have heavy impact to our laser image. This paper discuss underwater laser scanning image denoise and presents the method based on Sparse code shrinkage algorithm to reduce such noise effect in final reconstructed 3D model. The comparative study using natural and real 3D underwater scanning images is presented on the experimental section.

articleTitle: An Extended VIKOR Method for the Multiple Attribute Decision Making Problems Based on Interval Neutrosophic Set
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The interval neutrosophic set can be easier to express the uncertain information, and VIKOR is one of the most effective method in multiple attribute decision making, however, in general, it can only process the attribute values with triangular fuzzy numbers, and so on. In this article, in the case of attribute weights are unknown and the attribute values take the forms of interval neutrosophic sets, an extended VIKOR method is proposed for interval neutrosophic set. Firstly, the basic concepts of interval neutrosophic set are defined, and the hamming distance between interval neutrosophic sets is given. Then, an extended VIKOR method which combines hamming distance is proposed for interval neutrosophic sets. Finally, an example to illustrate the feasibility and validity of extended VIKOR method.

articleTitle: Network-Structure-Based Energy Aware Routing in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In Wireless Sensor Network (WSN), Routing protocol is a research hotspot due to its rapidly increasing application in monitoring various kinds of environment by sensing physical phenomenon. Since the sensor nodes have a limited transmission range, processing power, storage capabilities and energy resources, routing protocols must be able to prolong the lifetime of a network. In this paper, we first outline the design challenges for routing protocols in WSNs. Then, we classify the current network-structure-based routing protocols into different kinds, and we also describe and compare these kinds of routing protocols that can be used to improve the network lifetime. Besides, we also point out several further research direction of routing in WSNs.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Laser Communication System based on Circular Polarization Modulating Retro-Reflector
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Since the high stability of the circular polarization state of the beam and the polarization modulation do not drastically change the beam intensity, the problem of interference between the uplink and downlink information of the modulating retro-reflector laser communication is well solved. In the background of free space laser communication, the BER performance of circular polarization reverse modulation laser communication system is studied. The OPTISYSTEM simulation software is used to establish the system simulation model based on the echo power analysis of the modulating retro-reflector laser communication system. The bit error rate of the laser communication system based on On-Off-Keying and Circular Polarization Shift Keying modulating retro-reflector is calculated according to the simulated signal-to-noise ratio, and the highest modulating rate is given under a certain bit error rate.

articleTitle: Study on E-government Information Security in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The government in the era of big data requires safer infrastructure, information storage and data application. As a result, security threats will be the bottleneck for e-government development. Based on the e-government hierarchy model, this thesis focuses on such information security threats as human effects, network technology defects and management deficiency facing the e-government system in the era of big data. On this basis, three solutions are put forward to improve e-government information security system. Firstly, enhance information security awareness and improve network technology of information management departments in the government; secondly, conduct proper information encryption by ensuring information confidentiality and identity authentication; thirdly, implement strict information management through isolation between intranet and extranet and united planning of e-government information management.

articleTitle: Research on the design and control strategy of surgical manipulator for knee surgery assistant robot
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper designs and completes the manipulator of knee joint surgery assistant robot, and studies its control strategy. The designed manipulator has six joints and one operative end-effector. It can flexibly realize the functions of incision of knee skin tissue, incision of knee joint bone, drilling of knee joint bone and hemostasis of incision. Based on the design of the surgical manipulator, the general transfer equation of the system is deduced, and the natural frequency of the system is solved. The dynamic transfer matrix of the system is obtained, and the corresponding relationship between the dynamic input and output of each joint is obtained. An improved non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm is used for path planning to optimize the path of the end-effector of surgical manipulator in complex environment. This study improves the accuracy of cutting, drilling and hemostasis in knee surgery, optimizes the path of the end-effector, improves the quality and efficiency of knee surgery, and has good practical application value.

articleTitle: Design of a Digital Baseband Transmission Signal Coding Software Based on Java
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the lack of visual interface in digital baseband signal coding system, this paper designs a coding software for digital baseband transmission signal based on Java. Firstly, the common pattern of baseband transmission and its coding principle are given. Then the software interface is designed by Java Swing, and the algorithm of common coding is given at the same time. By giving the original message code, the AMI, HDB3 and other coding results can be obtained. The experimental results show that the software can perform digital baseband coding on the message code.

articleTitle: Study on Denoising and Enhancement Method in SAR Image based on Wavelet Packet and Fuzzy Set
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at problem of denoising and enhancement in Synthetic Apertnre Radar (SAR) image, this paper proposes a fnsion of wavelet packet transform and fnzzy set algorithm for freqnency domain and fnzzy domain collaborative and joint processing to improve denoising and enhancement effect in SAR image. Firstly, wavelet packet transform was nsed to decompose SAR image in freqnency domain, and noise was removed by threshold qnantization. Then, the low freqnency part of SAR image was linearly transformed to enhance freqnency domain of SAR image. Finally, fnzzy set algorithm was nsed to enhance fnzzy domain of SAR image. In snmmary, this paper comprehensively proposes a SAR image denoising and enhancement algorithm combining wavelet packet and fnzzy set. The effectiveness and snperiority of proposed method are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Research on The Detection Method for Insulation Piercing Connectors and Bolts on The Transmission Line Based on SSD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the piercing clamp and bolt on transmission line is easily effected by illumination, occlusion, environmental background and shooting angle, a method for detecting the piercing clamp and bolt on transmission line based on SSD algorithm is proposed in this paper. In this method, the data set get enhanced by means of flipping, translation and angle rotation, The method of multi-scale feature fusion is used to fuse deeper features of shallow feature maps, increase the perception field of shallow feature maps and improve the detection accuracy for small objects, and the intrinsic VGGNet Network in SSD Architecture is replaced with the Deep Residual Networks(ResNet-50) with deeper network depth and less computational complexity to extract the image feature. The result turns out that the mAP value of SSD models with ResNet50 reaches 91.5%, which increases by 3.2% compared with that of the models using VGG16. By using the Deep Learning object detection model, the puncture clamp with different resolution and different position angles can be better detected, which has high practical value for engineering application.

articleTitle: Real-Time PPP Time Transfer With Ambiguity Resolution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of the Real-Time Service (RTS) project, the timing users can use the real-time Precise Point Positioning (RT-PPP) technique for time transfer research. As a major participant of the RTS, the Centre National d'Etudes Spatiales (CNES) conducts PPP-WIZARD (Precise Point Positioning with Integer and Zero-difference Ambiguity Resolution Demonstrator) project to assess the real-time PPP with integer ambiguity resolution method, which is also called the RT-IPPP. In this paper, we use the real-time products broadcasted by CNES analysis center to examine the contribution of real-time ambiguity resolution on time transfer. The experimental results show that the standard deviation of the RT-IPPP results are decreased by 28.0% compared with the RT-PPP results. After using the RT-IPPP technique, the maximum error bound of RT-IPPP the time difference is decreased by 30.6%. The experimental results prove that ambiguity resolution can significantly improve the performance of time transfer in the real-time mode.

articleTitle: A Selection Method Based on Equipment Classification in Nuclear Power Plant for I&C EMC Test Standard
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Because the numbers and the types of EMC qualification standards are very large, it may take many confuse to the instrument and control (I&C) engineers when they want to select some standard to guide equipment qualification. This paper provides a selection method based on the equipment classification and help the I&C engineer of Nuclear Power Plant (NNP) to select the EMC qualification standards to guide equipment qualification. At last, combining with the selection approach it provides a suit of general instrument and control EMC qualification tables including qualification items and levels for safety class and none safety class I&C equipment.

articleTitle: Autonomous Collection System of Substation Patrol Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low intelligence and poor robustness in image acquisition of existing intelligent inspection robot in substation, this paper proposes a fully autonomous acquisition system of inspection robot in Substation Based on artificial intelligence technology. The target recognition and location in inspection video image are realized by SSD target detection algorithm. The Three-Dimensional position of the target equipment is obtained by binocular stereo vision algorithm and visual servo control algorithm. The three-dimensional position drives the robot's pan-tilt motion and completes the precise acquisition of patrol image. Through the verification of experiments and applications, a fully autonomous acquisition system for substation inspection robot proposed in this paper, realizes the standardization and precision acquisition of inspection images, and provides accurate data sources for the subsequent analysis of inspection data.

articleTitle: An Abnormal Pixel Tolerable Display Enhancing Method for Infrared Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Infrared measurement is one of important means for pelagic space instrumentation. Abnormal pixels would impair imaging quality of infrared detector and bring bad influence for display enhancing. In this paper, it presents an abnormal pixel detecting method combing statistics and frequency information and an improved display enhancing method tolerating abnormal pixels based on the detecting result. Real image experiment result shows that it could effectively detect abnormal pixels and improve display enhancing performance.

articleTitle: An application of information collection method based on RFID and WSN technology in cow breeding
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to guarantee the quality of each link of cow breeding and realize the efficient collection and real-time transmission of monitoring information, based on the analysis of the existing technology, a seamless information collection and transmission method is proposed in this paper, which combines RFID technology and WSN technology. The information collection scheme, network architecture and soft system design are introduced in this paper. Also, the stable running parameters of this constructed wireless transmission network are obtained through testing.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimum Scheme of 220 kV Regional Power Grid Based on N-1 Security Constraints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: During the flood period, a large number of wind power grids connected to the grid network will cause the N-1 overload of the power supply channel in a certain area under low-valley load mode, and the tidal currents in central and eastern regions of the region are limited under the peak load operation mode during the dry season. Considering the above problems, this paper proposes a 220kV grid optimization scheme based on the N-1 safety constraint, by witch the regional power flow distribution is optimized, the bottleneck of 220kV power grid transmission and power supply in the region is eliminated, the grid operation risk is reduced, and the grid operation economy can be improved. This program has important reference significance for the actual production operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Health Services Based on Wearable Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of medical level, people have higher and higher requirements to medical services. Personal daily health information is of great significance to the real-time monitoring of personal vital signs and health conditions, which can help people understand their physical conditions and detect symptoms early. After consulting a flood of relevant literature in the fields of WIT120, sensing and communication, a set of wearable mobile user health information-aware system was designed, and the application scenarios and future development prospects of the system were systematically analyzed.

articleTitle: A New Method for PI Parameter Adjustment of Induction Motor Based on MRAS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In speed sensorless vector control of induction motor (IM), speed estimation determines the performance of the system. Therefore, a PI parameters adjustment method of speed observer based on model reference adaptive system (MRAS) is proposed. Aiming at the problem of integral saturation and dc offset in voltage model flux observer (VM) using pure integrator, the method of high-pass filter with compensation is adopted. The transfer function of speed observer is deduced based on modern control theory. The stability of speed observer is analyzed and the PI parameters are designed according to the stability conditions, which avoids the complexity of empirical method and pole placement method, and has strong portability. The simulation results verified the feasibility and effectiveness of the design.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis Device for Nuclear radiation monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The nuclear radiation monitoring system can quickly, sensitively and reliably reflect the change of the radiation around the nuclear power plant and predict the early radiation accident state. The normal operation of radiation monitoring system is of great significance to the safety of nuclear power plant operation and radiation safety of personnel. This paper designs a portable fault rapid diagnosis device of nuclear radiation monitoring system, including fault diagnosis module, signal generation module and fault diagnosis software. This paper mainly introduces the hardware and software of the device. The test verifies that the device can simplify the process of radiation monitoring system fault diagnosis, shorten the time of fault diagnosis and analysis, and can meet the maintenance by general operators.

articleTitle: Research on Correction Method of Local Feature Descriptor Mismatch
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the local feature description algorithm increases the number of mismatches in the case of illumination mutation, and the image deformation often does not appear in a single way. Therefore, there is a high requirement for the stability of the image matching algorithm. If a similar structure appears in the local region of the image, the mismatch rate is higher, especially when the feature vector has no feature semantics or position information. The one-to-many, many-to-many mismatched pair has a higher frequency. In general, most of the methods used to circumvent such errors are commonly used to adjust the distance threshold, but the distance threshold is not targeted and the correct matching point pair may be eliminated. Therefore, Based on the KNN and RANSAC methods, this paper further uses geometric constraints to eliminate mismatches. This method can greatly improve the matching accuracy, so that the image descriptor can maintain high accuracy under the local light mutation environment and even the local similar content. Experiments have shown that our method can achieve very high matching accuracy.

articleTitle: Deterministic hierarchical joint remote state preparation using partially entangled quantum channel
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel scheme for deterministic hierarchical joint remote state preparation (HJRSP). Two senders and three receivers are involved. One sender has the amplitude information of the target state to be prepared at the receiver's port, while the other one has the phase information. There is a hierarchy among the receivers concerning their powers to reconstruct the target state. 6-particle partially entangled state is used as the quantum channel. Participants perform projective measurements under elaborate measurement bases. According to their measurement results, the receiver reconstructs the target state by means of appropriate unitary operation. The higher-power receiver reconstructs the target state independently, and the lower-power receiver reconstructs the target state if and only if all the other receivers help him (her). Different from the previous HJRSP scheme utilizing partially entangled channels, auxiliary qubit is not required in our scheme, and unit success probability can be achieved. It is shown that the success probability is independent of the parameters of the partially entangled quantum channel.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ Fuzzy Logic Control of Intelligent Electrically Powered Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A robust H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> Fuzzy Logic Control structure for a two-wheeled intelligent electrically powered wheelchair is proposed in this paper, which can compensate the effects caused by unmodeled dynamics, disturbances, approximate errors and varying external load acting on the drive system. The control structure employs a fuzzy logic controller with a simple structure incorporating an H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller based on an iterative linear matrix inequality algorithm via an acceleration feedback signal. The proposed scheme is easy to be carried on practical wheelchairs and robust to variance of the motor dynamics, sensor noise, and unmodeled vehicle dynamics. Finally, the simulation experiments show the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Forensics Framework for Malicious Behavior in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The difficult of detecting, response, tracing the malicious behavior in cloud has brought great challenges to the law enforcement in combating cybercrimes. This paper presents a malicious behavior oriented framework of detection, emergency response, traceability, and digital forensics in cloud environment. A cloud-based malicious behavior detection mechanism based on SDN is constructed, which implements full-traffic flow detection technology and malicious virtual machine detection based on memory analysis. The emergency response and traceability module can clarify the types of the malicious behavior and the impacts of the events, and locate the source of the event. The key nodes and paths of the infection topology or propagation path of the malicious behavior will be located security measure will be dispatched timely. The proposed IaaS service based forensics module realized the virtualization facility memory evidence extraction and analysis techniques, which can solve volatile data loss problems that often happened in traditional forensic methods.

articleTitle: Control Strategy Design and Dynamic Analysis of Grid-Connected Inverter Based on Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the shortcoming that the distributed generators cannot provide inertia for the power system and participate in the grid voltage regulation and frequency regulation when connecting to the grid by the grid-connected inverters, this paper designs a grid-connected inverter control strategy for simulating the characteristics of synchronous generators. Firstly, considering the corresponding relationship between the main circuit of grid-connected inverter and the equivalent circuit of synchronous generator, this paper proposes a virtual synchronous generator (VSG) outer loop controller for simulating synchronous machine rotor motion equation, active- frequency drooping characteristics and reactive-voltage droop characteristics. The virtual impedance controller is introduced in the strategy to simulate the electrical characteristics of the stator of the synchronous generator, which, combined with the inner loop controller based on the proportional integral (PI) controller forms the VSG control strategy for the grid-connected inverter. Then, the dynamic small-signal model of VSG power control is established, and the dynamic model of VSG participating in grid frequency regulation and voltage regulation is deduced. Moreover, the output active/reactive power characteristics of VSG are analyzed under the grid frequency/voltage fluctuations. Finally, the effectiveness of the VSG control strategy and the validity of the dynamic model of participating in the grid frequency regulation and voltage regulation are verified by the results of hardware-in-loop (HIL) experiments.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence and Distributed Parallel Computing in Archives Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 4th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the traditional mode, the classification of archives often has large workload, long time consumption and high labor cost. With the development of archives management towards informationization and paperlessness, it has become an important research topic to classify archives by using artificial intelligence classification method based on machine learning. In this paper, an archives classification method based on XGBoost and Spark distributed parallel computing is proposed. XGBoost algorithm can continuously improve the classification accuracy of small class samples during training rounds, which makes XGBoost algorithm has certain advantage in the classification of archives data with large samples and unbalanced class distribution. Spark distributed parallel computing system can greatly improve the computational efficiency of XGBoost algorithm and reduce the training time of the archives classification model. The simulation results show that our method has the advantages of faster model training and higher classification accuracy than the traditional method, and can satisfy the complex and huge archives classification task.
